notes.title: No Malarkey：别来虚的
contains: Malarkey
body: Malarkey是带些老派口吻的‘胡扯、瞎话’。拜登在2019年为2020年大选开展的艾奥瓦州巴士巡回活动使用了No Malarkey口号，译作‘别来虚的’更接近其语气。
游戏结局把这个口号夸张成可以清除共和党人的法案，并配上冰淇淋和飞行员墨镜。这是游戏的架空恶搞，不是真实法案或真实发生的历史事件。

sources.title: Axios：2019年No Malarkey巡回活动报道

notes.title: Amogus与sus
contains: Amogus
sus
body: Amogus是游戏名Among Us的故意错拼；sus是suspicious的缩写，意思是‘可疑、有内鬼嫌疑’。在这里，叙述者用它调侃异常悬殊的选举结果。
Among Us于2018年推出，Amogus这一写法在2020年末至2021年的网络传播中流行。它出现在2020剧本里是后来加入的网络彩蛋，不能当作当年政治人物的真实用语。

sources.title: Innersloth：2018年PC版发布公告
Know Your Meme：Amogus传播记录

notes.title: [Big Shot]：大人物
contains: [Big Shot]
body: Big shot本来就指‘大人物’。结合方括号、夸张标点和本项目的相关彩蛋，这里很可能借用了Deltarune第二章角色Spamton反复说的[BIG SHOT]。这是根据文本形式作出的用典判断，未找到作者对这句结局的明确说明。
相关游戏章节和网络梗出现在2021年；这是2020剧本中的跨年代玩笑。

sources.title: Know Your Meme：Spamton及BIG SHOT用语

notes.title: Read my lips：听清楚了
contains: Read my lips
body: 老布什在1988年共和党提名接受演说中，以‘听清楚了：不增加新税’作出鲜明承诺。Read my lips在这里是强调‘我把话说死了’，不是要求对方真的读唇语。
2016剧本将同一句式改成反对新增枪支管制立法，是游戏选项对这句名言的改写。

sources.title: Miller Center：1988年8月18日老布什演说原文

notes.title: 杜卡基斯的坦克宣传照
contains: TANK YOU VERY MUCH
photo-op of me riding in a tank
riding in a tank. Republicans
tank photo op like Dukakis
body: 1988年杜卡基斯乘坐坦克拍摄宣传照，试图展示国防领导能力；戴着头盔的画面反而招来嘲笑，也被对手用于攻击广告。
TANK YOU VERY MUCH把Thank you very much中的Thank改成Tank（坦克），借宣传照作双关。2000剧本里戈尔误开坦克、击中观众的叙事，则是借这个事件编出的荒诞结局，不是真事。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：以杜卡基斯坦克事件为题的政治漫画

notes.title: 霍顿案：原文混淆了两起犯罪
contains: Willie Horton
body: 霍顿本来因谋杀罪服刑。其离监休假后在马里兰州犯下的事件涉及强奸和袭击，并不是‘再次杀人’。1988年竞选把此案与马萨诸塞州的离监休假制度联系起来。
游戏部分题目把两起事件混为一谈，中文保留了原文叙述；请以这条旁注区分原文错误与真实历史。

sources.title: 美国国会记录：1988年9月16日对霍顿强奸及袭击案的讨论

notes.title: ‘你不是杰克·肯尼迪’
contains: Lloyd Bentsen, is widely believed to have defeated Dan Quayle
uncalled for, Senator
body: 1988年副总统辩论中，奎尔把自己的国会资历与肯尼迪参选总统时相比。本特森以自己认识并与肯尼迪共事的经历回应，最后指出奎尔不是杰克·肯尼迪。
奎尔随即回应，称这番话实在没必要。这段交锋成为著名政治反击；页眉也引用了奎尔的回应。注释只说明背景，不评价游戏中应该如何利用它。

sources.title: 总统辩论委员会：1988年10月5日辩论逐字稿

notes.title: 戈德华特的‘极端主义’名言
contains: extremism in the defense of liberty
defense of liberty
body: 这句话来自戈德华特1964年共和党提名接受演说。他以捍卫自由为理由为激烈立场辩护，紧接着又说，追求正义时的温和并非美德。
它表达的是候选人的政治立场。译文保留原句的尖锐程度，不能改成一般性的‘坚持原则’，也不能替人物额外加上认可或谴责。

sources.title: American Presidency Project：1964年7月16日演说原文

notes.title: ‘雏菊’广告
contains: Daisy
body: 1964年约翰逊阵营的广告先展示小女孩数花瓣，随后切入核爆倒计时与爆炸意象。它利用核战争恐惧，把总统选择与生存危险联系起来。
Daisy是这则政治广告的通称，不是普通花卉介绍；游戏在这里引用的是竞选广告史上的著名案例。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：Peace, Little Girl／Daisy政治广告馆藏

notes.title: ‘再也没有尼克松给你们出气了’
contains: Nixon to kick around
body: 尼克松在1962年输掉加利福尼亚州长选举后，向记者抱怨他们再也不能拿他出气，并称那是自己的最后一次记者会。Kick around在这里是反复攻击、奚落，不是‘到处闲逛’。
游戏根据尼克松的胜败，正用或反用这句话。后来的重新参选也使当年那句‘最后一次’带上了反讽意味。

sources.title: 尼克松基金会：1962年的‘最后一次记者会’

notes.title: ‘沉默的大多数’
contains: silent majority
body: 尼克松在1969年11月3日的越南战争电视演说中，向‘沉默的大多数’请求支持，用它与声音响亮的反战抗议者形成对照。
这是政治动员用语，不是经过统计确认的人口类别；它出现在1968游戏结局中，也带有对后来总统任内修辞的预示。

sources.title: American Presidency Project：1969年越南战争全国讲话

notes.title: 汉弗莱：‘快乐斗士’
contains: happy warrior
Happy Warrior
body: ‘快乐斗士’是汉弗莱的著名绰号，强调他的乐观、热情和政治斗志。Warrior在这里是比喻性的政治斗士，不是军人头衔。

sources.title: 美国参议院：汉弗莱人物传记

notes.title: 华莱士种族隔离演说的反向改写
contains: desegregation today
body: 华莱士在1963年阿拉巴马州长就职演说中，以‘今天隔离、明天隔离、永远隔离’维护种族隔离。游戏把句式反过来，改成汉弗莱宣告永远废除种族隔离。
这是游戏中的架空就职演说，不能作为汉弗莱1969年真实讲话引用。

sources.title: 阿拉巴马州档案馆：1963年1月14日华莱士就职演说

notes.title: Checkers演说：一只狗的名字
contains: Checkers speech
body: 1952年，尼克松为回应竞选资金争议发表广播电视演说，提到家中获赠的可卡犬Checkers，并说孩子们喜欢它，他不会把狗退回去。演说因此得名。
Checkers在这里是宠物名，不是‘跳棋演说’。这起争议发生于1952年；水门事件则发生在1970年代，不能把原文的联系读成同一事件。

sources.title: 尼克松基金会：Checkers演说及命名缘由

notes.title: ‘他让我们免于战争’
contains: He kept us out of war
body: 这是1916年威尔逊争取连任时的著名口号，指美国尚未卷入欧洲大战。美国随后于1917年4月对德宣战，使这个口号在回顾历史时格外醒目。
它在当时是对既有记录的宣传，不能直接译成对未来永不参战的保证。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：1917年对德宣战演说背景

notes.title: ‘黄金十字架’与自由铸银
contains: Cross of Gold
cross of gold
body: 布赖恩在1896年民主党大会演说中，用受难的十字架意象指责金本位使普通劳动者承受沉重负担。标题不是指真的金制宗教器物。
自由铸银主张让白银与黄金一样按法定比例铸币，以扩大货币供应。Free在这里指开放铸币，不是政府免费赠送银币。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：黄金十字架演说及1896年选举背景

notes.title: 麦金莱的‘前廊竞选’
contains: front porch
body: 1896年麦金莱主要在俄亥俄州坎顿的家中接待代表团并发表演说，形成‘前廊竞选’，与对手巡回演说的方式形成鲜明差别。
这里的Canton是美国俄亥俄州坎顿，不是中国广州。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：1896年麦金莱竞选史料导引

notes.title: ‘腐败交易’：1824—1825年的指控
contains: Corrupt Bargain
body: 1824年无人取得选举人票多数，选举交由众议院决定。众议院选出约翰·昆西·亚当斯，亚当斯随后任命克莱为国务卿，杰克逊阵营于是指控二人进行了‘腐败交易’。
该词是当时的政治指控，不能仅凭这个标签把秘密交换条件当作已经证实的事实。到1844年，它仍被用于攻击克莱。

sources.title: 美国众议院：第18届国会与1825年总统选举

notes.title: ‘北纬54度40分，否则开战’
contains: Fifty-four Forty or Fight
body: 这个口号要求美国在俄勒冈边界争议中坚持更北的领土主张，以战争威胁英国。数字是纬度，不是票数、金额或时间。
1846年美英最后以北纬49度附近的边界方案达成妥协，并保留整个温哥华岛给英国一方；口号表达的是强硬主张，而不是最终条约的边界。

sources.title: 美国国务院历史办公室：俄勒冈领地与1846年条约

notes.title: 社保‘保险箱’
contains: lockbox
body: 2000年辩论中，戈尔用lockbox强调把社保和医疗保障资金保护起来、不挪作他用。这是预算政策的‘专款专用’比喻，不是真的把税款存入一个金属箱子。
游戏也把这个意象写入其他候选人的政策选项；那不等于他们都说过完全相同的历史原话。

sources.title: 总统辩论委员会：2000年10月3日辩论逐字稿

notes.title: ‘一帮可鄙之人’
contains: basket of deplorables
body: 希拉里·克林顿在2016年筹款活动中，用这个说法批评一部分特朗普支持者的种族主义等偏见；她随后表示，对把比例说成‘一半’感到遗憾。
Deplorable在这里是‘应受谴责、可鄙’，不是值得同情的‘可怜’。Basket把人归成一类，中文按语境译作‘一帮’，保留这句话的攻击性。

sources.title: American Presidency Project：克林顿2016年9月10日回应声明

notes.title: ‘一百万美元的小额贷款’
contains: small loan of a million dollars
body: 特朗普在2015年的电视问答中，将父亲给他的一百万美元贷款称为‘小额’。这种‘小额’与普通人经济处境之间的反差，使这句话广为传播。
注释说明的是他当时的说法及其笑点，并不是对全部家族资助金额的核定。结局里亲自重计票的叙事也是游戏虚构。

sources.title: TIME：2015年10月26日电视问答报道

notes.title: Wide Awakes：‘觉醒者’竞选社团
contains: Wide Awake
Wide Awakes
body: 1860年支持共和党的年轻人组织‘觉醒者’社团，以制服、斗篷、提灯和整齐夜游队列营造声势。他们支持林肯，反对奴隶制扩张，并主张维护联邦。
名字指的是政治上的警醒；不能按字面理解为一群睡不着觉的人，也不应套用今天美国政治中woke一词的全部含义。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：1860年Wide Awakes政治漫画及说明

notes.title: ‘无所作为的国会’
contains: Do-Nothing
body: 杜鲁门把共和党控制的第80届国会称为‘无所作为的国会’，借此把竞选矛头从杜威本人扩大到共和党的执政记录。
这是候选人的攻击性概括，不是对国会确实没有通过任何法律的客观描述。杜鲁门自己的演说也承认国会做过一些事，只是他认为大多不好。

sources.title: 杜鲁门图书馆：1948年10月6日费城演说原文

notes.title: 1960年肯尼迪与尼克松电视辩论
contains: series of television debates
debacle against Kennedy in 1960
body: 1960年9月26日，肯尼迪和尼克松举行首场总统候选人电视辩论。候选人在荧屏上的形象与表达方式，成为此后竞选传播中的重要议题。
游戏对谁赢得辩论的评价属于叙事设定；本注不把‘所有电视观众支持肯尼迪、所有广播听众支持尼克松’这种过于整齐的说法当作确定史实。

sources.title: 肯尼迪图书馆：1960年9月26日辩论原始逐字稿

notes.title: 约瑟夫·斯密的1844年总统竞选
contains: Joseph Smith
body: 后期圣徒运动创始人约瑟夫·斯密曾在1844年竞选美国总统；同年6月27日，他在伊利诺伊州迦太基监狱被武装暴民杀害，竞选未能继续。
2012剧本用这个较少为人熟知的先例衬托罗姆尼的宗教背景。罗姆尼成为总统，是这里的游戏胜利分支，不是真实2012年大选结果。

sources.title: Joseph Smith Papers：1844年最后六周的文献与背景

notes.title: YMCA与特朗普的竞选集会
contains: YMCA screeched
body: 特朗普在2020年竞选集会末尾随着Village People的YMCA跳舞，相关画面受到广泛传播。游戏借熟悉的集会音乐，反衬败选者的绝望。
本段人物的反应及结尾情节都是游戏的架空叙事，不能当作拜登或麦戈文的真实经历。

sources.title: 美联社2020年10月21日报道：特朗普的YMCA集会舞步

notes.title: Fear and Loathing：书名改写
contains: Fear and Loathing in Trump Hotel
body: 这一标题很可能把亨特·S.·汤普森的Fear and Loathing in Las Vegas书名，改成了‘特朗普酒店里的恐惧与厌恶’，借用它的荒诞、失控气氛。
这里属于根据标题结构推定的文学用典；未找到作者直接确认，不能据此认定整段模仿了该书的具体情节。

sources.title: 企鹅兰登书屋：汤普森原书及作者信息

notes.title: 国内公共工程与克莱的“美国体系”
contains: Do you believe that some revenue should be set aside from our tariffs to finance internal improvements, such as canals and roads?
Henry Clay supports the idea that the federal government should purchase the telegraph patent and manage the technology. To what extent should you attack him on this?
This sounds like the most ridiculous idea yet from Mr. Clay's long public career. I trust that enterprising individuals and companies will develop this technology.
We don't need to hammer on the internal improvements issue. We have other things to talk about which will better unite the party.
Only a very limited amount, for the most compelling projects. Otherwise the tariff should be for revenue purposes only.
This is one of the key objectives of our current tariff policy, and I would support a strong infrastructure program as President.
I don't believe that it is constitutional or advisable for the federal government to undertake an internal improvements program.
Do you still support the idea that the federal government should purchase the telegraph patent and manage the technology?
I absolutely believe that the development of telegraph lines should take its place alongside canals, harbors, and railroads as a national prerogative.
I've supported internal improvements throughout my career, but telegraph lines are a different thing. I trust that private individuals can build these.
We should attack the Northern Democrats on their opposition to, or flip-flopping on, the issues of tariffs and internal improvements. They are on soft ground in that debate.
body: 这里的internal improvements指运河、道路等交通与公共工程，不是泛指改善内政。克莱的“美国体系”把保护性关税、国家银行和联邦资助的公共工程结合起来，主张通过交通和市场联系促进各地区经济。
电报是否应由政府购买专利并管理，是游戏把新技术放进这场政府权限争论中的具体选项。译文保留赞成政府主导与支持私人建设的区别。

sources.title: 美国参议院：克莱1832年“美国体系”演说
美国众议院：1824年“美国体系”演说

notes.title: 国家银行、银行战争与独立国库
contains: Regardless of your personal feelings, would you sign an act which established an independent Treasury for the government's funds?
I stand for a national bank, broadly similar to the late Second Bank of the United States.
I stand for a national bank or an independent Treasury -- whichever can gain the most support. I would require any national bank to maintain a branch in every state.
I will never support a national bank, but I do advocate an independent Treasury, so that federal funds won't be tied up in local speculations.
I support our current free banking system, and I see no need for the Treasury to insulate its operations from the state-chartered banks.
I support a national bank, and one clear argument for the bank is the total chaos we've had with our currency since 1837.
Only if we could establish one without chartering a new national bank.
I support an independent Treasury, but not one that would disseminate a national currency.
Our current system is more democratic than any alternative that could be devised. Let the private banks issue currency in line with their own strength and prosperity.
The independent Treasury is a halfway measure, designed to cover for the disaster that was the war against the Second Bank of the United States.
I would prefer a national bank, but I would be willing to sign a bill which created an independent Treasury.
The creation of an independent Treasury will be one of the key initiatives of my Presidency.
I support our current banking system, and would not support any ill-conceived attempts to centralize our finances.
Are you out of your mind? A national bank is anathema to the Democratic Party.
The independent Treasury idea has broad support in the party, and also shows that Democrats are trying to do something after the 1837 crisis.
A national bank is anathema to most Democrats.
What is the idea behind this outburst? The Bank War was, perhaps, Andrew Jackson's central initiative as President.

Regardless of your views on the banking question, many accuse your running mate of being too closely tied to the Second Bank of the United States, and too inexperienced in government. What is your response?
I would attack any person who asserts that working with the Second Bank of the United States is poor preparation for government.
People know that you have a strong opinion on the national bank -- there's no need to veer into extremism.
body: 1844年语境中的national bank，是围绕是否恢复类似美国第二银行的全国性银行而展开的争论。第二银行的联邦特许期限于1836年届满；“已撤销”指其全国性特许地位，并非说其当时立即停止一切州级业务。杰克逊1832年否决续约，是“银行战争”的关键事件。
独立国库是让政府自行保管公共资金、减少对私人银行依赖的制度，不是设立现代中央银行。1846年沃克任财政部长时，该制度重新确立。自由银行制度也不是免费银行服务。这些概念不能套用1863年的全国银行法或1913年成立的美联储。

sources.title: 美联储历史：美国第二银行
美国财政部：罗伯特·沃克与1846年独立国库
美国参议院：1863年全国银行法

notes.title: 本土主义与1844年费城暴乱
contains: Do you have any statement on the presence of Theodore Frelinghuysen on the Whig ticket, and his association with known anti-Catholic agitators?
There have recently been riots and armed clashes between nativists and Irish immigrants in Philadelphia and elsewhere. Do you have any plans to condemn the nativist violence in these episodes?
The Democratic Party is a friend of the working-class, and of immigrants from abroad. We denounce the vile bigotry of the Whig Party, as evidenced by Frelinghuysen.
The Whig Party attempts to stand apart from these nativist mobs, yet their own candidate for Vice President has associated with virulent anti-Catholics.
I don't want to address civil disorder directly, but we should be clear that we oppose any changes to our naturalization laws.
I support our current naturalization laws as they stand.
Only some very minor changes, like increasing the waiting period before new citizens may vote.
Our current laws are in need of great revision, in light of the troubles we have had with recent immigrants.
The Irish vote in the North has gone heavily in your favor recently. It's a good idea to keep it that way.
A nice aside aimed at Clay, but you should show more vigor in defense of your Irish supporters.
Immigration restriction is more of a Whig position, and it does you little good to advocate for it.
Nativism appears to be on the rise, but you are probably better off, on the whole, taking a more moderate tack.
The background of your running mate, Theodore Frelinghuysen, has caused much distress among the Catholics of this country? Will you make any statements on this issue?
There have recently been riots and armed clashes between nativists and Irish immigrants in Philadelphia and elsewhere. Do you have any plans to condemn the Irish violence in these episodes?
We need to address these concerns and state categorically that the Whigs support our current naturalization laws and do not stand for nativism.
Of course we denounce rioting and lawlessness, but we do support some attempt to change our naturalization laws.
We should condemn the apparent lawlessness of the Irish arrivals, and ask whether we ought to reconsider our generous naturalization policies.
After a few days have passed and tempers have cooled, let us reemphasize our support for current naturalization laws.
At the national level, this is probably your best position. In certain locales the nativist sentiment does appear to be rising, however.
This could cost you some nativist support, but that wing is hopefully concentrated in states that aren't close.
body: 此处nativism指反移民、反天主教的本土主义或排外主义，与美国原住民无关。许多爱尔兰移民信奉天主教，这使宗教与移民冲突相互交织。1844年费城发生暴乱，天主教教堂遭焚毁。
游戏分别提供谴责本土主义者和谴责爱尔兰人的题目，这是政治立场不同的两段原文，不能合并成同一个温和表态。入籍法决定成为公民的条件；选项中的新公民投票等待期另行译明，避免与一般入境等待混淆。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：爱尔兰移民的宗教冲突与歧视
美国国会图书馆：1844年费城暴乱版画与编目说明

notes.title: 禁议规则：不是普通的维持议事秩序
contains: Do you support the lifting of the Gag Rule in Congress?
Congress must function in an orderly fashion, without taking time out from its business to receive ill-conceived petitions. I support the Gag Rule.
Regardless of our feelings about the slavery issue, it is undemocratic for Congress to deny the people the right to petition the government. I believe the Gag Rule should be lifted.
We have no plans to address the Gag Rule during our campaign.
Ending the Gag Rule is definitely a Whig prerogative.
body: 众议院1836年开始采用禁议规则，把涉及奴隶制的请愿自动搁置，不予进一步处理。约翰·昆西·亚当斯反对它，认为它侵害请愿权；规则最终在1844年12月3日被废除。
因此，支持禁议规则的选项是在支持压下反奴隶制请愿。它不只是一般性的议会纪律要求。游戏在竞选期间询问是否支持废除，译文没有把大选后的结果写进人物当时的回答。

sources.title: 美国众议院：禁议规则及其废除

notes.title: “天定命运”的年代问题
contains: I believe that the United States, in line with the “Manifest Destiny” ideal, should expand wherever feasible.
body: “天定命运”以天意和民族使命为领土扩张辩护。约翰·L.·奥沙利文在1845年的《吞并》文章中使用了这一著名措辞。
这一选项位于1844年剧本，因而存在用后来成名的术语概括较早扩张观念的年代错置。译文保留原作说法；不能据此认定人物在1844年已经使用了这个固定口号。

sources.title: 奥沙利文1845年《吞并》原文及史料导读

notes.title: 卡尔霍恩致帕肯纳姆信
contains: Do you have any statement to make on John Calhoun's “Packenham Letter”, stating slavery to be a positive blessing, and justifying the annexation of Texas as a pro-slavery move?
I would not go to the lengths of John Calhoun, but Texas would certainly help expand the market for slavery in our country.
We will frame Texas as an issue of national pride and national expansion. I rebuke the idea of Calhoun that this is purely a Southern enterprise.
I disagree with John Calhoun across the board, which leads to my opposition to the annexation of Texas.
body: 卡尔霍恩1844年4月18日写给英国驻美公使理查德·帕肯纳姆的信，为奴隶制辩护，并把吞并得克萨斯与保护奴隶制免受英国废奴政策影响联系起来。这里的“积极的福祉”是他的政治主张，不是校注认可的事实判断。
游戏原文写作Packenham，收信人的规范拼写是Pakenham。中文按帕肯纳姆处理，原始英文数据保持不变。选项之间对奴隶市场、全国扩张和南方利益的不同表态也完整保留。

sources.title: 卡尔霍恩1844年致理查德·帕肯纳姆信原文

notes.title: 普林斯顿号事故与国务卿更替
contains: After the unfortunate death of Abel Upshur in the Princeton explosion, John Calhoun succeeded him as Secretary of State. Was this a wise appointment by President Tyler?
body: 1844年2月28日，普林斯顿号在波托马克河试航时，“和平缔造者”舰炮爆炸，国务卿阿贝尔·厄普舒尔、海军部长托马斯·吉尔默等人遇难。这里说的是军舰事故，不是普林斯顿大学发生爆炸。

sources.title: 美国海军历史与遗产司令部：普林斯顿号舰史

notes.title: 伯尼：原作的人名误写
contains: Thomas Birney is a stooge of the Democrats, attempting to agitate emotions and divide our party. People ought to feel free to vote for him if they want to hand this election to James K. Polk.
I am steadfast against the annexation of Texas and the expansion of slavery. I believe that Birney's followers should be made aware of this point.
body: 1844年自由党的总统候选人是詹姆斯·吉莱斯皮·伯尼（James G. Birney）。游戏这个攻击选项却写成Thomas Birney，正文按原文保留为“托马斯·伯尼”，在此说明实际人物。
“民主党的傀儡”“把大选送给波尔克”属于玩家角色的竞选攻击，不是对伯尼真实动机的史学定论。自由党是当时的废奴第三党，不是现代自由意志党的另一译名。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：1844年自由党候选人詹姆斯·伯尼肖像

notes.title: 地域偏见：原句可能漏了否定词
contains: I am against the annexation of Texas. And just to show that this does derive from sectional prejudice, I am also against expansion into Oregon or other regions.
body: 原文确实写的是“this does derive from sectional prejudice”（这确实源于地域偏见）。但紧接着说既反对得克萨斯扩张，也反对俄勒冈等地扩张，可能本想表达“不因地域偏见而反对”，疑似漏写not。
译文保留现有英文的肯定含义，不擅自补成否定。这里的sectional指美国不同地区之间的利益分歧，不是社会阶层。得克萨斯与俄勒冈涉及不同的领土及奴隶制争论，这也解释了原句为何可疑；漏词只是校订判断，并未获作者确认。

sources.title: 美国国务院历史办公室：得克萨斯吞并
美国国务院历史办公室：俄勒冈领地争端

notes.title: 俄勒冈边界与原文语病
contains: We need to negotiate a permanent agreement with Great Britain that grants some of all of the Oregon Territory to the United States.
I would support any agreement, as long as the United States keeps the land that is south and east of the Colombia River.
body: 这里的俄勒冈领地是美英争议地区，范围不能等同于今天的俄勒冈州。1846年条约主要沿北纬49度划界，并保留温哥华岛归英国。哥伦比亚河曾是谈判中的另一种边界构想。
原选项写作“some of all”，语法不通。本译文根据上下文按“some or all”（部分或全部）理解，明确记录这一解释，而不声称原文无误。另一选项把Columbia River拼成Colombia River；中文采用通行译名“哥伦比亚河”。游戏中的政策选择和实际历史最终条约分开说明。

sources.title: 美国国务院历史办公室：1846年俄勒冈领地协议

notes.title: 非洲殖民安置与附条件废奴
contains: We must put out a letter, clarifying that we only support abolition if slaveholders can be fairly compensated, with reasonable notice, and if freed slaves can be recolonized to Africa.
body: 这里的recolonized to Africa指把获释黑人送往非洲建立殖民定居点，不能译成一般的国内再安置。美国殖民协会推动自由黑人迁往非洲，亨利·克莱是其中的重要人物。
选项同时要求补偿奴隶主、给予提前通知和非洲殖民安置。这是附带条件的废奴主张，与立即、无条件废奴不同；译文保留这些限制，不把它改写为现代平等权利宣言。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：殖民安置及亨利·克莱

notes.title: 众议院选总统：按州投票，不是按议员人数
contains:
Wow. No candidate has achieved a majority in the Electoral College

This is surely an unusual situation, given that no candidate besides yourself and Clay seemed poised to win an electoral vote. Fortunately, the Democrats have won a majority in the House and seem likely to confirm you as the ultimate winner. Best wishes for your term in office.

Wow. No candidate has achieved a majority in the Electoral College

This is sure an unusual situation, given that no candidate besides yourself and Polk seemed poised to win an electoral vote. Unfortunately, the Democrats have won a majority in the House and seem likely to confirm James K. Polk as the ultimate winner. How will your legacy be remembered?
body: 如果没有总统候选人获得已任命选举人票的过半数，宪法第十二修正案规定，由众议院从选举人票最多的至多三名候选人中选出总统。每个州的代表团只有一票；副总统另由参议院按相应规则选出。
游戏结局只说民主党在众议院占多数，所以波尔克很可能获选。这是原作的简化叙事：议员席位总数占多数，并不必然等于掌握多数州代表团。译文保留“很可能”的语气，不把这一结果说成自动产生的法律规则。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：选举人团相关宪法条文（第十二修正案）

notes.title: “小山核桃”：杰克逊的政治传人
contains: For better or worse, many view you as a protege of Andrew Jackson (some call you “Young Hickory”). Is it better to embrace this label, or to distance yourself from it?
body: 杰克逊被称为“老山核桃”（Old Hickory）；波尔克因支持杰克逊的政策而获得“小山核桃”（Young Hickory）的称号。这里的“年轻”强调政治传承，不是在谈一种树的树龄。
问题是在问：应该利用杰克逊的声望，还是避免被视为缺乏独立立场的门生。称号本身是真实的历史竞选用语，不是后来网上杜撰的昵称。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：波尔克生平时间线
美国国会图书馆：1844年民主党竞选旗帜

notes.title: 一无所知党：这是党名，不是在骂人无知
contains: We need to acknowledge the Know-Nothing point of view. Otherwise, they will bolt to this so-called Constitutional Union party.
Better to keep the German vote in line -- A few Know-Nothings (in the North) may vote for Bell, but they are more likely to despise Stephen A. Douglas, and vote for the man who can beat him.
We will attack the Republican embrace of immigration as opportunistic and disingenuous. It doesn't take a genius to figure out which party the Know Nothings joined.
body: Know-Nothings指一无所知党人，与当时排外、反天主教的美国党运动有关。成员对组织活动的询问，常以“我对此一无所知”作答，因此得名。不能把他们译成一般的“一无所知的人”。
游戏中声称这些人转投某党，是人物为了争取选民或攻击对手而说的话。译文保留这种政治修辞，不将其扩写为所有成员都以相同方式转党的史学结论。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：美国党1854年入党审查问题原件
美国国会图书馆：一无所知名称与排外活动

notes.title: 人民主权：由领地居民决定奴隶制
contains: We can support the idea of popular sovereignty, but that must include an acknowledgement that Kansas clearly desires to enter the Union as a free state.
Douglas and his party are running on the failed, dishonest policy of popular sovereignty. I want the Republicans to point this out at every opportunity.

I had hoped that popular sovereignty would resolve the slavery issue, but the intransigence of the Southern bolters has convinced me otherwise. I now believe that slavery must not be permitted in any new state or territory.
body: 在这段美国内战前的争论中，popular sovereignty主要指由领地居民决定是否允许奴隶制，而不是泛泛宣称一切权力属于人民。道格拉斯推动的1854年《堪萨斯—内布拉斯加法》，将这一原则用于新领地，并废除了密苏里妥协的地域限制。
Southern bolters指脱离原有党派阵营的南方人，绝不是“南方爆弹手”。这个选项让玩家改弦更张、反对新州与领地的奴隶制，是游戏允许的立场选择，不能当作道格拉斯真实历史竞选纲领。

sources.title: 美国参议院：堪萨斯—内布拉斯加法

notes.title: 迪克西民主党人与瑟蒙德转党
contains: You have vindicated leftist critics, along with outraging your base. Dixiecrats are ecstatic, believing the Democratic party has bowed after many years, but they aren’t abandoning Wallace.

Today, famous South Carolinian and 1948 Dixiecrat candidate Strom Thurmond has officially switched his party affiliation from Democratic to Republican, an expected move after his endorsement of Barry Goldwater for President.
body: Dixie是美国南方的传统称呼。Dixiecrats在这里指1948年反对民主党民权路线、支持种族隔离的州权民主党人。瑟蒙德曾以该党总统候选人身份参选，并于1964年9月加入共和党。
这个名称指特定历史派系，不能泛指所有南方民主党人。1968年的反馈是在描述游戏中这些选民如何反应，不是断言他们在现实中必然采取同一种投票行为。

sources.title: 美国参议院：斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德生平

notes.title: 政治“狗哨”：带有隐含指向的措辞
contains: Nice try, but you’re attempting to appeal to those who distrust you and are firmly in Nixon’s camp. Worse, the black community has taken your choice of words as a racist dog whistle.
body: 政治狗哨是表面上可以作普通解释、却向特定群体传递另一层含义的措辞。这里的反馈明确说，黑人群体把人物的用词理解为种族主义暗示；它不是指真的吹狗哨。
这是游戏叙述者对选项效果的描述。校注解释术语，不把所有相似词汇一概判为种族主义，也不声称这是1968年人物当时使用的固定术语。

sources.title: 韦氏词典：dog whistle的政治含义

notes.title: “稳固南方”与南方战略
contains:
As expected, you've lost the 1964 Election.

Despite your best efforts, perhaps it was always an impossible task to beat an incumbent as strong as Johnson from the position you began in. You were certainly never favored, so this comes as no surprise to anyone.

Despite your failure, however, the door has been opened for your followers, like Ronald Reagan, to enter Republican politics as mainstream candidates. On another note, the Southern Strategy appears to have worked in full, and Republican strategists are already taking notes on how to exploit the now wide-open South. Though your chapter may be closed, a new chapter of the Republican Party may just be beginning. In any case, your popularity in Arizona remains. Perhaps another term in the Senate is in your future?
I won’t be the one to lose the Solid South. With enough subtle hints, under-the-table deals, and backpedaling on earlier promises and policies we’ve made, we’ll reel the South back in yet.

Your rebuke only worsens the fracture in the party, but Humphrey is pleased by your steadfast support- as are liberals nationwide. You may have broken the Solid South, but the rest of the country might just make up for it.
body: Solid South在这里指传统上稳定支持民主党的南方票仓，也常称“南方基地”。“稳固”说的是党派选票格局，不是南方社会不存在冲突。南方战略则是共和党争取这批原民主党选民的竞选策略，两者不能混为同一个概念。
1964年民权争论及白人反弹，是这种重组的重要背景。游戏所说“南方战略已充分奏效”是具体游戏结局的判断，不表示现实中的转变在一年内全部完成。

sources.title: PBS《美国历史》：稳固南方及其民主党票仓背景
美国国家档案馆：1964年竞选中的种族政治

notes.title: 德雷德·斯科特案：公民身份与领地奴隶制
contains: What is your position on the Supreme Court's Dred Scott v. Sandford decision?
We must remain steadfast against the acquisition of new territories, and must combat the expansion of slavery to the extent permitted by the Supreme Court's Dred Scott decision.

This is the most odious, dangerous decision to be handed down in the history of the Court. What is to prevent the Court from forcing slavery next upon the states themselves, under some dubious interpretation?
We obviously cannot agree with this decision, but the Supreme Court lays down the law of the land, and we have little choice but to acquiesce.

I don't believe that blacks and whites will ever mix socially in this nation, but that cannot change the fact that blacks are citizens of this nation, and should be given the voting and property rights to match that status.
Your weakness on the Dred Scott case is a bombshell, and the source of much consternation among Republicans.
This answer is a bit soft for the abolitionist wing. There is great fear that Dred Scott will be only the beginning of the Court's interference in the slavery debate.
We believe that the Supreme Court is the highest law in the land, and should be respected by all decent Americans.
We join the Republicans in denouncing this decision. We may have our differences, but we can all agree that this Court has acted well beyond its bounds in this case.
Negativity on the Dred Scott decision is confined to the Republican vote.
body: 1857年的德雷德·斯科特诉桑福德案，否认被作为奴隶带入美国的非洲人后裔享有判决所说的联邦公民身份，并认定国会不得在联邦领地禁止奴隶制。这里的领地不能随意译成已加入联邦的州。
游戏人物对判决的谴责、接受或担忧，是不同政治立场；不能把所有回答改写成同一种现代评价。某些选项让玩家主张黑人拥有公民身份与投票权，这也不等于林肯在1860年真实发表过相同承诺。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：1857年斯科特案判决与原文

notes.title: 莱蒙案：经过自由州，不等于逃奴案件
contains: Do you have any comments on the Lemmon v. New York case which may be making its way to the Supreme Court?

If the Court rules that slaves can be brought into free states without consequence, then we will effectively have a slave nation on our hands. This is the type of Southern aggression that we must be ever-vigilant against.
We don't know for sure if the Court will consider this case, and for now we ought to avoid making any statements on it.
body: 莱蒙案涉及奴隶主从弗吉尼亚前往得克萨斯、途经纽约时带入的八名被奴役者。纽约法院判他们自由；纽约州上诉法院于1860年维持该结果。它与逃亡奴隶遭追捕的问题不同。
游戏担心此案进一步上诉后，最高法院会要求自由州承认带入境内者的奴隶身份。这是人物对未来判决的担忧，不是已经发生的联邦判决。原作采用Lemmon v. New York这一名称；纽约正式判例也以Lemmon v. People记载。

sources.title: 纽约法院历史学会：莱蒙奴隶案
纽约州上诉法院2022年判决回顾Lemmon v. People（1860）

notes.title: 个人自由法与《逃奴法》
contains: What is your position on the passage of “personal liberty laws” by various states, to flout the Fugitive Slave Act?
I support the personal liberty laws, and would favor a repeal or scaling back of the Fugitive Slave Law.
Let's try to avoid this issue in our campaign statements and speeches. No good can come of it.
The newer Fugitive Slave Law was the result of reasoned compromise in Congress. I may disagree with aspects of that Compromise, but I must accept it as a whole.
These are the types of radical abolitionist measures which have caused so many problems in our politics. The federal law takes precedence.
I'm not going to make any statements condemning these laws during the present campaign. That would be a hasty, alienating move on our part.
body: 1850年《逃奴法》加强了联邦追捕、遣返逃亡奴隶的机制。北方一些州的个人自由法则提供州级程序保障，或限制州官员、监狱协助执行。它们不是泛指保障所有个人自由的法律。
例如马萨诸塞1855年法对主张奴隶所有权者的举证提出要求，并限制使用州内拘禁设施。游戏选项分别主张支持、回避或服从联邦法，译文保留这一争论，不悄悄合并成一致立场。

sources.title: 美国参议院：梅森与1850年《逃奴法》
马萨诸塞州图书馆：1855年第489章个人自由法原件

notes.title: 赠地大学与“中等教育”的原文疑点
contains: What is your position on the creation of land grant universities for secondary education?
Yes, let's emphasize our support of this measure. We stand behind education and the expansion of opportunity.
Let's keep our mouth shut on this issue, and stick to our opposition to slavery.
We support this idea as a positive step for working men in this country.
This is not something that we should address in our campaign. We should channel our focus on other issues.
This strikes me, and many Democrats, as a potential waste of federal land and resources.
This is definitely more of a Republican issue at this point.
body: 赠地大学通过联邦赠予公共土地等方式支持办学。1862年《莫里尔法》资助以农业和机械技艺为重点的学院，属于高等教育。
原问题却写成land grant universities for secondary education，即“用于中等教育的赠地大学”。正文保留这个不协调的说法，在此指出中等教育与高等教育之别；不能据此认为这些大学是中学，也不能把1862年法案当作1860年已经生效的法律。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：1862年《莫里尔法》

notes.title: 宅地法：土地分配与1860年否决
contains: How much should your party emphasize its support of a homestead act in this election?
The core belief of our party is that the federal territories should be settled by honest, free, hard-working men and their families. A homestead act would be right in line with this philosophy.
Even the Northern Democrats support a homestead act. Let's stick to issues where we have a distinction to hammer on.
This has been a Democratic idea since the days of Andrew Jackson. We support it completely.
Anyone can see that we support this idea, but our main emphasis should be on other issues.
Part of any compromise with Southern Democrats would involve a resolution in the territories. By what rights should planters be denied their opportunity to purchase western land?
Homesteads are a winning issue in the North. There's no reason to hold back here.
body: 宅地政策讨论以公共土地支持定居与耕作，不能直接套用中国宅基地制度。1860年国会曾通过宅地法案，但布坎南总统否决了它。著名的《宅地法》直到1862年5月20日才由林肯签署。
因此，游戏在1860年讨论是否支持宅地立法，有真实背景；不能把支持这一主张译成已经落实1862年法案。对自由劳动者与种植园主购买西部土地的不同表述，也分别保留。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：1860年否决与1862年《宅地法》

notes.title: “黑色共和党”：种族化的竞选攻击
contains: Should your party continue its familiar attacks on the “black Republicans” as abolitionists and supporters of social and political equality for blacks?
Lincoln and his party are abolitionists, whether they care to admit it or not. I don't believe a majority in the North would support them if this were fully understood.
Of course we should. This is one of most effective attacks we have against the shenanigans of the Republicans.
I'm sure people out there will make these attacks on their own initiative, but we shouldn't emphasize this too much.

It might be in our best interest to play down such rhetoric in this particular campaign. Our base in the North will vote for us anyway, and it's not as if we have any Southern support to lose at this point.
This is the logical conclusion of the Republican program, if they succeed in closing off slavery and slowly extinguishing it.
We should hold back on this kind of rhetoric, given the unusual nature of this year's election.
Not at all. This argument has come up in the past, but we should take a more careful analysis of it this time around.
body: “Black Republicans”是当时对共和党的种族化贬称，用来攻击其反对奴隶制扩张的政策、煽动对白人与黑人关系改变的恐惧。这里不能译成单纯表示族裔身份的“黑人共和党人”。
1860年讽刺画就曾把所谓“Black Republicanism”与一名夸张描绘的黑人候选人联系起来。游戏选项是在重现这种攻击话术，校注解释其含义，不认可这类指控，也不把“反扩张”和“立即废奴”混为一谈。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：1860年反共和党讽刺画及编目说明

notes.title: 约翰·布朗突袭与1859年恐慌
contains: What should your party's position be on the raid of John Brown, late in 1859?
Whatever our private feelings, we have no choice but to denounce such extralegal actions.
Clearly what John Brown did was illegal, but without the obstructionism and provocation of the South on slavery, it would have never come to pass.
We will condemn the activity of any such self-styled revolutionaries. John Brown was a fanatic and a lunatic.
We will keep silent on this episode as we campaign.
It's an easy victory for you to criticize John Brown.
body: 1859年10月16日，约翰·布朗及其追随者突袭哈珀斯费里的联邦军械库，试图推动反奴隶制起义。事件激化了南北恐惧与相互指责。
原问题的late in 1859在这里指1859年后期，不应理解为12月发生。玩家可以谴责其违法行为，也可以批评南方的挑衅；这类可选立场不是每位候选人在现实中逐字说过的史料。

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：约翰·布朗突袭经过
美国国家公园管理局：布朗突袭与1860年选举

notes.title: 自由港学说：地方立法如何影响奴隶制
contains: There's nothing in this decision which contradicts my own ideas on slavery. Slavery can hardly thrive in a territory where the residents oppose the practice, regardless of the Court's abstractions on the issue.
body: 1858年自由港辩论中，道格拉斯主张：即使最高法院承认将奴隶带入领地的权利，领地居民仍可通过不提供支持奴隶制的地方立法，使它难以维持。这个回答后来被称为自由港学说。
这解释了游戏里他为什么一面不否认斯科特案判决，一面坚持居民反对就能阻止奴隶制发展。它不等于法院已经撤销原判，也不是联邦政府直接禁止奴隶制。

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：自由港学说及1858年辩论

notes.title: 永久保护奴隶制的修宪主张
contains: Would you support a compromise Amendment which permanently protected slavery in the Southern states, in return for no further expansion of the institution?
I would not support any Amendment that irrevocably protects slavery in the South. We would have to see if a more narrow compromise was possible.
We will absolutely not address this in our campaign. If it comes to this next year, then we can make a more specific determination at that point.
I'm open to some kind of compromise that would provide guarantees on slavery in the South, as long as it would not allow the extension of slavery to new states or territories.
Absolutely I would. Not only would this prevent a potential war and preserve the Union, but it would remove slavery from the realm of political debate once and for all.
I would need to see the details of these Amendments before I could take a position.
Not really. I'm all for compromise between the sections, but how could we have a permanent Amendment to the Constitution? Couldn't we have another Amendment to amend that Amendment?
It would be better to reserve judgment on this issue until after the election. Many moderates would support some kind of compromise if the alternative was secession and civil war.

Congratulations! You have won the 1860 Presidential Election.

How on earth did you pull this off? Hopefully you can soothe the frayed nerves from this turbulent campaign, and move the country past its slavery issues of the 1850s. Your supporters are already preparing a compromise amendment, offering permanent protection for slavery in the South in return for the admission of more free states. An invasion of Cuba may also be in order.

No candidate captured an Electoral College majority.

Congress will now choose from the top three candidates in the electoral vote count. If you are in the top three, you have a great chance. Otherwise, Bell will be the favorite. Your supporters are already preparing a compromise amendment, offering permanent protection for slavery in the South in return for the admission of more free states. You will likely have to make such promises to prevent a deadlock in the House vote.
body: 危机中的妥协方案可能保护既有蓄奴州的制度，同时限制其扩张。1861年提出的科温修正案，试图禁止未来修宪赋予国会干预州内奴隶制的权力，但没有获得所需批准、成为宪法。
1860年游戏问题是在询问一种尚待形成的妥协，并未指名这就是科温修正案。不能把它译成已经通过的法律，也不能把人物质疑“以后能否再修宪”的台词当作对永久性条款的确定法律裁判。

sources.title: 美国国会访客中心：1861年科温修正案原件

notes.title: 禁止进口奴隶，不等于废除奴隶制
contains: Do you have anything to say about the efforts of some to reopen the Atlantic slave trade?
The fact that this is even under consideration as a demand shows how far beyond compromise the South has drifted.
I'm sure that these are just rumors and speculation. It would be irresponsible of me at this point to extend my obvious condemnation of this step.
This is the type of aggressive, expansive move by the Southern Democrats that led to the split in our party. Under no circumstances would I support the reopening of the Atlantic slave trade.
Let's keep a low profile on this issue and hope it passes. We don't need to make things worse by issuing controversial statements.
Opposition to the reopening of the slave trade is a no-brainer.
body: 美国禁止从海外输入奴隶的联邦法律于1808年1月1日生效，但奴隶制与美国境内的奴隶买卖继续存在。游戏讨论“重启跨大西洋奴隶贸易”，针对的是海外输入这一禁令。
因此，反对重启贸易不必然意味着赞成立即废奴。译文把进口禁令、国内奴隶贸易和奴隶制本身区分开来。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：奴隶贸易及1808年进口禁令

notes.title: 移民与入籍：nationalization的语境疑点
contains: What position should your party take on foreign immigration and nationalization in this election?
Germans are a key part of our new party and our vote in the Midwest. Let's express our support for the current naturalization laws.
The Democrats are in favor of our current naturalization laws. That is my position and I stand by it.
Let's skirt this issue and attempt to focus our campaign on other things. There's not much for us to gain here.
body: 原问题用的是nationalization，通常可指国有化；但上下文讨论外国移民，实际选项明确谈naturalization laws（入籍法）。本译文据此按“入籍”理解，并在这里公开说明，而不是另造一个国有化政策议题。
入籍是取得公民身份的程序，不等同于入境或移民本身。1802年法律恢复了入籍所需的五年等待要求，这是当时讨论现行入籍法的历史背景。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：1802年恢复入籍等待要求

notes.title: “喷火派”：激进的南方分离主义者
contains: Herschel Johnson is a former Governor of Georgia with a stated opposition to the Fire-Eaters and talk of secession. He is one of the last leading Democrats of the South to have not bolted to the Southern Democrat splinter party. Unfortunately, it is not very likely that Johnson's presence will help Douglas compete with Breckenridge or Bell in the South.

James Guthrie served as Secretary of the Treasury under Franklin Pierce, and paid off most of the federal debt during that term. He is a slaveholder and states' rights advocate, but a bitter opponent of secession. His selection would allow Douglas to run with a Southerner who is still somewhat connected to the national political scene. Guthrie has also long advocated internal improvements and owns a railroad, which could attract some limited crossover support from former Whigs.
body: Fire-Eaters不是表演吞火的人，而是内战前激进维护奴隶制、鼓吹蓄奴州脱离联邦的一批南方人物。他们也有人要求恢复跨大西洋奴隶贸易。
约翰逊介绍中反对“喷火派”，并不表示他反对一切奴隶制；格思里虽然是奴隶主并主张州权，也反对脱离联邦。奴隶主、州权派与分离主义者不能当作完全相同的标签。

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：喷火派与南方分离运动

notes.title: Hunkers与“烧谷仓派”
contains: Horatio Seymour has served as Governor of New York and is influential in that state's politics. By selecting him, Douglas would be running with an all-northern ticket, but he could gain valuable votes in the nation's largest state. Seymour has been associated with the "Hunker" faction of New York Democrats, who favor internal improvements and oppose agitation on the slavery issue. It would take some cajoling and possibly more for Seymour to accept the nomination.
body: Hunkers是纽约民主党内部较保守的派系，译文保留英文并说明为“保守派”；不宜把它当作全国统一的另一个政党。与之相对的Barnburners，则是更反对奴隶制扩张的一派。
Barnburners的绰号借用了“为除掉老鼠，连谷仓也烧掉”的故事，用来讥讽改革过于激烈。这是政治派系之间的比喻性攻击，不是说这些人真的烧毁了谷仓。

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：纽约民主党的Hunkers与Barnburners

notes.title: 联合选票：不只是总统与副总统搭档
contains: Hopefully you are far enough ahead in New York and Pennsylvania that this fusion ticket doesn't matter.
What is your opinion on the formation of fusion tickets in the Northern states to consolidate the anti-Lincoln vote?
This is no time for false pride. Let's do what we can to build a fusion ticket where that action makes sense, and worry about the rest when we get to it.

I will never appear on a fusion ticket with Breckinridge, but I will take my name off the ballot in the slave states (barring Missouri, of course). Hopefully he and Bell will reciprocate in the north.
We cannot sacrifice the prestige of the Democratic Party by making these kinds of deals.
I will take my name off the ballot in those states. We just need to make sure Lincoln doesn't win them.
No, I will not. I have a good chance of winning them and I need every vote I can get.
I will support any fusion tickets which can be organized, and I will withdraw my name from the slave state ballots. We must find a way to stop Lincoln.
Fusion tickets have been organized in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. Your name will head the ballot in New York and New Jersey.
This move seems to help Bell in the South. He has removed himself from the Midwestern ballots. Breckinridge ignores your overtures.
This certainly shakes up the race. Fusion tickets have been organized in New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania.
We just need to let you know, it appears that your opponents have consolidated into a "fusion ticket" in the states of Pennsylvania, New Jersey, and New York.
body: 1860年的fusion ticket在这些问题里，指反林肯阵营联合推出选举人名单，以减少分散选票；不是把不同总统候选人简单组成总统、副总统搭档。联合名单中的选举人可以支持不同的总统人选。
新泽西的实际结果就分给林肯四张选举人票、道格拉斯三张。各州联合安排与选票细节不同，游戏的简化呈现不能当作一套全国统一的法律程序；译文解释术语，原有票数算法完全保留。

sources.title: 马凯特大学法学院：1860年联合选票与新泽西结果
美国国家档案馆：1860年选举人票结果

notes.title: “国会选择”：总统实际由众议院选出
contains:
Abraham Lincoln runs as the Republican against his rival Stephen A. Douglas. Slavery is the dominant issue and has caused two splinter candidates to step forward -- Breckinridge and Bell -- both with Southern roots.

  • Lincoln begins with the lead, and must simply hold his Northern coalition together to take the victory.
  • The other three candidates must find some way to prevent a Lincoln victory. In that case, the House of Representatives will choose.

No candidate captured an Electoral College majority.

This leaves everyone in a bad situation. Congress will now choose from the top three candidates in the electoral vote count. You are highly unlikely to be the compromise candidate in this situation, however. It is unclear whether Congress will select Douglas or Bell, or if they will deadlock and precipitate a Constitutional crisis. If Douglas is selected, how would the South react? There are even whispers about a civil war.

Stephen Douglas, thanks to a Democratic schism, has little hope of winning the election outright. His path to victory involves throwing the election the House, and finishing in the top three in the electoral vote count. In this case, he could win or at least deny the Republicans a victory.

Douglas has been a proponent of 'popular sovereignty', but this compromise has lost its luster in North and South alike. If he is to deny Lincoln a majority, he must carry some Northern states.

No candidate captured an Electoral College majority.

Congress will now choose from the top three candidates in the electoral vote count. If you are in the top three, you have a great chance. Otherwise, Bell will be the favorite. Your supporters are already preparing a compromise amendment, offering permanent protection for slavery in the South in return for the admission of more free states. You will likely have to make such promises to prevent a deadlock in the House vote.
body: 依据宪法第十二修正案，无人获得已任命选举人票的过半数时，总统由众议院从选举人票最多的至多三名候选人中选出。每个州代表团只有一票；副总统另由参议院按规则选出。
原结局笼统说“国会选择”，应当结合这一制度理解。候选人位列前三只获得被选择的资格，并不自动获胜；仅仅阻止林肯获胜，也不一定意味着无人取得过半数。游戏的具体架空结局不等于历史上实际发生过这一轮投票。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：第十二修正案及选举人团法律条文

notes.title: 自由铸银、有限购银与金银比价
contains:
William McKinley runs as the establishment Republican while William Jennings Bryan brings a radically different agenda to the race. The bad economy and the coinage of silver dominate discussion.

  • McKinley will make the case for traditional Republican policies, including a strong defense of the gold standard.
  • Bryan will state that there can be no relief for debtors or the larger economy without inflation, which he hopes to bring about via "free silver".
Can you state your definitive position on the American monetary system?
I support a strict adherence to the gold standard, which is fundamental to American prosperity.
Limited silver coinage is a good compromise. I support a program like that of Bland-Allison where the government purchases around $2 million of silver each month.

I support the free, unlimited coinage of silver at the current market price of 30-to-1 against gold. This ratio should be frequently adjusted to match actual prices in order to avoid another run on the Treasury's gold supply.
I support the free, unlimited coinage of silver at a fixed price ratio of 16-to-1 against gold.

The Democratic idea has been that if you legislate to make the masses prosperous, their prosperity will find its way up through every class which rests upon them. We need to help our farmers and our workers by allowing the coinage of silver.

The international system we have in place is the gold standard. Not only is this highly advisable from a business standpoint, but it is driven by the power of Great Britain. We are better off working within this system.
This is something we should work for to reform the monetary supply. That being said, the United States should not unilaterally leave the gold standard until we have some agreement in place.

This would be a worthwhile arrangement for the laboring classes across the civilized world. When I'm elected, however, we will allow the free coinage of silver regardless of what agreements are or aren't in place.
This is a vigorous, straightforward defense of your views on the gold standard.
There are gold men and there are silver men. Compromise on this issue does not fit into the mood of the moment.
There are gold men and there are silver men. Compromise on this issue does not fit into the mood of the moment, especially since this represents a change in position from your silver advocacy.
This is a strong pro-silver answer, while still acknowledging the difficulties a fixed price could cause in the Treasury.
We support the free coinage of silver priced at a 16-to-1 ratio against gold. The results will aid farmers and workers of all classes and contribute to an American renewal.
body: 自由铸银要求开放白银铸币，并取消相应数量限制；不是政府免费赠送银币。金银复本位同时以两种金属为本位。按16∶1的法定比价，指按重量一份黄金相当于十六份白银；不能把这个数字改成当时市场价格。
《布兰德—艾利森法》采取有限购银与铸币，是不同于自由、无限制铸银的折中方案。游戏还提供按市场比价调整的选项，译文保留固定比价、浮动比价和有限购银之间的政策差别。

sources.title: 美国参议院：艾利森与有限铸银的立法折中
国会图书馆：1896年选举的数字史料

notes.title: 前廊竞选：候选人为何在家接待选民？
contains: Bryan's nomination has electrified the western voter, and he is now planning to campaign on the rails, six days a week. Will you break precedent as well and make a speaking tour of the nation?
Bryan's naked ambition knows no bounds. It is unbecoming of a candidate to make campaign appearances on his own behalf.

There's no way I can compete with Bryan's oratorical talents. Instead, I will receive groups of visitors at my home in Canton, Ohio. We have the financing to pay for these visits, and anyone who shows up will receive a free sandwich while I deliver a speech.
Settle into a nice, comfortable chair and wait for the telegraph results to come in. Downtown Canton is thronged with supporters who await a glimpse of you.
Today it looks like it's the Milwaukee Chamber of Commerce who have made the trip to your house. Do you have something inspiring to tell them in your speech?
Settle into your parlor and await the telegraph results. Best of luck good sir, you have fought a brave battle.
body: 麦金莱在俄亥俄州坎顿的家中接待各地代表团，发表准备好的演说；布赖恩则乘火车巡回演说。这是两种竞选组织方式的对照，不是麦金莱退出竞选。
游戏人物认为候选人亲自拉票“有失身份”，反映一种竞选礼仪观念；不能据此说此前从来没有候选人巡回竞选。免费三明治是原作的具体叙述，此处不把每个来访者都得到三明治当作已经逐项证实的史实。

sources.title: 国会图书馆：1896年总统选举及前廊演说
海斯总统图书馆与博物馆：麦金莱1896年前廊竞选

notes.title: “伟大的平民”与“普拉特河的少年演说家”
contains:
Congratulations! You have won the 1896 election.

"The Great Commoner" will soon be President of the United States! Nobody with your political views has ever sniffed the Presidency, let alone won it, and with that in mind your supporters are rioting frenziedly in the streets. The sweetest speech of all will be your victory speech tomorrow in Lincoln, Nebraska. Prepare to enact your reform agenda and most importantly the free coinage of silver.
Boos and hisses from the audience! This is what the 'Boy Orator of the Platte' came to talk about?!

The novelty of a personal visit from the "Great Commoner" could probably swing the West Coast states in your direction. However, it will take two weeks to travel and return via train.
Will you divert your attention from the Midwest long enough to visit California, Oregon, and Washington?
body: 这些是布赖恩的政治绰号。“伟大的平民”强调他作为普通民众代言人的形象；“普拉特河的少年演说家”突出年轻与口才，并联系他的内布拉斯加背景。并非说他竞选时还是未成年少年。
“普拉特河”是河名，不是柏拉图。游戏里听众发出嘘声，是在讽刺他的演说偏离支持者期待，译文保留这种挖苦。

sources.title: 内布拉斯加州历史学会：布赖恩档案与政治绰号
国会图书馆：世纪之交的美国与布赖恩的演说形象

notes.title: Wet／Dry：反禁酒派与禁酒派
contains: What is your opinion on measures that would aim to restrict the sale or production of alcohol?
I am a proud "wet" in the alcohol debate. What a man drinks is no one's business but his own.
It is my dream to see a Prohibition Amendment passed before I die.
These measures are a step in the right direction. Nothing destroys so many lives in this country as does the pernicious habit of drinking alcohol.
Perhaps if our goal is to prevent drinking on Sunday, or public drunkenness, I am all for those measures. But a blanket temperance law is a different story.
After an electoral massacre in 1890, Republicans have been trying to step back from the temperance issue. You're not helping them.
This is a little to the morally conservative side vis-a-vis most Americans.
This is a moderate answer that offends very few people.
A 'wet' is not the best reputation to have in this day and age.
Let's remind the immigrant populations that Bryan is a religious fanatic who opposes the sale of alcohol.
Croker is probably worried about my views on the temperance issue. I will assure him that a Bryan Administration will not push for Prohibition.
You may have helped yourself in New York, but a lot of other places are concerned about the temperance issue. They thought you were on board with their beliefs.
What are your thoughts on the Women's Christian Temperance Union? Is this group a positive force in American life?
The WCTU is one of the most spiritually uplifting, morally righteous groups in our society. I pray that the Lord will see fit to guide them to success in their mission.
This is a well-meaning group of honest Christian women. I am neither especially opposed to nor especially supportive of their goals.
This group is Exhibit A in the dangers of allowing women to become politically active. They are engaged in a naive quest to purify American life from an imagined evil.
The WCTU is popular in some rural areas, but not in the northern cities that you need to win this fall.
body: 禁酒政治中的wet通常指反禁酒或支持合法饮酒的一方，dry指支持禁酒的一方；不能直译成“湿的人”或“干的人”。节制饮酒、星期日限售与全面禁酒，也不是同一政策。
1896年全国禁酒宪法修正案尚未通过。游戏中希望未来通过禁酒修正案，是政治主张；实际第十八修正案在1919年获批准，全国禁酒于1920年开始。

sources.title: 国会图书馆：威尔逊档案中的禁酒争论与wet／dry称呼
国会图书馆：全国禁酒开始的时间线

notes.title: 政党分赃制与官职酬庸
contains: My administration will bring back the era of the budget surplus, and will work towards the professionalization of the federal government. We will continue to phase out the 'spoils system' in accordance with the Pendleton Act.
These are good motives, but the spoils system has been in decline for years. Most voters are more worried about finding work and regaining prosperity.

New York politics are dominated by a highly corrupt, patronage-based outfit known as Tammany Hall. Their boss, Richard Croker, has so far been indifferent to your campaign. Are you willing to make concessions to arouse his enthusiasm?
I'm sure that Croker is concerned about the patronage positions his men will receive. Patronage jobs for New York men will be plentiful in my administration.

Perhaps there is a misunderstanding. I will defend labor unions, fight against the temperance movements, and ensure adequate patronage jobs for New York Democrats. All I ask in return is that they deliver New York to the ticket.
This is somewhat effective, but the number of patronage jobs is dwindling each year and other states are worried about how many there are to go around.
body: 政党分赃制指胜选后以官职报偿党内支持者，不是战场分赃。官职酬庸是分配职位的政治关系；也不意味着所有联邦职位都可由总统任意分给私人。
1883年《彭德尔顿法》确立竞争考试等择优任用办法，但最初覆盖的职位有限，改革范围逐步扩大。因此游戏仍讨论酬庸官职，并不等于该法没有存在。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：1883年《彭德尔顿法》原件与改革范围

notes.title: 普尔曼罢工：邮件、禁令与联邦介入
contains: Grover Cleveland sent federal troops to Illinois to end the Pullman Strike without the request of Governor Altgeld. Was this an overreach on his part?

Was it an appropriate intervention of the federal government to attach U.S. mail cars to Pullman trains during the strike in 1894? (Thereby making it a federal crime to interfere with the passage of these cars)
This was the act of a tyrant. Pullman was engaged in abominable business practices, and in the darkest hour Cleveland cast his lot with the company over the working man.

Governor Altgeld was working to mediate the dispute between the Pullman Company and the strikers when Cleveland interfered. There should have absolutely been more time given for these sides to reach an accommodation.

It's not the job of government to regulate labor disputes, but the fact of the matter is that these strikers were allowing no rail traffic to pass through Chicago whatsoever. Something needed to be done.
Bargaining for wages is the business of a man and his employer. Collective bargaining has no place in American society, and I commend Grover Cleveland for having the courage to act decisively.
The entire city of Chicago and half of the Midwest was blocked to rail traffic. It was impossible for this fracas not to interrupt U.S. mail.
We should have found other methods to end this strike besides legal chicanery.
The Democrats have always been the party of states' rights. I was a little surprised to see Cleveland intervene in this case.
A good man named Eugene Debs was thrown in prison due to the overreach of President Cleveland.
The rail strikes threw most of the country into fear and panic. They were pleased when Cleveland put an end to the madness.
Is it generally appropriate for federal courts to issue injunctions against striking unions?
The use of injunctions is a favored court tactic for union busting and it must stop. I support the right of striking workers to picket their workplace while on strike.

Maybe in limited cases, where unions are a threat to public safety or where they undermine an essential industry. The courts are notoriously conservative, however, and definitely take this practice too far.

The Pullman Strike of 1894 disrupted half of the nation's rail traffic and threatened to throw our society into complete turmoil. A small group of radicals should never have the power to disrupt the lives of millions.
body: 1894年普尔曼罢工及抵制普尔曼车厢，使铁路运输和邮政受到影响。法院禁令、州长与联邦政府的冲突、德布斯因违抗禁令被追究，属于相关但不同的问题。法院禁令不是工会自己发布的命令。
原作把邮政车厢挂接安排归于联邦政府；国家公园管理局的叙述则特别记载铁路总经理协会鼓励挂接车厢，以利用邮件受阻争取干预。这里说明归责差别，保留原作问法，不据此认定当时每趟列车的安排。

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：1894年罢工、铁路协会与联邦介入

notes.title: 《谢尔曼白银购买法》：原作1894年有误
contains: Grover Cleveland led the push to repeal the Sherman Silver Purchase Act in 1894. What are your thoughts on his actions during that period?

I support the coinage of silver, and this action was a step in the wrong direction. It took money out of the system when we needed it the most, and is partly to blame for the depth of our current downturn.

Unfortunately the Treasury was bankrupt. I do think that Cleveland approached this in the usual heavy-handed, abrasive manner, but he was absolutely in the right. This whole episode demonstrates the folly of silver coinage.
We can criticize Cleveland for a lot of things, but his repeal of the Silver Purchase Act is not one of them. I supported Cleveland all the way in the repeal debate.
body: 《谢尔曼白银购买法》属于1890年的货币立法，与同年的《谢尔曼反托拉斯法》不是同一部法律。支持铸银与反对企业垄断不能因名称相近而混为一谈。
原问题把克利夫兰推动废法的年份写为1894年。参议院与众议院的官方历史均把废法争论放在1893年；正文保留原作的1894年，在旁注说明。此处所说的废法主要针对购银要求，不能简单概括为所有白银都从货币体系中消失。

sources.title: 美国参议院：科罗拉多参议员与1893年废法争论
美国众议院历史：乔治·华盛顿·默里与1893年购银争论

notes.title: 考克西“军队”：失业者进军华盛顿
contains: It's time we think about implementing a series of public works projects to occupy our excess labor force. This will improve business by placing more money in the hands of consumers.
You have aligned yourself with Coxey and his army. We'll see how that turns out.
Jacob Coxey's protests fell on deaf ears in 1894. With so many men out of work, is there any role for a public works program that would keep them occupied until business improves?
If we could be sure that the benefits would spread equally to the different states, I think a public works program could be helpful at this point.
I'm sure that Mr. Coxey is a well-intentioned citizen, but I see no constitutional authority for implementing a federal public works program.
This is absolutely the wrong solution to our business downturn. We must increase tariffs to stimulate American business.
This is absolutely the wrong solution to our business downturn. We must allow the free coinage of silver to reduce the burden of our debts.
body: 1894年，雅各布·考克西带领失业者赴华盛顿，要求通过公共工程创造工作。所谓“军队”是抗议队伍的政治称呼，不是联邦军队，也不是由将军指挥的军事单位。
游戏对公共工程是否合宪、能否促进景气提供不同回答。支持公共工程、提高关税和扩大货币供给，是不同的政策路径，译文没有合并成同一种救济政策。

sources.title: 国会图书馆：考克西军队与1894年失业者游行史料

notes.title: “干草叉”本·蒂尔曼与南方州权话语
contains:
You have alluded to the need for less prejudice between the races. Senator "Pitchfork" Ben Tillman, of South Carolina, privately seeks your clarification.
Can you reassure him that the federal government will respect the rights of the states under your Administration?
We will respect the rights of the states. I call for greater understanding, but certainly not for an overthrow of the natural order.
There has been a deafening silence for many years on the issue of equal rights in the South. It's time we had a true enforcement of the 14th and 15th Amendment.

Tillman and others have nothing to fear from me. It is the sacred duty of the white man to properly instruct and civilize the black man and other inferior races. Greater understanding must occur within this context.
You have appeased Mr. Tillman without coming across as a firebrand in the North.
Your heart is in the right place, but Southern leaders are furious. Your allies might be able to smooth this over once, but there are rumblings of support now for John Palmer.
This is what Mr. Tillman and others wanted to hear, but there are rumblings in the Midwest that you are too friendly with extremist elements in the former Confederacy.
body: 蒂尔曼的绰号与他扬言用干草叉戳克利夫兰、迫其改变经济政策的攻击性修辞有关；不是他真的带着干草叉参加游戏中的会谈。
在南方种族政治语境中，“尊重州权”和“自然秩序”可能被用来维护白人统治。原作某个选项直接宣称黑人及其他种族低等，译文保留其种族主义立场；旁注不把游戏中的可选发言当作布赖恩真实说过的引文。第十四和第十五修正案涉及平等保护、公民权及投票权，不能笼统译为一般性修宪。

sources.title: 美国参议院：本杰明·蒂尔曼生平、绰号与种族主义政治

notes.title: 爱达荷妇女选举权：同年不等于已参与当届总统投票
contains: A few western states have allowed women the right to vote. Do you take the calls for a women's suffrage Amendment seriously?
I would support such an Amendment if it gained traction within our system. I'm just sorry to see that the chances seem unlikely.
We welcome the support of women and men. Where women are granted the vote, we are confident that they will support our ticket.
I think there are more important issues for us to be focusing our efforts on. Extending the suffrage to women carries with it a whole host of dangers.
Women can vote now in Colorado, Utah, Idaho, and Wyoming. This certainly can't hurt you in those states.
body: 科罗拉多、犹他、爱达荷和怀俄明的妇女选举权，形成于不同的立法、建州与公投过程，不能都说成全国宪法修正案带来的权利。
爱达荷的妇女选举权公投，在1896年十一月投票日才获批准。原作却以“如今已能投票”的说法，把它列入竞选期间的州名单；正文保留这个表述，但不应据此推断爱达荷妇女已经参与1896年总统投票。全国第十九修正案是后来的事件。

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：西部各州妇女选举权时间线

notes.title: “蓝色法”：星期日营业与休息规定
contains: Would you support federal "Blue Laws" to protect the sanctity of Sunday?
At the very least, a federal law prohibiting the sale of alcohol of Sunday seems appropriate.
This debate has no place in our system of federalism. The individual states have every right to decide how they wish to handle the issue of commerce and drinking on Sunday.
I don't support the mandated closing of shops on Sunday.
body: 蓝色法通常指限制星期日营业、劳动或某些娱乐活动的法律，历史上与基督教的休息、礼拜观念相联系；名称不是说法律使用蓝色字体。
是否限售酒类、强制商店停业，以及应由州还是联邦立法，是游戏中的不同选项，不等于都主张全国全面禁酒。

sources.title: 国会图书馆法律博客：星期日蓝色法与营业限制

notes.title: 农村免费投递：把邮件送到住处
contains: What is your position on Rural Free Delivery of the mail, signed into law earlier this year by Grover Cleveland? Is this an acceptable strain to place on the finances of the Post Office?
It's a shame that this policy wasn't implemented decades ago. For too long, rural Americans have been forced to travel up to thirty miles to retrieve the mail they are entitled to.
We should monitor this program very carefully to determine if it can be done in a cost-effective manner.
This policy will hurt the small storeowner and serves as yet another example of wasteful government spending. We should be looking to reduce the deficit -- not to add new programs.
You can't even get your answer right on the mail issue? Farmers want free mail and they're tired of being ripped off by local storeowners.
body: 农村免费投递指居民无需专程去邮局领取邮件，开始获得上门投递服务；“免费”不是所有寄信都免邮资。
美国邮政史记载，实验性投递拨款于1893年获通过，随后追加经费，服务于1896年10月1日在西弗吉尼亚几个地点试行。原作把过程概括为克利夫兰当年签署的一部法律，旁注说明这涉及多年拨款及试验，并非1896年已覆盖全体农村居民。

sources.title: 美国邮政：农村免费投递的拨款与服务时间线

notes.title: 太平洋铁路融资法案：疑似提前引用1897年表决
contains: Are you pleased with the recent defeat in Congress of the Pacific Railroad Funding Bill, which would have provided federal support to the Southern and Central Pacific railroads.
It is my firm position that we need to nationalize the railroads of this country. Their power has stood beyond reproach for too long.

For all of their talk about small government, the Republicans are quite adept at funneling public money to the railroads. I only support that practice when there is a clear rationale, and in this case the rationale was corruption.
Without federal support including loans and land grants, there are certain railroads which would simply be too large to construct with private capital. I was disappointed by the defeat of this bill.
I was opposed to this bill. We might have provided land grants and funding for railroads in the past, but that practice will end under my Administration.
body: 国会记录中，可识别的H.R. 8189太平洋铁路融资法案，涉及既有铁路债务和联邦债权的清偿，并不只是拨款新建一条铁路。1897年1月11日，它在众议院推进至三读的表决中遭到否决。
原作在1896年竞选中提到该法案“最近遭否决”，存在明显的年代疑点。正文保留问法；此处不是声称铁路融资在1896年没有争论，也未排除原作者可能混用了其他提案。

sources.title: 美国政府出版局：1897年1月11日国会记录与H.R. 8189表决

notes.title: effluence：原作措辞不协调
contains: It's a shame that we need to even campaign in these beacons of the South. But if we have to, let us do it with effluence.
body: 原句使用with effluence。这个词通常表示流出或排放，放在鼓励南方竞选的句子里不协调。译文按上下文理解为“放开手脚去干”，没有把异常措辞当成一个美国政治术语。
无法从原文确定作者本来想写哪一个词，故不宣称它一定是eloquence等词的笔误。英文原文完整保留；本条属于翻译判断与原作疑点，不是历史事件的考证。

sources.title: 原版内置1896年布赖恩—苏厄尔剧本（用于核对措辞）

notes.title: 胶着选举与众议院按州选总统
contains:
Wow! You have won a true nail-biter.

No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Fortunately for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes for you accordingly.

The important thing is that you won. Go about implementing your agenda accordingly, and pay no attention to Democrats and agitators who call for 'compromise' and 'conciliation'.

Sorry! You have lost in a squeaker.

No candidate achieved a majority of the electoral votes, marking the first time this has happened since 1824. Unfortunately for you, the majority of U.S. states have Republican controlled congressional delegations, and they will cast their votes for William McKinley.

Given the incredibly close nature of the election, you can certainly set your sights on a political comeback in 1900, if that is what you desire.
body: nail-biter与squeaker都在这里形容结果极其接近的选举，并非咬指甲的比赛或“输给吱吱声”。胜负标题与缺少选举人票多数的叙述应结合阅读。
没有候选人得到选举人票过半数时，众议院从选举人票前三名中选总统，每州代表团一票；参议院另选副总统。游戏直接依据州代表团的党派控制预测结果，是简化叙事，而不是将普通众议员票数直接相加。1896年的州数与今日不同，不套用今日所需州票数。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：选举人票不足多数时的国会选举规则

notes.title: 进化论、社会达尔文主义与后来“猴子审判”
contains: We absolutely need a federal program for this purpose. The Bible says that we must love all people -- even those who have been cast aside by our Darwinian industrial machinery.
What are your views on the Darwinian theory of Evolution?
I agree with the concept of 'survival of the fittest'. It is the destiny of the strong to expand at the expense of the weak.
I have no comment to make on Darwinism. This is completely irrelevant to my expected duties as President of the United States.
I'm not convinced of the veracity of this theory. It contravenes accepted Christian teaching in a large number of ways.

Evolution teaches disregard for the security and dignity of our fellow man. Left unchecked this 'survival of the fittest' mentality will eventually cause indifference to life itself, from which only calamity can ensue.
This is a bad response politically. Social Darwinism is still a minority view, held mainly among the Ivy League upper-crust. You shouldn't imply that you agree with such views.
This is nothing less than a betrayal of your own essence. You are a Creationist and you always will be.
body: 生物进化论、把竞争与弱肉强食套用到社会的社会达尔文主义，以及基于宗教的创造论，并不是同一个概念。原作有意让不同选项在这些问题上表态，译文保留这种区别。
布赖恩与1925年斯科普斯审判的关联很有名；史密森尼档案保存了达罗盘问他的照片。但1925年不能当成1896年已经发生的事件。游戏把他后来的政治宗教形象带入较早的竞选，所提供的具体回答也不能自动视为当年真实演说原话。

sources.title: 史密森尼档案：1925年7月20日斯科普斯审判照片与人物
内布拉斯加州历史学会：布赖恩档案中的《达尔文主义的威胁》等著作

notes.title: 推翻夏威夷君主制与美国吞并是两件事
contains: Let's discuss world affairs. I support the annexation of Hawaii and I support the independence of Cuba. I support a stronger Navy.
The Navy is more than adequate to meet our current needs, and will remain so as long as imperialist Republicans avoid intervening in Cuba or Hawaii.
What is your opinion on the overthrow of the Hawaiian monarchy by the Dole group? Do you support the annexation of Hawaii into the United States?

These men are Americans and they are attempting to bring badly-needed order to the islands of Hawaii. If managed properly, an annexation will allow us to enjoy the benefits of Hawaii's innumerable sugar plantations. These islands are also a perfect location for a naval base.
This cabal may be hoping for recognition from the United States, but for now they are simply a group of Pacific island adventurers. I have no wishes for either their success or their failure.
We will never recognize or annex the so-called Hawaiian government while I am President.
body: 夏威夷君主制于1893年被推翻；美国于1898年吞并夏威夷。1896年讨论是否吞并，不是在讨论一个已经成为美国州的地方。多尔指政治人物桑福德·多尔，也不是水果本身。
“带去秩序”“种植园收益”等是游戏人物的立场性说法，不能当作夏威夷人民一致同意的结论。伊奥拉尼宫资料保留了莉莉乌奥卡拉尼女王反对吞并的抗议；1898年总统咨文则记录了美国接收主权的程序，二者反映不同当事方。

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：伊奥拉尼宫与夏威夷反对吞并的历史资料
美国国务院历史文献：1898年总统咨文中的夏威夷接收程序

notes.title: “带连字符的美国人”：族裔身份与忠诚争论
contains: Do you believe that certain groups in the United States, for their own narrow interests, are trying to undermine American diplomacy and the global order?
Are you willing to meet with German-American and Irish-American political leaders to discuss your beliefs, regardless of your feelings towards their organizations?
I can think of no better way to reinforce my commitment to peace and neutrality than to meet with such groups.
During my career, I have met with any number of individuals whom I have disagreed with. I don't see a need to apply a different standard to this situation.
I refuse to meet with any hyphenated-American group which places another identity above that of American.
I do, and I would especially single out German-Americans in this regard, for their support of an expansionist German state.
I do, and I would especially single out Irish-Americans in this regard, for their strenuous opposition to Great Britain.
I'm concerned about any citizen who would embrace the presence of a hyphen in their American identity.
The Democratic Party still wins a lot of its support from immigrants, leaving aside the current environment of full-on Americanism.
There are some attacks about this meeting, but it could also help keep German-Americans in the fold.
Red-blooded Americans cheer your strong stance on this position.
Jingoists and so on favor this stance, but there is a significant German bloc of Republicans who you should still be worried about.
Red-blooded Americans cheer your baiting of the Irish in this incident.
body: 英文中的族裔称呼常用连字符连接，例如German-American。“带连字符的美国人”在战争时期的争论中，被用来质疑移民及其后裔的忠诚，并不是一个法律上的国籍类别。
国会图书馆保存的1916年讽刺画，直接讽刺以这种称呼攻击不投票支持威尔逊的人。游戏里的“美国人身份优先”和“铁血爱国”带有当时民族主义、排外争论的色彩；不能把德裔或爱尔兰裔整体描述成已经被证实的不忠者。

sources.title: 国会图书馆：1916年关于威尔逊与hyphen的政治讽刺画

notes.title: 1916年税法与“超额利润税”的时间差
contains: Will you sign the Revenue Act of 1916, which would increase the income tax and establish a Tariff Commission?

I will sign this reluctantly. I support the income tax increase on higher incomes, but not the introduction of a tariff commission. Such a commission will invariably be too friendly to big business in its recommendations.
I'm proud to sign this into law. I think the broad majority of Americans can stand behind its provisions.
I will veto this Act. I support a federal income tax, but not to the level that this bill imposes. It also introduces an estate tax and an excess profits tax.
Agrarian radicals agree with your stance on the tariff commission, but moderates in the business community do not.
The Democratic Party is pretty-well united in support of this law.
The larger part of your supporters are resolutely in favor of a higher income tax, and are surprised by your unexpected veto.
body: 原作把1916年收入法中的遗产税与“超额利润税”并列，正文保留这一说法。美国税务局1918年的报告则区分：1916年对军火制造净所得征税，第一项一般性的超额利润税来自1917年3月3日的法律。
因此，不宜把1916年的军火制造税与后来的一般超额利润税混为一谈。这里是原作的年代／分类问题，并非允许汉化调整税率、选项效果或事件时间。

sources.title: 美国税务局：1918年局长报告中的1916及1917税法沿革

notes.title: 移民识字测试：不是只准考英语
contains: Would you support a law requiring new immigrants to pass a literacy test in English?
I would object to any immigration act which included a literacy test.
I don't have strong feelings on this provision. If such a measure were passed by Congress I would sign it.
I believe that any immigrant who seeks a new life in the United States should be required to pass a literacy test.
This isn't a subject that I plan to address on the campaign trail.
I do, and I would especially single out German-Americans in this regard, for their support of an expansionist German state.
body: 原问题将拟议的移民测试写成英语识字测试，正文保留原文。1917年实际生效的识字条款允许用某种语言或方言阅读，并有若干豁免，并非一律要求读英语。
国务院保存的1917年劳工部长函件明确讨论这项测试及配偶豁免。游戏发生在1916年竞选期间，支持或反对拟议法案，与已经实施后的法律规定需要分开理解。

sources.title: 美国国务院：1917年6月27日关于识字测试及豁免的函件

notes.title: 《基廷—欧文法》：州际贸易限制与后来的判决
contains: How much do you plan to push back against Southern obstructionism on a federal child labor law?
I want to campaign this fall on the passage of a child labor law. I will personally appeal to any recalcitrant Senators, to consider the electoral success of Democrats this fall.
I would certainly sign this into law, but not if that means railroading a bill through Congress against the wishes of its elected members.
The Keating-Owen Act has passed and provides federal protections against the use of child labor.
There are some whispers that you have caved to the Southern wing of the party and done little to advance a child labor law.
What are your opinions on child labor legislation, as exemplified by the recent Keating-Owens child labor bill?
Republicans have stood behind such legislation all along. It would have become law years ago without the obstruction of Southern Democrats.
I oppose child labor and believe the states should pass laws against the practice, as New York did while I was Governor. But it is not a matter for the federal government to interfere in.
This recent act is not something that I plan to address very much as I campaign.
This bill is broadly acceptable to progressives, and there are whispers that your campaign is rather more conservative than expected.
body: 1916年的《基廷—欧文法》借联邦监管州际贸易的权限，限制使用某些童工的工厂、矿场等产品流通；不是联邦已经永久、全面禁止所有未成年人工作的法律。
最高法院在1918年的哈默诉达根哈特案中判该法违宪。游戏的1916年人物讨论支持、州权或联邦权限时，尚不能把这个后来的判决当成已经发生。原问题的Keating-Owens拼写对应通常所称的Keating-Owen Act。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：1916年法案原件、限制范围与1918年判决

notes.title: 布兰代斯提名：进步主义与犹太身份争论
contains: As 1916 begins, you have a vacancy to fill on the Supreme Court. Advisors are recommending Louis Brandeis -- a choice that is sure to be controversial. What are your thoughts?
I'm prepared to stand behind Louis Brandeis as a Court nominee. He has devoted his life to fighting for the common man against the business trusts of this nation.
Brandeis's ability is not in question, but he is too radical to be considered for a Court opening. I'd also rather not have the Jewish issue come up during this campaign.
The nomination battle was contentious, but progressives across the country have noticed your commitment.
Do you have any plans to attack the nomination of Louis Brandeis to the Supreme Court?
I believe the appointment of Louis Brandeis to the Court shows exceptionally poor, and dangerous, judgment on the part of Woodrow Wilson.
One hardly has to be an arch-conservative to be concerned about the elevation of Brandeis to the Supreme Court.
body: 威尔逊1916年提名布兰代斯，引发强烈争议和长时间公开听证。他成为最高法院第一位犹太裔大法官，进步主义立场和职业经历也卷入提名争论。
原作选项提到“犹太人问题”，保留了当时带有偏见的政治措辞；旁注不认同这种偏见，也不把游戏中每一句可选的反对发言都当作休斯的真实引语。

sources.title: 美国参议院：司法提名史中的1916年布兰代斯听证
美国参议院：布兰代斯获确认的历史

notes.title: 1916年的《琼斯法》：菲律宾自治与独立承诺
contains: Do you plan to support the Jones Act -- granting greater autonomy to the Philippines along with a plan to grant independence.
I would prefer that the measure grant immediate independence, but I can support it in its current form.
This is a necessary step forward in the self-determination of the Philippines.
This measure is premature at the present time. We have added greatly to the welfare of the Philippines and should not leave before our work is done.
Immediate independence is a little unsettling to some, but it shouldn't make too much of a difference.
There is still a large anti-war, anti-imperialist group within the Democratic Party, and they view this stance as a betrayal.
Immediate independence of the Philippines is not the popular position for Republicans.
body: 此处指1916年菲律宾自治立法，扩大民选政府并表达未来独立的方向；不是1920年美国沿海航运中也俗称《琼斯法》的法律。
更大的自治权、立即独立和以后独立是不同政策。菲律宾实际于1946年独立，不能把游戏中“立即独立”的可选主张当成1916年已完成的历史事实。

sources.title: 美国众议院：菲律宾相关立法与1916年自治法
美国国务院：美菲战争及自治、独立的后续时间线

notes.title: 潘兴远征：抓捕比利亚与墨西哥主权
contains: The forces of Pancho Villa have killed over 30 Americans in separate incidents, and even launched a raid into New Mexico. How will you respond to this, as President?
We will dispatch a military expedition to Mexico, with clear orders to continue their pursuit regardless of any interference that may arise from the nation's Carranza government.
I will dispatch a military expedition into Mexico to apprehend Pancho Villa. The expedition will operate in any area where the Carranza government does not have control.
We need to mobilize the National Guard and increase our military presence on the southern border, in order to prevent future attacks.
The Pershing Expedition makes its way into Mexico as the campaign at home progresses.
The public is clamoring for more vigorous action after the death of several Americans at the hands of Pancho Villa.
What do you make of Woodrow Wilson's response to the raids and outrages of Pancho Villa?
Mexico has been in turmoil for years, and anyone with foresight could have anticipated the problems that have arisen from our undefended border. Wilson did not.
Every good American should support our current expedition into Mexico, to apprehend the villainous Pancho Villa.
Rather than directly imposing ourselves on Mexican territory, we should be seeking other ways to assist the rightful government in securing that country.
In spite of anti-war sentiment elsewhere, most voters are deeply upset by the death of Americans at the hand of Pancho Villa.
body: 潘乔·比利亚的部队1916年袭击新墨西哥州哥伦布镇后，美国派潘兴率军进入墨西哥追捕。比利亚并不等于卡兰萨政府，美军与该政府之间也有主权和军事行动的冲突。
远征最终未能抓到比利亚。游戏中限制行动区域、增强边境防卫、支持墨西哥合法政府与全面深入追捕，是不同的选项，译文保留这些差别。

sources.title: 美国国家公园管理局：哥伦布镇、卡兰萨与远征
国会图书馆：袭击之后的美墨关系

notes.title: 复活节起义：爱尔兰问题与美国竞选
contains: Do you have any statements to make about the Easter Rebellion which transpired earlier this year in Ireland?
We should be calling on Great Britain to treat the perpetrators of this uprising with leniency, and to consider the relationship it has with Ireland.
This isn't an issue that our campaign plans to address. It would be unwise to antagonize Great Britain at this crucial juncture.
The Irish uprising is a domestic issue of Great Britain and should not be the concern of any patriotic American.
Irish voters notice your unexpected strong support of their position -- as do others.
The Democratic machines, already skeptical of you, find no reassurance in your silence on the Irish question.
Observers are surprised at your sudden, warm feelings for the Irish.
Red-blooded Americans cheer your baiting of the Irish in this incident.
body: 1916年4月24日至29日，爱尔兰独立派在都柏林发动起义，随后面临拘押、军事审判及处决。它不是宗教节庆活动引发的小规模纠纷。
美国竞选涉及爱尔兰裔选民、对英关系以及是否应呼吁宽大处理。支持起义者、避免得罪英国与将它视为英国内政，是原作不同的政治立场。

sources.title: 国会图书馆：复活节起义的同期报刊研究指南
英国国家档案馆：起义、军事审判及减刑档案

notes.title: 休斯与约翰逊：“怠慢”传闻不等于唯一败因
contains: California, an important state this fall, is in the midst of a divisive split between Progressives and traditional Republicans. What are your own plans for visiting that state?
We will plan our own visit to that state, and call upon the Governor and his opponents equally, to avoid giving offense.
It's best not to wade into the middle of a controversy -- we should not make any large trip to California during this campaign.
The Governor of California can barely be called a Republican. We will coordinate our itinerary with the established party apparatus on our visit.
Your trip to California went as well as could be expected.
There is some gossip from California that the popular Governor, Hiram Johnson, feels deeply snubbed by your recent visit, and he hasn't been shy about expressing that opinion.
body: 原作以州长海勒姆·约翰逊是否感到遭到怠慢，表现加利福尼亚共和党传统派与进步派之间的裂痕。同期报刊中确有“怠慢”说法及否认它的辩解，不能把这个争议压缩成已经证实的一句因果结论。
加利福尼亚最终投给威尔逊，其13张选举人票对结果很重要。但“若见了一面就必定胜选”是反事实推断，并非票数档案能够证明的事实。

sources.title: 俄勒冈大学同期报刊档案：1916年11月11日关于怠慢说的争论
美国国家档案馆：1916年各州选举人票结果

notes.title: 休斯离开最高法院：失去席位并非终身无法返回
contains:
Congratulations! You have won the 1916 election.

After the tumultuous 1912, the natural supremacy of the Republican Party has reasserted itself. The next steps are up to you -- perhaps you can lead the repeal of the Adamson Act, or replace it with something more measured and comprehensive. In regards to Europe, best of luck in whatever may occur over the next four years. Finally, Wilson plans to resign before your March 4th inauguration, so that you might assume the office now.

Sorry, you have lost the 1916 election.

Ultimately, the popularity of Woodrow Wilson was just a little much to overcome.

It appears that Wilson's agenda will remain in effect domestically. In world affairs, it remains to be seen how the situation in Europe will finally resolve itself. As to your own prospects, it is unclear what your next steps will be. The Supreme Court seat you once enjoyed has now been lost for the foreseeable future.
I have a substantial record of reform and progressivism as Governor of New York, and as a Supreme Court Justice. I won't hesitate to say so as I campaign.
body: 休斯在1916年离开最高法院参加总统竞选，落选后没有自动恢复原来的大法官席位。原作结局讨论这次选择的代价。
他后来出任国务卿，又于1930年出任首席大法官。因此“这次失去席位”不能被理解为他此后从未重返最高法院。游戏的胜选叙事和替代搭档情节，属于模拟结果。

sources.title: 美国国务院：查尔斯·埃文斯·休斯的任职经历

notes.title: 伯克特人名：原作的Haskett与档案不符
contains: What motivated you to support the candidacy of Elmer Haskett for Vice President, as strongly as you did?
I believe that Burkett appeals to the voters of the West, and will help us win those states back to the Republican fold.
body: 这一搭档分支的原问题称Elmer Haskett，后续选项称Burkett。美国众议院人物档案记载的内布拉斯加州前参议员，是埃尔默·雅各布·伯克特（Elmer Jacob Burkett）。正文保留原问题的哈斯克特写法，在此说明原作人名不一致。
这不表示游戏新增了另一位副总统候选人。1916年实际共和党搭档是费尔班克斯，伯克特分支是可选的模拟组合。

sources.title: 美国众议院：埃尔默·雅各布·伯克特人物档案
美国国家档案馆：1916年总统与副总统选举结果

notes.title: 威尔逊提前交权：不是胜选者自动继任
contains:
Sorry, you have lost the 1916 election.

Maybe 1912 was just an anomaly, brought about by Roosevelt's grandstanding. It has been over 20 years since the Democrats defeated a united Republican Party, and that advantage shows no sign of abating.

On the domestic front, let's hope that your achievements survive. Internationally, no one can say what might happen next. In a novel move, you have offered to do your part by resigning immediately, rather than waiting until March 4th.

Congratulations! You have won the 1916 election.

After the tumultuous 1912, the natural supremacy of the Republican Party has reasserted itself. The next steps are up to you -- perhaps you can lead the repeal of the Adamson Act, or replace it with something more measured and comprehensive. In regards to Europe, best of luck in whatever may occur over the next four years. Finally, Wilson plans to resign before your March 4th inauguration, so that you might assume the office now.
body: 国务卿罗伯特·兰辛在回忆录中记述：威尔逊考虑过，如果休斯胜选，就先任命休斯为国务卿，再由总统和副总统马歇尔辞职，借当时的继任安排提前交权。这是一项未实施的预案。
正文简略说“辞职，让你马上就职”，不应理解为总统一辞职，尚未就任的胜选者便自动接任。替代搭档分支也不能据此认定所有人物都会接受这套安排。

sources.title: 罗伯特·兰辛《战争回忆录》：1916年竞选章，第165—166页（公开转录）

notes.title: “他让我们置身战争之外”：1916年的竞选口号
contains: My speech fill focus on our success in avoiding the war in Europe, along with a promise that we will continue to take every effort to avoid provocation in that theatre.
