美国国家档案馆：1964年各候选人结果

notes.title: 六日战争与以土地换和平
contains: What is your stance on the Six-Day War that occurred last year, and how should Israel handle the new territories it has taken possession of?
Israel has every right to these territories they now occupy. They were attacked from all sides by an enemy bent on their destruction.
As President, I'm confident that all sides can come together and negotiate a long-term peace agreement. Certainly the return of the Sinai or the Golan Heights should not be off the table.
I fully support Israel's right to defend herself. However, I believe that these territories should be returned to the Arab states as a first step towards peace negotiations.

This business in Israel is no business of America. I wish them the best, but we should not be obtrusively inserting ourselves into these multilateral peace negotiations. Doing so will only serve to entangle us in the long run.
Observers believe that Israel launched a surprise attack first and question your logic. You’ve also gone against Johnson and the State Department on this issue.
This is a good, broad answer that doesn’t alienate anyone.
This is a surprising anti-Israel answer coming from you, that hurts you marginally.
You contradict your previous statements and earn the ire of American Jews.
body: 1967年6月以色列击败埃及、约旦和叙利亚，占领西奈半岛、加沙、约旦河西岸、东耶路撒冷和戈兰高地。战前有封锁蒂朗海峡、撤出联合国部队及军事集结等危机；不能只凭选项“四面受敌”就认定战争的开火顺序。
约翰逊政府寻求撤军与和平安排相结合。联合国安理会第242号决议将撤军与承认各国主权、和平安全相联系，各方对措辞有不同解释。无条件先归还、先获得和平保证、主张继续占领和美国不介入，是四种不同立场，译文没有抹平它们。

sources.title: 美国国务院：1967年战争、危机及第242号决议

notes.title: 哥伦比亚大学：越战、国防研究与社区争议
contains: How would you prevent campus incidents like the takeover of Columbia University that occurred this past spring?

How these students have not been expelled is beyond me. If Administrators want to be complicit in the degradation of a private university, that is their own business. However, I won't spend a dime of federal money on a school that coddles radical agitators.
I will crack down on dope-smoking, homosexuality, LSD binging, illegal protesting, and flag-burning. These practices are the tools of left-wingers and Communists who wish to undermine our society.

There are some legitimate complaints behind these abhorrent actions. I will work for peace in Vietnam and civil rights in the United States. In the meantime, I support the rights of university administrators as they combat this problem.
Tough words, Hubert. Radical student organizations disavow you, but working-class and suburban Americans are appreciative towards your law and order stance.
Nice rant, but it’s quite extreme and has horrified Democrats.
This is a tad sympathetic to the protestors, but it gets the job done. But moderates, focused on the chaos, are bothered by your acknowledgment of student complaints.
body: 1968年春的校园占领不只是抽象的学生不满。抗议涉及学校与国防分析研究所的关系，以及晨边公园体育馆项目对哈莱姆社区的影响；建筑入口安排引发种族不平等的批评。
学生占领校园建筑后，校方请求警察清场，出现逮捕与伤害。候选人关于煽动者、共产主义或校方纵容的台词是其政治判断，不是将所有抗议者定为同一种人。原选项中的同性恋、吸毒和焚旗指控保留，不增添译者的道德判决。

sources.title: 哥伦比亚大学档案展：体育馆建设与社区抗议
哥伦比亚大学：1968年抗议的多重背景

notes.title: 漫长炎热的夏季：1967年城市骚乱
contains:
Wow! You have won the 1968 election in a shocker!

Dixie forever! Even with the Long Hot Summer of 1967, nobody guessed that you could do well enough in the Northern states to win the election outright. You have instantly become most polarizing President-elect since Abraham Lincoln.
Do we need more spending in the War on Poverty, especially in light of the riots since 1965?

This increase in crime we see is the natural consequence of integration. I will not allow the black community in this country to get fancified notions of what they can get away with when I'm President.
We need to improve our policing practices, prevent riots and disorder, and also address the underlying economic causes that spread dissatisfaction with the status quo.
There is a cynicism in our poorest neighborhoods engendered by poverty and by the brutality of the police. I will vigorously address both of these issues when I'm elected.

The Black Panthers are a radical group of militants who are plotting the overthrow of the United States government. It is my firm position, in accordance with the Constitution, that anyone planning treason against our country should be imprisoned and possibly executed.

I support a fair shake for every American. I support programs that help black businesses. I support desegregation. I oppose groups like the Black Panthers that have contributed to the rioting and chaos that has swept the nation these past three years.

Our goal is a society that works for everyone. The Black Panthers have instigated some ugly incidents, and I believe on the balance that they have done more harm than good for the cause of integration.
My primary focus is to return law and order to this country. The riots, the murders, the drug use, and the protests we've seen since 1965 are unacceptable.
If elected, what will you do to get the student and Negro riots in this country under control?

There has been a total abdication of responsibility in this country over the past five years. The riots in Detroit and Newark are simply the final straw in what we can accept. I will crack down severely on disorder and nominate judges who will overturn atrocious decisions such as Miranda v. Arizona.
Law and order is the primary theme of my campaign. We also need to encourage investment in the ghettoes to ensure a high quality of life and prevent these occurrences.

Our first priority is always to have strong law enforcement. We also need more spending on education, more integration in our schools, and more programs to ensure that blacks can advance in our society after the stain of segregation.
If we had peace in Vietnam and more investment in education here at home, we wouldn't be having these riots.
The majority of white voters do not place police brutality as the cause of the long, hot summer. In terms of tradeoff, youth and black voters will turn out heavily for this fall.
Do you believe that the black community in most cities overreacted to the assassination of Martin Luther King this past April?
The reaction that occurred should terrify any thinking American. Entire neighborhoods were burned and pillaged. They even looted their own storekeepers in many cities.

That was a very tough event for many of us to take, no matter what our backgrounds were. I believe that more precautions should have been taken to keep things from getting out of hand, but we must also remember that most Negroes wanted no part of these riots.

I believe that both the black community and the police overreacted in many areas. First and foremost, we must speak out against violence wherever it may occur -- and against whoever is the source of it.
body: 这里的漫长炎热夏季指1967年的城市骚乱，纽瓦克和底特律尤其突出。1968年金博士遇刺后又发生了另一波骚乱，二者不能混成同一事件。
克纳委员会调查关注种族歧视、贫困、居住隔离和警民关系等因素。选项把骚乱归因于融合、黑豹党或法院判决，是候选人的论证，不能作为委员会的结论；也不应把所有黑人或所有抗议者当作参与暴力的人。金的非暴力运动、黑人激进组织及各地骚乱分别理解。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：众议院调查所述1967年骚乱、克纳委员会与金的反战立场
美国住房与城市发展部保存：克纳委员会报告原件

notes.title: 沃伦法院：律师权、讯问权与婚姻自由
contains: Earl Warren is without a doubt the worst Supreme Court justice in the history of the United States. From Brown v. Board of Education up through the present day, he has been nothing but an agent of tyranny for the federal government.

On the balance I would not appoint another justice like Mr. Warren. Desegregating our schools was one thing, but he has gone off the deep end on these issues like school prayer, Miranda rights, and other activist decisions.
It would be better in some cases if we could get Congress to make these decisions, but I do support the stances Mr. Warren has taken on the Court.

The Warren Court is the first Supreme Court in history which has had the guts to use constitutional law for the benefit of the common citizen. I will continue to appoint sound judges like Mr. Warren, Abe Fortas, and Thurgood Marshall.
Did the Supreme Court overstep its bounds in Loving v. Virginia by declaring state miscegenation statutes unconstitutional?
My God, someone has to step in and protect good order in this society. This is just another instance of federal judges taking control over an issue that's simply none of their business.

I'm not going to comment on a decision like this one. I certainly don't support miscegenation laws by any means, but I also think the Court has to be careful about overstepping the rights of the states.
I fully support the Supreme Court in this decision. I don't know how someone in 1968 can stand up and fight against two peoples' right to marry each other.
Has the current Supreme Court contributed to our disorder with decisions such as Gideon v. Wainright and Miranda v. Arizona?

Over the past five years we've sent a message to criminals that their rights are more important than the rights of law-abiding Americans. I don't know how anyone was surprised at the rioting and social chaos that we've seen since then.
My priority as President will be to fight for law and order in this country. The Court had good intentions but I am concerned that they overstepped their bounds in these cases.
Due process for defendants is a Constitutional right. I'm confident that we will find a way to enforce the law in this country without devolving into a police state.

There has been a total abdication of responsibility in this country over the past five years. The riots in Detroit and Newark are simply the final straw in what we can accept. I will crack down severely on disorder and nominate judges who will overturn atrocious decisions such as Miranda v. Arizona.
Federal tyranny? And what were you saying about Brown v. Board of Education?
The Warren Court is unpopular overall, but this clashes with many liberal supporters who have a positive view of the Court.
This is a weak answer to liberals, but appeals strongly to moderates.
Blacks and liberals are thrilled, but moderates dislike your approval and promise to continue the policies of the Warren Court.
What? The voters that you need detest making interracial marriage illegal.
Making the subject about states rights is possibly the worst way to oppose it as a Democrat.
Probably the best answer. The nation doesn't like interracial marriage, but doesn’t want laws pertaining to its legality.
body: 吉迪恩案1963年确立贫困重罪被告获得指定律师的保障；米兰达案1966年涉及羁押讯问时的权利告知与程序保障，不是法院一概禁止执法。原文把Wainwright误拼为Wainright，中文采用通行案名。
洛文案1967年裁定弗吉尼亚州禁止跨种族婚姻的法律违宪。它涉及平等保护与正当程序，不能译成一般的通婚习俗争论。司法能动主义是对法院积极运用司法审查的称呼；选项批评其越权，保留批评语气，但不替候选人证明判决造成犯罪。

sources.title: 美国联邦法院：吉迪恩案事实与判决
美国联邦法院：米兰达案事实与判决
国家档案馆：洛文夫妇与跨种族婚姻案

notes.title: 尼克松1957年的角色：副总统与参议员不同
contains: We have achieved great strides on this issue in the past twenty years -- and let the record show that I shepherd the Civil Rights Act of 1957 through the Senate and have supported Civil Rights bills during my time in the House and Senate. We still have a long way to go, however, before we can truly realize the dream of Martin Luther King.

We have achieved great strides on this issue in the past twenty years -- and let the record show that Hubert H. Humphrey was at the forefront of this movement as early as 1948. We still have a long way to go, however, before we can truly realize the dream of Martin Luther King.
body: 尼克松1950至1953年担任参议员，1953至1961年担任副总统，依法兼任参议院议长；1957年已经不是参议员。原选项的“推动在参议院过关”应与其副总统职务区分，不能据此把他写成1957年的参议员或多数党领袖。
约翰逊当时作为多数党领袖，也在法案通过中发挥重要作用。汉弗莱另一个选项提到1948年民权运动，是不同人物的政治经历，不应把两人的自我表功合并成同一条传记。

sources.title: 美国参议院：曾任副总统的参议员及任职年代
美国参议院：约翰逊与1957年民权法

notes.title: 1965年移民改革：取消歧视性来源配额
contains: What is your opinion of the Immigration and Nationality Act of 1965? Is it a good idea to liberalize our immigration policy and to outlaw national origin quotas?
The Negro problem apparently wasn't enough for our federal bureaucrats, because they decided to add Mexicans and Orientals to the list as well. I oppose new immigration to this country.

We need to be vigilant on the amount of immigration that we allow, but I also agree that we shouldn't restrict the practice based on national origin. In a Cold War world, we need to be mindful of international perceptions.
This is a fair and sensible policy that will allow skilled immigrants to enter the United States. It's ludicrous to state that this will somehow compromise our culture and our values.

Our former immigration policy was a national embarrassment. This country was built by immigrants and my only complaint right now is that the overall number of visas is still far too low for our needs.
body: 1965年改革废除旧的国籍来源配额体系，改以家庭联系、技能等因素安排优先次序。取消旧配额不等于取消一切人数限制，更不等于任何人都可以无条件入境。
原选项使用Negro、Orientals等当时的族群称呼，并带有明确的排外语气。中文保留其针对黑人、墨西哥人和东方人的指责，不把它改写成中性的技术移民政策，也不把这种台词视为译者观点。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：1965年移民改革背景

notes.title: 平权行动不等于强制雇用不合格者
contains: I strongly support what we have done to end the insidious practice of segregation in the South. However I'm also alarmed at some of the ideas I've heard about forced integration of neighborhoods, or the proposed busing of students to distant schools.

We need to be very aggressive in fighting racism and its effects where they exist. I support programs such as busing, affirmative action, the new HUD department, and anything else that is necessary to integrate all regions of the United States.
What do you think of programs that require schools to use busing to achieve racial balance?

Busing is nothing but another conspiracy to mongrelize the races of this country. First it was the Brown decision. Now it's some policy that some academic came up with to send children to school thirty miles from their house as part of some social engineering scheme.

I stand opposed to the legal segregation of our schools. Legal segregation promotes inferior education. I also think that busing promotes inferior education. My goal is to see every child in this country get a good education.

I do agree with the idea that education is a local matter. I'm not especially opposed to busing where local authorities deem it necessary, but I would only use the federal government in extraordinary circumstances.
What good is a Court decision banning segregation if we don't actually do something to integrate our schools? People oppose busing because they oppose school integration, pure and simple.
Have you given any thought to programs that would set racial quotas for job hiring or college admissions, in order to accelerate the process of integration?
You're dang right I've given some thought to this. We have laws in the books right now that require federal contractors to hire unqualified candidates, and we need to repeal them immediately.

We promise an equal opportunity to every person to succeed in America. I oppose discrimination in federal hiring and so on, but we also need to ask ourselves if a quota system is really the best way to monitor this issue.

We absolutely need laws prohibiting discrimination, and we need to go the extra mile in ensuring equal opportunity for women and minorities. Kennedy and Johnson's executive orders relating to federal hiring do just that.
What we have now is a good start, but we need to be taking more affirmative action to fight against the effects of racial injustice in this country.
Negroes take offense to your response, viewing it as parroting Nixon and worse, Wallace. Even right-wing whites admit that you echo Wallace.
White voters are content, but blacks demand more from the Democrats, due to the poverty in their urban communities.
You defend the administration’s actions, which reassures African-Americans but frustrates white Americans who believe such measures to be excessive.
Very liberal of you. You’ve won the absolute loyalty of the Negro community, and also lost many white voters. But you’ve exchanged them equally, so polls haven’t moved.
body: 1965年第11246号行政命令的原始文本要求联邦承包商反歧视并采取积极措施，促进平等就业机会。原选项声称法律要求雇用不合格者，是反对者的说法，不能当作行政命令的原文规定。
招聘中的平权行动、配额、学校种族融合的跨区校车接送，是有关联但不同的制度。校车接送在这里是改变学校种族构成的措施，不是所有学生日常乘校车。命令1965年原始版本与后来增列性别歧视的修订，也应区分。

sources.title: 美国平等就业机会委员会：第11246号行政命令原始文本

notes.title: 启蒙计划：学前教育与减贫
contains: Can you comment on the newly created Head Start program?
The Head Start program is another product of the out-of-touch, intellectual elite. It's a waste of money.
We need to do anything we can to ensure quality education for our youngsters. Let's see how this program develops and whether it seems to work or not.
Programs like Head Start are the only way that we will end poverty in our cities and rural districts. I fought for this program from the beginning and I will support it as President.
body: 启蒙计划是伟大社会减贫议程中的儿童发展项目，1965年从八周示范项目起步，结合学前教育、健康与家庭支持。它不是小学课程的另一个名称，也不是大学提前录取。
选项“唯一办法”“知识精英浪费钱”分别是支持与反对的竞选修辞，不能当作经评估证明的唯一政策答案。

sources.title: HeadStart.gov：项目历史

notes.title: 环保署尚未成立：1968年的政策提议
contains: Some have proposed implementing an Environmental Protection Agency at the federal level to combat industrial pollution. Would you support this as President?
This is one of the most dangerous ideas I can think of. A federal agency to combat pollution will hurt business, increase unemployment, and undermine the wages of our workers.
I believe that existing government agencies can handle the issues we have. It does upset any decent American to see rivers filled with black sludge and industrial waste.
This is something I whole-heartedly support. We have rivers that are unusable to humans, acid rain falling from the skies, and smog so thick in some cities that people can barely see.
What is your position on expanding the Clean Air Act of 1963? Do you believe that stricter enforcement against pollutants is necessary, or does the current law suffice?
This is another case of pointy-headed intellectualism that will regulate our factories right out of business and kill the jobs of the working man.
We need to find a balance between protecting the environment and protecting our economy. I support this Act but we also need to enforce it in a practical manner.
I dream of a country where every citizen has clean air to breathe. The Clean Air Act is a good start but I'm not opposed to further legislation in this area.
You’ve shifted the conversation to regulations and the economy, but Americans across the political spectrum are concerned about the environment.
The Democratic base wants something more assertive on the environment.
Good move. Promising further regulation to protect the environment pleases the base.
This gives the impression that you don’t really care about the environment at all.
Unions and working-class voters adore your answer, but liberal environmentalists see it as toothless.
This is a decent, liberal answer except that it leaves you open for attacks: conservatives accuse you of being a tree hugging hippie.
body: 环境保护署1970年才正式成立。1968年问题问的是是否支持建立这个联邦机构，不能写成扩建已存在的环保署。1963年《清洁空气法》与1970年强化后的法律，也不能混为同一个版本。
反对者把环保监管与失业联系起来，支持者强调污染危害，温和选项强调执行与经济的平衡；译文分别保留。抱树嬉皮士是嘲笑环保人士的政治标签，不是说人物真的正在抱树。

sources.title: 美国环保署：机构起源与成立
美国环保署：清洁空气法的演变

notes.title: 1968年的黄金危机：不同于19世纪金币本位
contains: How can anyone be satisfied with the course our nation has taken? Inflation is killing the value of the dollar and the gold standard itself is at risk. Unemployment is highest under the Johnson Administration among the very people he claims to care about the most.
Our current economic path is not sustainable. We need to continue the growth we have seen but we cannot allow this inflation we have to continue.

The unemployment rate right now is under four percent. Workers, particularly those in labor unions, enjoy high purchasing power and an ever-expanding lifestyle. Economic growth throughout the 1960s has been outstanding.

The worst thing we can do right now is to sabotage the progress we have seen by continuing to squander our money on a war in Vietnam. I support a full employment economy as well -- meaning we must be vigilant against misguided attempts to raise interest rates.

The unemployment rate won't stay low for long if we continue to pass new regulations on housing, mining, and industrial concerns. I speak for the working man when I say that we need to get the federal government out of these areas.
We are keeping the unemployment rate artificially depressed with unsound fiscal and monetary policies. In the long-run, this will lead to a poor economy and higher unemployment.
Democratic management of the economy these past eight years has been a clear success. I will continue to protect our unions and support the economy with smart government action.
There is far more we can do. Jobs training programs and a continued fight against discrimination will ensure that all Americans can share in the low unemployment rate.
body: 此时的美元与黄金联系属于布雷顿森林国际货币体系，不能按19世纪公众日常持有纸币兑换金币的金本位理解。1968年3月黄金总库危机后，官方黄金交易和私人市场形成两层市场。
官方市场维持每盎司35美元，私人价格浮动；停止美元对黄金兑换则发生在1971年。充分就业也不是每个成年人都必定有工作。原选项对通胀、利率和失业的因果判断保留，没有改任何经济或选举数值。

sources.title: 美国国务院：1968年3月黄金两层市场的会议与公报
联邦储备历史：美元黄金兑换至1971年终止

notes.title: 春节攻势：战场结果与政治影响并非一回事
contains: Should Lyndon Johnson have been able to prevent the Tet Offensive?
The Tet Offensive was an absolute disaster for the North Vietnamese. Why should it have been prevented?

I'm worried that for most or all of 1967, Lyndon Johnson repeatedly assured us that the North Vietnamese were on their last legs. It's difficult to assess the situation when we can't rely on the information that we have.
We should have had greater security in those places where we were attacked. Let us not forget, however, that this attack greatly hurt the Viet Cong and was a victory for the United States.
We could have prevented the Tet Offensive entirely if we'd never entangled ourselves in this Vietnamese quagmire.
While true, this is the exact opposite of what Americans believe how the war is going and doesn’t endear you to anti-war voters.
You’ve discredited the administration you served under, but the President hasn’t acted against you. The anti-war crowd welcomes you, and you shake off claims that you are merely a puppet for Johnson.
You’ve justified President Johnson’s handling of Vietnam and have his thanks, but it pushes away doves - they despise Jumbo.
Voters want more than just gloating with hindsight.
body: 1968年春节攻势未达到北越与越共预期的普遍起义和军事目标，但严重冲击了美国公众对战争进展及政府乐观表态的信任。说其军事上失利，不等于说美国国内政治也因此毫发无损。
游戏中的胜利、灾难、应加强戒备和根本不该参战，是不同政治论证。越共与北越相互协作，但并非同一个组织；译文没有把两个名称任意互换。

sources.title: 美国国务院：春节攻势与美方政策转变
美国国防部：军事胜利与舆论转折

notes.title: 1965年多米尼加干预：反共理由与争议
contains: Did you support Lyndon Johnson's 1965 intervention in the Dominican Republic?
I wish we would have had the guts to intervene in Cuba the way we did in the Dominican Republic. I will do anything I can as President to prevent a Communist insurgency in Latin America.
With minimal cost and minimal loss of life, President Johnson was able to prevent a Communist uprising in the Dominican Republic. I fully support his actions in that area.
I do support the intervention. We also need to reexamine our policies in general towards Latin America to ensure higher economic growth and more political freedom there.

We have long supported right-wing government in the Dominican Republic, and we've now propped it up against the will of the people. We can't credibly claim to fight for democracy when we do things like this.
This is very out of touch with the current mood of America. On the bright side, you do receive a boost in Florida from Cuban-Americans.
Much of the party, LBJ, moderates, and conservative Democrats are extremely elated. It proves to the country you’re not a radical left-wing, communist sympathizer.
This has a certain appeal to your wide coalition. You backup Johnson and simultaneously throw a bone to the left.
This legitimizes your detractors and right-wing claims that you are weak on Communism.
body: 多米尼加内战中，争取恢复被推翻的博什政府的力量与其对手交战。约翰逊政府以保护人员、担忧共产主义势力掌权等理由出兵，但恢复宪政的阵营不能全部等同于共产党。
国务院当时的情报评估强调共产主义影响，同期美国国会议员则质疑干预的依据与民主承诺。原选项支持、审慎支持和谴责干预的区别均保留；“最低伤亡”是人物评价，不意味着没有多米尼加平民伤亡。

sources.title: 美国国务院：1965年5月7日情报评估
美国海军历史：博什、内战与干预全过程
美国国会记录：1965年5月11日的批评

notes.title: 肯尼迪回合：贸易谈判与授权之争
contains: Do you believe that President Johnson overstepped his bounds in negotiating the Kennedy Round of trade agreements? Do you support the liberalization of international trade under the GATT?
International trade will undermine the prosperity of the working man as quickly as it will undermine the sovereignty of the United States. I don't support any of these global organizations.
I support the overall thrust of this policy. Foreign trade supports our Cold War allies, reduces the cost of goods in America, and supports a broader economic prosperity.
I support these international trade negotiations, but we must be sure that we don't undermine the rights of our own unions with one-sided agreements.
Labor and unions disagree.
This is a good answer. You manage to mollify LBJ and also soothe unions who are anxious about the effect these agreements have.
body: 肯尼迪回合是关贸总协定框架下的多边贸易谈判，由肯尼迪时期的1962年《贸易扩展法》授权推动，后来在约翰逊任内完成。它不是肯尼迪本人在1967年主持的会议，也不是已经成立世界贸易组织。
行政部门谈判权限、关税让步、国会后续立法及劳动者利益，是不同问题。支持贸易和批评某项协议偏向一方可以并存。

sources.title: 美国国务院：1967年5月对国会领导层说明的谈话要点
美国国务院：贸易授权与各方权限争论

notes.title: Dump the Hump：拒绝汉弗莱的押韵口号
contains: Dump the Hump!
body: Hump是Humphrey的戏谑缩写，与dump押韵。这里应理解为甩掉汉弗莱、别投他，不是字面上的丢掉驼峰。佐治亚数字图书馆的标语牌档案保存了这一口号。
口号曾被不同反对者使用，单凭这句话不能认定说话者必定属于同一政党或反战组织。中文传达拒绝投票的意思，没有编造原文不存在的押韵口号。

sources.title: 佐治亚数字图书馆：带Dump the Hump字样的原始标语牌记录

notes.title: Jumbo：把约翰逊变成粗俗网络绰号
contains: You’ve justified President Johnson’s handling of Vietnam and have his thanks, but it pushes away doves - they despise Jumbo.
body: Jumbo字面意为巨大的东西，在约翰逊相关轶事和网络梗中指其给自己阴茎起的名字；游戏这里借它代指约翰逊，带有粗俗嘲讽，而不是另一名政治人物。中文保留“巨无霸”的绰号，并在此解释双关。
下列文章汇集传记作者转述的轶事。此次未读到这些轶事对应的原始口述档案，不能把每个场景、尺寸或所谓越战动机当作已独立证实的史实，也不能推定当时鸽派普遍这样称呼他。

sources.title: MEL：约翰逊绰号的传记转述汇集及证据限制

notes.title: 尖脑袋知识分子：华莱士的反精英修辞
contains: This is another case of pointy-headed intellectualism that will regulate our factories right out of business and kill the jobs of the working man.
The Head Start program is another product of the out-of-touch, intellectual elite. It's a waste of money.
There's not a dime's worth of difference between the Democrats and Republicans. My goal is to win this election outright.
body: 尖脑袋是把学者与官僚讥为只会纸上谈兵、脱离普通人生活的政治称呼，不能误译成某种生理疾病。1970年国会记录收录的采访，直接问华莱士此前贬低北方记者与知识分子的言论。
“两党差别连一角钱都不值”则用很小的货币单位夸张地表示两党毫无差别。这里保留修辞，不把其理解为客观测量的政策相似度。

sources.title: 美国国会记录：1970年2月5日所载华莱士采访

notes.title: 未决选举与隐藏结局：游戏叙事不是历史判决
contains:
Wow! No candidate holds a majority in the electoral college.

Wallace's machinations have succeeded. The election will go to the House of Representatives where the Democrats hold a clear majority.

You do hold some cards however -- Humphrey would certainly rather make concessions to you, rather than deal with George Wallace. Perhaps you could obtain a place in his Administration, or some assurances on a policy issue of your choice.

Wow! No candidate achieved a majority in the electoral college.

Fortunately for you the Democrats have won a majority of the nation's Congressional delegations. Unfortunately, you also have to deal with George Wallace. He will not allow the Southern states to support any candidate who advocates desegregation.

Your best chance, sadly, is to try to broker a deal with Nixon or with other moderate Republicans.

You are the likely winner, but who knows where this all ends?

Congratulations! You have deadlocked the electoral college with your votes in the South.

In a close election, your electoral votes in the South have prevented either candidate from winning a majority. Get ready to put the squeeze on Humphrey and Nixon.

Of course, you still have to deal with the possibility that Humphrey and Nixon dislike you so much that they will simply strike a deal with each other. Whatever happens, it's sure to be interesting.

* Ha^^ ha^^ ha^^ ha^^^^^^...<^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^* Did you REALLY think it was OVER!?!?<^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^* I mean, we haven't even shown you what happens when Wallace wins every state yet...^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

Order!

Richard M Nixon, how do you plead on 1 count of treason against the United States of America, 1 count of misappropriation of campaign funds, 1 count of obstruction of justice, one count of abuse of power, one count of…

Richard Nixon, as he heard all this droning from the judge, closed his eyes, waiting for the sentence to end. He had been up all night, unable to sleep due to all the stress from the trial. Before he knew it, he’d fallen unconscious. All of a sudden, he jolted awake to the sound of the judge screaming; "NIXON! What do you plead?..."

"Uh, not guilty, your honour… not guilty?"

"On 1 count of sleeping in a court of law?..."

"When did you say tha- actually yes, your honour. The liberal media has been painting an askew picture of me. I was merely resting my eyes."

Pundits are shocked, trying to figure out how you managed to capture states outside the deep south to win it all. What happens next is entirely unknown. Its likely a crusader against the civil rights bill will happen, as well as the deconstruction of Great Society, and the escalation of Vietnam. Whatever happens, sit back and relax knowing you've done the greatest upset in US political history!
We need to remind voters that Wallace is still a Democrat, and that his goal is to throw the election to the House.
If there is no majority in the electoral college, what are your goals at the bargaining table?

I will support whatever candidate agrees to rescind the Civil Rights Act of 1964 and agrees to appoint justices who will overturn Brown v. Board of Education. If no candidate agrees to those conditions, then I will not support either one of them.
There's not a dime's worth of difference between the Democrats and Republicans. My goal is to win this election outright.
Whatever ends up happening on election day, I cannot comment about the aftermath at this point. If that scenario develops I will hear what each side has to say and make a decision at that point.

I will stick to the states where Richard Nixon is leading, and emphasize my credentials as a law-and-order conservative. If I can keep Nixon below 270, I have a real chance at brokering an end to desegregation after this election.
I'm more worried about sticking it to Humphrey than I am about Nixon. If it comes down to a negotiated election, I'd rather have Nixon in the driver's seat because I think we can work with him.
body: 没有候选人取得选举人票过半数时，众议院从总统得票前三名中选总统，按州代表团一州一票；参议院另从副总统得票前两名中选副总统。全院民主党席位多，不自动等于每个州代表团会投汉弗莱。
华莱士讨价还价、赢下全国、隐藏打字动画和尼克松庭审，属于原作架空或恶搞结局。尼克松1968年并未接受这种庭审，“我只是在闭目养神”是为睡着找借口的笑点，不是法院史料。原文民权法案crusader一句语法不通，按上下文译为针对法案的讨伐，公开记录这一解释。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：宪法第十二修正案
美国国家档案馆：真实1968年选举结果

notes.title: 儿童营养法：试点早餐与牛奶项目分别理解
contains: Do you support the Child Nutrition Act of 1966, which provides free breakfast and milk to qualified schoolchildren of impoverished backgrounds? Or do you believe that the program is too costly and constitutes a misuse of federal power?

I don't think anyone opposes the idea of providing milk to our poor kids. My contention, however, is that the state and local governments are more in tune with their needs than some bureaucrats in Washington.
This is a sensible piece of legislation. I support it and I think that every decent American supports it too.
body: 1966年《儿童营养法》第3节授权特殊牛奶项目，第4节授权学校早餐试点。早餐资助由州教育机构分配，优先考虑经济困难地区及学生通学距离较远的学校；不能理解成1966年所有学生已经普遍享有免费早餐。
法案规定，无力支付全价的儿童可免费或减价用早餐。原问题把早餐与牛奶简写为免费提供，译文保留问题，旁注区分具体条款与资格安排，不改候选人立场。

sources.title: 美国成文法原件：80 Stat. 885，第3至4节

notes.title: 避孕与堕胎：1968年不能倒套后来的判例
contains: Would you consider a constitutional amendment to outlaw the birth control pill, given the Supreme Court's decisions on that issue?
The Pill does not augur well for the social health of this nation. If we could get the support I'd love to see an Amendment that settles this issue once and for all.
We have bigger priorities to deal with right now in America. I don't think that most Americans support or expect this kind of an initiative.
We all have our own opinions on this practice, but I think the current system is the one that we should stay with. The individual states should be allowed to legislate on abortion as they so please.

I'm opposed to the practice of abortion personally, but I would support a federal law protecting access to this procedure in the most dire cases for the woman, such as when her life or health are in danger.
I support the right of women to control their reproductive destiny. This should be defended at the federal level.
Cheers and jeers mix in the convention hall, but elsewhere your speech is well-received.
Abortion is a contentious issue and your view is unnecessarily conservative. Feminists, led by the National Organization for Women, are enraged and protests become common at your rallies.
Conservative Democrats love this, but it turns off your more liberal supporters.
This is a liberal answer that still engages moderates. The negative? Conservative Democrats are upset by the answer.
This is too liberal for many in your party to stomach.
Americans generally like the pill.
The pill is not the biggest issue this election.
body: 1965年格里斯沃尔德诉康涅狄格州案涉及向已婚夫妇提供避孕建议和手段，法院从宪法保障中阐释婚姻隐私。它不是已经判决所有人的堕胎权，也不是1968年已经发生了1973年的罗诉韦德案。
是否通过联邦法律、是否维持州立法、是否只准许危急情况下的手术，是不同政策选择。反对避孕药的宪法修正案提议也须与普通法律区分。

sources.title: 康奈尔法律信息研究所：1965年判决原文381 U.S. 479

notes.title: 叛国：宪法限定与政治指控
contains: The Black Panthers are a radical group of militants who are plotting the overthrow of the United States government. It is my firm position, in accordance with the Constitution, that anyone planning treason against our country should be imprisoned and possibly executed.
This is bordering on treason. The American people deserve to hear about this.

Order!

Richard M Nixon, how do you plead on 1 count of treason against the United States of America, 1 count of misappropriation of campaign funds, 1 count of obstruction of justice, one count of abuse of power, one count of…

Richard Nixon, as he heard all this droning from the judge, closed his eyes, waiting for the sentence to end. He had been up all night, unable to sleep due to all the stress from the trial. Before he knew it, he’d fallen unconscious. All of a sudden, he jolted awake to the sound of the judge screaming; "NIXON! What do you plead?..."

"Uh, not guilty, your honour… not guilty?"

"On 1 count of sleeping in a court of law?..."

"When did you say tha- actually yes, your honour. The liberal media has been painting an askew picture of me. I was merely resting my eyes."
body: 美国宪法第三条将叛国限于对美国发动战争，或依附其敌人并给予援助；定罪还设有明确证据要求。仅仅具有激进观点或加入某个政治组织，不等于已经构成宪法意义的叛国。
原选项要求监禁甚至处决，是候选人的强硬政治主张。旁注区分指控与定罪，不替角色增加新的犯罪事实，也不改变原回答效果。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：宪法第三条第三节

notes.title: 芝加哥大会：警察制造的暴乱与调查报告
contains: What will you say in your acceptance speech at the Democratic Convention in Chicago? Will you address the rioting outside and the legacy of Robert Kennedy?
After the debacle of the convention in Chicago, are you willing to make a statement condemning the student protestors? Or conversely, one blaming the Chicago police?
I will tactfully criticize the police overreaction and then pivot towards a promise to end the war in Vietnam.
It is not worth addressing the violence outside. I will make a general pledge for law and order and focus my speech on the trials of the working man.
I fully blame the protestors for what happened. Their goal from day one was to spur a violent confrontation and disrupt the convention.
What we saw in Chicago was a police riot, pure and simple.
I think there's a lot of blame for both sides. Surely we can all agree that violence cannot be condoned, whatever the source.
I won't be making any statements about Chicago in my campaign. We should forget this as soon as possible and move on to the issues affecting our country.
The riots outside of the convention hall are the eight-hundred pound gorilla in the room. You can't just ignore them.
You really can't win by choosing a side in the Chicago mayhem. Just move along and find other things to talk about.
It’s the best answer for the events that transpired in Chicago, but nobody is swayed by your rebuke of both sides.
Total avoidance of the subject doesn’t do you any favors, although most Americans quickly move on from the situation.
body: 1968年民主党大会期间，芝加哥街头警察与示威者发生严重冲突。沃克调查报告承认挑衅与示威者的暴力，也记录警察对和平示威者、记者和旁观者使用无差别及过度武力，并用警察制造的暴乱概括某些警察行动。
这份报告在1968年12月才公开。游戏中大选前角色说出类似表述，可以是其政治立场，但不能写成当时已经引用12月发布的报告。这里警察是被指责发动暴力的一方，不是“警察镇压暴乱”的缩写；将责任完全归给某一方和双方皆有责任的选项保留区别。

sources.title: 沃克报告原始摘要转载：1968年12月发布的Rights in Conflict

notes.title: 心里犯奸淫：宗教自省与竞选风波
contains: Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in several ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. They'll need to tread carefully, as the impressive turnaround from 72, despite the playboy interview, shows what America thinks of Ol' Dick Nixon's cronies.

Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in a number of ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. As expected, your Playboy interview prevented a glorious decimation of the Republicans, but you'll take it, seeing as it could have been worse with the economic recovery.

Congratulations! Even though you were the favourite from the start, you could have faltered in several ways. You've carried the will of the country and sent a clear message to those DC insiders. Many were shocked at the tightness of the election, seeing as the negativity around the GOP and DC in general. Maybe you were TOO honest, Jimmy...

In the next issue of Playboy, there's an interview where you used the words "screw" and "shack up" and confessed, "I've committed adultery in my heart..." Many of your religious supporters are furious. What can you say to explain yourself?

In your infamous Playboy interview, you also referred to Lyndon Johnson as "lying, cheating, and distorting the truth." This might make you look honest, but it could destroy your chances of winning Texas if you don't apologize.
It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. The least you can do is show some contrition.
It's probably smart to cut your losses and move on from this issue. But for the first time now, a lot of people are questioning your judgment...
It was a bad idea to do this interview in the first place. You don't need to make things worse by digging your heels in.
You've gained a bit for being honest, but this can't be good for your chances in Texas.
Probably a smart move to walk back from these comments, although it does undermine your claims to honesty by a small amount.

Your campaign has just received a big break in the form of a controversial interview that Carter did with Playboy, where he confessed to "committing adultery in his heart" and used some coarse language. Any thoughts?
This is great. We need any good news we can get at this point.
I will hold a press conference and remind people that we really don't know anything about this guy. What other hidden, perverse notions does he have?
body: 卡特在《花花公子》访谈中谈基督教的谦卑、欲念与不应自以为比别人优越。“心里犯奸淫”援引耶稣关于欲念的教导，不是承认实际婚外情。“干”和“姘居”保留原文口语的粗俗程度，不能改成他真的干过这些事。
他随后批评尼克松和约翰逊撒谎、欺骗及歪曲真相；原作只突出约翰逊与得克萨斯选票。资料页的11月1日是编辑按杂志11月号设置的日期，不代表采访当天；游戏的票数后果及道歉选择属于模拟。

sources.title: 加州大学圣巴巴拉分校：1976年《花花公子》访谈全文及日期说明

notes.title: 福特未经选举进入白宫，不是从未当选公职
contains: Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. The recovering economy, however, made this election quite close, so you can take solace in the fact that you went down swinging.

Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. America showed they wanted an outsider, and Carter managed to take that title. Let's hope he can help restore faith in government, and help the inflation die down.

Despite your best efforts, Jimmy Carter has bested you, making you the only president never elected to office. The toll of Watergate and Vietnam was just too much for you to handle. Your Watergate pardon might go down as one of the most blunderous moves in political history, as otherwise, you might have been able to disassociate yourself with Nixon. You, accordingly, got beaten by a larger than expected margin.
body: 福特曾多次当选联邦众议员。1973年按第二十五修正案程序获任命并经国会确认出任副总统，1974年尼克松辞职后继任总统；他没有在全国大选中当选总统或副总统。
原文“从未当选进入职位”措辞过宽，中文按本段总统身份译为“从未通过选举进入白宫”，并在这里保留这一解释的依据。不能把它理解为他整个政治生涯都未赢过选举。

sources.title: 福特总统图书馆：1973—1974年副总统档案与任命背景
国家档案馆：第二十五修正案

notes.title: 福特最后一届任期与未决选举
contains:
Wow! You have won in a squeaker.

While the Electoral College ended in a tie, the Democrats have a huge advantage in the House of Representatives and are sure to elect you in that manner. Hopefully the closeness of this election doesn't undermine your promises to clean up Washington and unite the people of this country.

Congratulations! You have won the 1976 Presidential Election.

Hopefully you can continue to help the United States recover from the Watergate Scandal, the recent recession, and the debacle of Vietnam. In either case, this will be your final term as President. Speculation is sure to be intense on who will replace you. Will it be Ronald Reagan? Ted Kennedy? Or someone else entirely?

Sorry, you have lost the 1976 Presidential Election.

While the Electoral College ended in a tie, the Democrats have a huge advantage in the House of Representatives and are sure to elect your opponent in that manner. Perhaps you can still play a role in 1980, or seek your old Congressional leadership positions. In any case, you can still take solace in the fact that you did the right thing by pardoning Nixon and moving the country beyond the Watergate episode.
body: 福特继任后至1977年1月已任职超过两年。第二十二修正案规定，若在他人当选的任期内任职超过两年，之后只能再当选总统一次；因此1976年赢得选举将开启他的最后一届，而非还可以赢下1980年。
若总统候选人都未获选举人票多数，第十二修正案规定众议院按州投票，每州一票，从前三名中选总统。原作把民主党议员占多数写成卡特必胜，属于机制简化；议员总人数多数不等于州代表团票数多数。

sources.title: 国家档案馆：第十二与第二十二修正案

notes.title: 卡特乌托邦：花生、果酱与873票
contains: The year is 1984

Jimmy Carter has been president for 8 years. Inflation has subsided to a steady amount, with unemployment dropping to virtually 0%. The budget had been balanced in 78, and poverty and hunger have been eradicated, as everyone unemployed became a farmer, and is eating peanut butter and peach jam sandwiches. the USSR on the 21st of January had seceded all their land to the USA and declared their government dissolved. Most importantly of all, the government is now trusted more than ever under the leadership of Jimmy Carter, who beat up Richard Nixon on live TV in 1981, garnering a 99% approval rating. Mondale has already won the most recent election 873 electoral votes to 0 against those sorry Republicans, who disbanded shortly after. All is good in the world, thanks to our wonderful leader, Jimmy Carter.
body: 这是原作的夸张架空结局：全民务农吃花生酱三明治、苏联解散并让出国土、卡特电视直播痛打尼克松、共和党解散，都不是历史事实。花生联系卡特的务农形象，全文故意把政治成功写成荒诞童话。
蒙代尔“873比0”的选举人票不是1976年的真实票数。国家档案馆列出当年总计538票；译文保留873这个笑点，不改票数计算，也不把游戏中的1984年份强行认证为某个特定文学梗。

sources.title: 国家档案馆：1976年真实选举人票
《花花公子》访谈：卡特花生农场主的形象

notes.title: 玫瑰园战略：利用现任总统身份
contains: Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. You won by a quite shocking margin. It seems your rose garden strategy worked well.

Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. Carter put up a strong fight, however, and without the Playboy scandal, you likely wouldn't have won. The Democrats are sure to make some electoral changes after two outsiders in a row preventing them from winning...

Wow! Defying the odds, you have beaten back the Democrats to secure yet another term for your party. After the Watergate pardon, most thought you were done for, but you proved them wrong. You barely squeaked by, however. Carter gave you a run for your money, and congress isn't too friendly towards you either, so you better tread carefully.

You can hopefully expand upon the recovery from stagflation in your second term, and hopefully bring honour back to the white house. It won't be an easy feat with your pardon, but America wants to give you a chance. Do well and you might be remembered for more than Nixon's pardon.

I am the President of the United States and we should exploit that fact. Show me presiding over the Bicentennial, meeting with Queen Elizabeth, and generally looking like a President. My record speaks for itself.
body: 玫瑰园战略指福特更多留在白宫履行公务，突出总统的经验与可靠形象，由多尔外出竞选，也节省差旅预算。它不是园艺政策，也不意味着总统从不外出。
游戏写“战略奏效”是相应胜利分支的评价；真实1976年福特输给卡特。建国二百周年庆典中的总统形象也服务于现任者优势。

sources.title: 福特总统图书馆：1976年大选与玫瑰园战略

notes.title: 东欧口误：辩论中的冷战措辞
contains: Ford performed well, except for an unfortunate gaffe about the Soviet Union and Eastern Europe. Furthermore, as the election gets closer, the economy is improving and voters are giving things a closer look...
body: 福特在第二场总统辩论中否认苏联主宰东欧，引发争议。这里并不是东欧国家已经摆脱苏联影响；他的后续解释强调当地人民追求自由。
游戏中有关赢得辩论或从口误中获益的反馈是模拟结果，不替任何候选人证明东欧当时的实际政治独立程度。

sources.title: 福特总统图书馆：三场总统辩论及东欧争议

notes.title: 对苏粮食贸易：1972年已签大额协议
contains: The United States started selling large amounts of grain to the Soviet Union, in 1973. What is your opinion on this policy?
I don't really care too much one way or the other. As long as we have sufficient supplies in the U.S., we should ship grain to whoever will pay for it.
This policy is a win-win for us. It helps our own farmers prosper, and it is a public relations victory for the world to see the Soviet Union depending on American enterprise.
This policy helps support an unsustainable Soviet system. I believe that we should never bail out communism from its failures if we're serious about winning the Cold War.
This answer is a bit apathetic, and you've missed a good chance to win support from the farm states.
A lot of farm states are happy to have another market for their grain, and this is a good foreign policy win as well.
This might make you look more conservative, but it's not the popular answer for this election.
body: 国务院《美国对外关系文件》记录，美国与苏联于1972年7月8日签署三年粮食采购协议。原问题写大量销售始于1973年，年代概括有误；中文正文保留1973，不暗改原始问题。
农产品出口、缓和外交关系以及贸易导致国内价格变动的争论应分别理解。游戏关于农民支持或物价效果的评价是竞选反馈，不是从这份协议即可推出的定量结论。

sources.title: 美国国务院：1972年7月粮食采购协议

notes.title: 充分就业：1976年提案与1978年法律不同
contains: Do you support the Humphrey-Hawkins Full Employment Act?
Absolutely I do. We should not tolerate high unemployment in this country, and this Act provides the tools to prevent it.

I'm all for some programs to provide jobs, but this Act has too many mandates and goals that are inconsistent with each other. We can't have a balanced budget, full employment, and low inflation at the same time.
I can see both sides of this issue, but if Congress passes this Act I won't veto it as President.

This Act has no basis in economic reality. If we could wave a magic wand and ensure 3% unemployment and 0% inflation with a balanced budget and no trade deficit, do you think we wouldn't have done it already?
This is a pretty liberal policy, but it's broadly popular with Democrats and particularly important to Hubert Humphrey.
This is a good chance to present yourself as the voice of common-sense and honesty, but many Democrats favor the proposed law.
You have enjoyed broad appeal, but sometimes it is almost too broad. As the election approaches, some voters worry that you can't take a clear stand on many of the issues.
This is a pretty conservative answer for a Democrat. It sounds like something Ronald Reagan might say.
body: 1976年争论的是汉弗莱—霍金斯就业立法提议，不能写成当时已生效的1978年法律。充分就业并非绝对零失业。
最终1978年法律包含20岁以上人员失业率不超过3%、通胀降至3%或更低及更长期零通胀等目标，并附带就业目标约束。原选项把3%失业、0%通胀、预算平衡和无贸易逆差并列，是反对者的讥讽论证，不能当作所有1976年版本的逐字条文。

sources.title: 联邦储备历史：1978年充分就业与平衡增长法

notes.title: 逃避征兵者与军中逃兵不同
contains: What is your position on a pardon of Vietnam War draft evaders?
It is time for America to move past this issue. I will issue an immediate pardon if I am elected President.
Millions of American men accepted their responsibilities and served admirably, but I can see the case for an eventual pardon. Perhaps towards the end of my term.
I would need to think about this issue a little more before reaching a final decision.
Of course this war was controversial, but I oppose any pardon for people who evaded their military service. This would not send the right message in a future crisis.
body: 逃避征兵者指未按征兵制度要求服役的人；军中逃兵则已进入军队后擅离职守。卡特在1976年访谈中支持普遍赦免前者，并明确不把军中逃兵纳入同一范围。
这里保留完全反对、附条件与普遍赦免的政治立场差别；不能把draft evaders一律译成逃兵，也不能把所有反战者等同于违法者。

sources.title: 卡特1976年访谈：分别讨论逃避征兵者与军中逃兵

notes.title: ERA是宪法修正案；贝蒂的沙发是玩笑
contains: Do you support the ratification of the Equal Rights Amendment, which states "Equality of rights under the law shall not be denied or abridged by the United States or by any State on account of sex."?
I support the passage of this Amendment, and think it is a good thing for America.
I don't really have a strong statement to make on this Amendment. This is an issue for Congress and the states to decide.
We already have too many grounds for the federal government to interfere in the economy. This would add another new set of regulations that we can't afford.
I oppose this Amendment, as many labor unions do, because it would jeopardize protections for female workers in areas such as working hours or tasks.
This is the mainstream answer shared by all major politicians (unless you count a guy like Reagan).
Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. Some wings of the party are pretty disappointed in this stance.
Even Gerald Ford supports this Amendment. It's good to win the labor vote, but there are other factors to consider as well.
This is the party line, but it's also a controversial issue with much disagreement.
This is a good compromise position if you don't want to support the Amendment.
This is a good answer to fire up the base. But women voters, including your own wife, are upset with you. Enjoy sleeping on the White House couch for a few days.
You've managed to offend everyone with this answer. Sounding conservative and praising labor unions at the same time?
body: 平等权利修正案由国会于1972年提出，尚须足够州批准才能成为宪法的一部分。1976年的支持与反对不能译成国会准备首次通过一项普通法律；工会对妇女保护立法与平等待遇也并非始终有同一立场。
贝蒂·福特公开支持ERA，并在1975年访谈表达期待。反馈里总统只能睡白宫沙发，是借夫妻观点冲突开玩笑，不是已查证的白宫生活记录。原文关于“许多工会反对”的范围和75%支持率尚未独立核准。

sources.title: 国家档案馆：ERA的国会通过与州批准程序
福特总统图书馆：贝蒂1975年8月10日访谈

notes.title: 贝蒂的坦率：不等于替丈夫宣布政纲
contains: Betty Ford is out there making some pretty bold statements about sexuality, marijuana, and other topics. Conservatives want to know if you can have a quiet chat with her to tone it down a bit.
I've tried to explain to her that we have an election coming up, and we don't need all this bad press, but she won't listen.
What do you want me to say? She's my wife. Can't people find something better to worry about?
My wife's public approval rating is something like 75%. I wish I had her touch with the media.
body: 贝蒂1975年《60分钟》访谈涉及堕胎、年轻人的性关系及尝试大麻，引来赞成与反对。她表达自己的观点，也强调与丈夫可以有政治分歧。
原问答中“劝她低调”“她不听”是可选竞选台词，不是访谈逐字实录；75%支持率在本批资料中尚未独立验证。图书馆正式访谈页标注8月10日，避免把另一份文件标题中的10月日期误当首次播出时间。

sources.title: 福特总统图书馆：贝蒂《60分钟》完整访谈

notes.title: 工作权法：工会保障协议，而非政府保证就业
contains: What is your position on right-to-work laws? Would you support a national bill to repeal Taft-Hartley and do away with right-to-work?
I am a strong supporter of labor unions and I would support this type of measure.
This isn't an issue that I have strong feelings about, one way or the other. I think it is the kind of thing that each state can figure out for themselves.
I go more the other way on this issue. I think that more states should be right-to-work. Unions dangerously distort the economy and the political process.
This is the type of middle-ground answer that will keep you from alienating any large wing of the party.
This is a big break from the Democratic platform. You'd better be prepared to explain this a little more.
body: 这里的工作权法涉及州是否禁止把缴纳工会费用等工会保障安排作为就业条件。它不是国家保证人人获得工作的权利，也不能与充分就业法案混为一谈。
《塔夫脱—哈特利法》及其第14(b)条保留州在相关安排上的限制权限。支持工会与反对强制缴费的选项保留不同立场；现代机构页面中的州数量不能倒填到1976年。

sources.title: 美国国家劳资关系委员会：工会保障协议与工作权法
美国国家劳资关系委员会：劳动关系法第14(b)条

notes.title: 石油禁运：阿拉伯产油国与以色列政策
contains: How can we best prevent another episode like the 1973 oil crisis, which paralyzed the country?
We need to cultivate relationships like the ones we have with Iran and Saudi Arabia, to ensure that we have support from Middle Eastern oil producers.
I'm a big supporter of domestic oil production. One thing we can definitely do is begin to drill in Alaska.
The crisis resulted from a regional war against Israel. We need to work towards lasting peace agreements to prevent this in the future.
We need to do anything we can, including reducing our consumption, working for peace deals, producing domestically, and stabilizing our relationships with oil-producing allies.
Voters don't care much what you do, as long as there are no more gas shortages and long lines at the pump.
This certainly helps you with the urban hard hat vote, but it could hurt you in the South, where most states are right-to-work.
body: 1973年阿拉伯—以色列战争期间，阿拉伯产油国针对支持以色列的国家实施禁运，并削减产量，禁运于1974年3月结束。不能把它写成所有石油输出国或所有阿拉伯国家一致的行动。
美国对以色列的支持、与沙特等国的关系、国内能源开发及节能政策相互牵制。原选项的石油独立、调整外交立场和增加生产是不同路线，译文没有合并。

sources.title: 美国国务院：1973—1974年石油禁运

notes.title: 巴拿马运河：1976年谈判并未完成移交
contains: Do you think that the Panama Canal should be turned back over to Panama?
This is an issue I would have to consider more closely over the next couple of years. Let's see how the current negotiations go.
Absolutely not. The United States built this canal and it is a central part of world commerce. Who knows what might happen if we put Panama in charge.
This is a pretty safe answer that appeals to your party without alienating moderates.
This is a good, conservative answer on foreign policy.
body: 福特时期已在谈判新的运河安排；1977年卡特与托里霍斯签署两个条约，1978年参议院批准。运河区于1979年10月停止存在，运河本身到1999年12月才移交巴拿马。
1976年选项讨论的是将来的政策选择，不能当作已经完成的卡特条约。保留继续控制、谈判和主权移交的差别，也不把运河与整个运河区当作同一个日期移交的对象。

sources.title: 美国国务院：托里霍斯—卡特条约及分阶段移交

notes.title: 彻奇委员会：情报监督，不是教会委员会
contains: You have selected Frank Church as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
Frank Church has made some recent statements on the campaign trail that even more needs to be done to rein in America's military and intelligence agencies. Do you think he is going too far?
I support this as a positive step, and I'm eager to see how current negotiations play out.
Frank Church is committed to openness in government, and in exposing the kinds of intelligence abuses that all Americans deserve to hear about.
Frank Church has served his home state of Idaho well, and he is the best man for the job.
Church is an honorable man, but I would never support the weakening of America's fundamental defense abilities. I support investigations, but not cuts to our defense.
I wouldn't phrase it in his manner. I think we can afford some cuts to our defense budget, but as a Navy man myself, I will always respect our military.
Church is right on the mark. The people still are not in a position where they can trust our leading government institutions, and that includes the military.
I think we've done enough in this area. My goal as President will be to move beyond the strife and scandals of the past few years.
Frank Church should help burnish your credentials on defense and character issues.
body: Church在这里是参议员弗兰克·彻奇的姓。1975年成立的调查委员会查究情报机关的非法、不当或不道德行动，1976年4月提出最终报告；并不是调查宗教组织的委员会。
游戏把公开政府、约束军方及情报活动与国家安全之间的争议写入搭档分支。批评调查削弱安全，是角色的政治判断；调查发现的权利侵害不能被这一台词抹去。

sources.title: 美国参议院：彻奇委员会调查与最终报告

notes.title: 斯库普·杰克逊：绰号与鹰派民主党人
contains: You have selected Scoop Jackson as your running mate. Can you speak a little more about that?
Some have suggested that Scoop Jackson is too conservative for the Democratic Party. Can you explain a little why you've selected a defense hawk and anti-busing Senator as your running mate?
Scoop Jackson has the right ideas about what it means to be a Democrat -- strong on defense, and tireless in his fight for working class American.
Scoop Jackson has served his home state of Washington well, and he is the best man for the job.

Scoop Jackson stands for common-sense American values. I support a strong defense myself, and anyone can get a little concerned over how much the federal courts have interfered with education in this country.
We might have a few areas in which we have different opinions, but that is what the Democratic Party is all about. Part of running a national campaign is compromising for the good of the whole.
Scoop Jackson is a polarizing choice, but he has his advantages.
body: 斯库普是亨利·杰克逊的绰号，参议院简介记述他年幼卖报时获得这个称呼。不是名字叫“独家新闻”的另一个人，也不是安德鲁·杰克逊。
他是华盛顿州民主党参议员，国内政策上的自由派倾向与国防外交上的强硬态度可以并存。不能因为鹰派立场就把他的党籍、工会关系或全部国内政纲改成共和党保守派。

sources.title: 美国参议院：亨利·斯库普·杰克逊生平

notes.title: 巴茨辞职：真实事件与可选应对
contains: Your Secretary of Agriculture, Earl Butz, will be quoted in next week's Rolling Stone as making some very crude and racist jokes. Some have suggested you fire him before the article is released. What are your thoughts?
I agree. We can't have this kind of thing on the Ford Administration. He should leave immediately.
Let's have him leave the day that the article comes out. That way the connection is clear.
Let's wait and see and how the public reacts to this.
A couple of bad jokes shouldn't ruin someone's career. Let's keep him on board.
body: 真实历史中，农业部长厄尔·巴茨于1976年10月4日辞职，福特当天公开接受。巴茨在辞职信中为被公开报道的言语致歉；不能把游戏中继续留任的选择当成真实最后结果。
原问答概述粗俗且带种族主义的笑话，没有给出逐字引语，中文不额外编造辱骂内容。这里的总统称赞与支持者反应仍是相应原作台词。

sources.title: 福特1976年10月4日讲话与巴茨辞职信

notes.title: 斯克鲁奇：吝啬冷酷的文学比喻
contains: Good hedge. You can't possibly support this idea, but you can oppose it without sounding like a scrooge.
body: 斯克鲁奇是狄更斯《圣诞颂歌》中的人物，成为吝啬、缺乏同情心的代称。这里说反对政策时不要显得像他，是顾问对竞选形象的讥讽，不是美国政客的姓名。

sources.title: 美国国会图书馆：《圣诞颂歌》及斯克鲁奇的广播改编

notes.title: 纽约救助：贷款、条件与政治形象
contains: What is your position on the federal government making loans to states or cities in need of financial help? An obvious recent example is the $2.3 billion bailout of New York city.
Big cities have a higher social burden than most jurisdictions. It's only right that they should receive extra financial help to compensate.
We have to consider each case individually. New York was a one time thing, and they also had to make significant reforms before this loan was approved.
I couldn't really comment until I saw what the specifics of the case would be.
These types of bailouts support big government, big labor machine politics at the expense of everyone else. There's no way I would support this kind of deal.
This is a good liberal answer, but perhaps a bit too liberal.
This is not the best response for a Democrat.
This is a controversial answer, but as an outsider it could help feed your popularity.
body: 问题所称23亿美元救助涉及联邦贷款，不是无偿向城市赠送同额资金。福特最初反对为避免违约而进行联邦救助，后来在纽约州、市及相关机构采取措施后支持贷款方案。
福特竞选阵营的资料汇编记录了这一转变，但它本身是竞选宣传材料，不能把其中赞扬政策效果的说法当作中立经济评估。游戏保留赞成、附条件与拒绝的选项区别。

sources.title: 福特总统图书馆保存：1976年竞选资料汇编

notes.title: 有限禁试与全面禁试不是同一政策
contains: Should there be a ban on nuclear weapons testing?
I believe we should implement an immediate moratorium on the testing of nuclear devices.
This is an issue I'd have to consider carefully, but perhaps if we got the Soviet Union on board I'd be open to it.
I don't believe so. Our nation's security depends on being adequately prepared to face Soviet aggression.
You've definitely come down with the dovish wing of the party on this issue.
This is a popular, mainstream answer on this issue. Even Republicans are looking for ways to defuse Cold War tensions these days.
You've definitely come down with the hawkish wing of the party on this issue.
body: 1963年《部分禁止核试验条约》禁止大气层、外层空间和水下核试验，没有禁止地下核试验。1976年再讨论全面禁试并不意味着过去从未有过禁试安排。
继续研制武器、与苏联谈判限制以及全面禁止核试验，是不同立场。译文不把停止试验擅自扩大为立即销毁所有核武器。

sources.title: 美国国务院：1963年有限禁试条约的范围

notes.title: 布朗的以色列负担论：军事供给与外交争议
contains: General George Brown, Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, has made some comments that Israel has become a "burden" to the national defense effort. Do you agree with this?
I disagree strongly and believe that General Brown should be removed from this position for such comments. Israel is one of our most valued allies.
This is definitely something that deserves a reprimand at the very least. I don't agree with these views.
I don't have any comment. The General's views are his own.
I agree with General Brown, to be honest. We would have never had the Oil Crisis in '73 if we weren't closely aligned with Israel.
This is a strong answer, but it certainly helps you with the Jewish vote in New York and elsewhere.
This is a good enough answer, but some Jewish supporters were hoping for more.
Your position on this controversy has become news itself. People are wondering if you're opposed to Israel or the Jewish people, and it is not helping you on the trial.
body: 这里是参谋长联席会议主席乔治·布朗，不是副总统候选人或地方议员。1976年同期报道记录，福特回应有关布朗“军事负担”的说法，解释1973年战争援助曾动用美国在欧洲的军备储备，并强调已补足、美国支持以色列安全。
批评援助成本、支持盟友及反犹指控不是同一种主张。原顾问反馈担忧选民把候选人立场理解为反对犹太人，中文保留这一竞选风险，不把所有对援助的批评直接判定为反犹。

sources.title: 犹太电讯社1976年10月21日报道：福特回应布朗

notes.title: 普莱恩斯教会与克伦农·金：礼拜不等于会籍
contains: On the Sunday before election day, your church has canceled its services rather than admit a black minister as a member. Will you terminate your own membership?
I've always believed in trying to change an institution from within. My family has consistently voted against segregation in our church, and will continue to do so.
Our church has been open to some black attendees in the past, but this particular man is already the member of another church, and is clearly a Republican operative.
My family has tried for many years to work for change in the Plains Baptist Church, but I can see now that we have failed. I have no choice but to withdraw my membership.
Unfortunately there's not much you can do with this awkward situation. But you've spoken out enough for Civil Rights that this shouldn't hurt you too much...
This answer sounds too strident and waffling to have much appeal on either side. Hopefully the damage is limited.
It's nice to talk about the New South, but there is sure to be a backlash (especially from the Southern Baptist vote). On the other hand, this could help you a bit elsewhere.
body: 克伦农·金是一名黑人牧师和民权活动人士，不是已于1968年遇刺的马丁·路德·金。同期美联社报道记载，卡特家乡教会后来以120比66表决向所有愿意参加礼拜的人开放。
参加礼拜、申请加入教会、获准成为成员是不同程序。原问题把入会与礼拜取消放在一起，保留其剧情；“共和党特务”是选项的攻击说法，不是译者认证的身份。此次档案PDF全文读取失败，表决及身份依据为报纸档案的搜索文本，具体事发日和会籍程序仍待原页核对。

sources.title: 得克萨斯理工大学报纸档案：1976年11月15日Pampa News所载美联社报道

notes.title: 福特摔倒梗：电视讽刺中的笨拙总统
contains: I can't fuckin think of anything funny for Ford, he is so bland, just pretend this gif is playing and he is falling down the stairs.
body: 原作让玩家想象福特摔下飞机舷梯的动图，联系其在奥地利摔倒及切维·切斯在《周六夜现场》模仿笨拙福特的形象。电视讽刺不等于对其身体能力的医学判断，也不能据此否定他的运动经历。

sources.title: TIME历史专栏：福特、切维·切斯与1976年电视讽刺

notes.title: 贝赫—塞勒：全国直选的宪法改革提议
contains: Interestingly enough, Ford ended up winning the popular vote. Republicans are more shocked than angry. Perhaps passing a new version of the Bayh-Celler amendment can be among your reforms?

If it wasn't already bad enough for you, the popular votes ended up going in your favour. The public and the Democrats are enraged and in despair, as the will of the people to remove the man who pardon Nixon failed. If the Bayh-Celler amendment didn't pass previously, surely the support to pass it will be present now?
body: 贝赫—塞勒提议以总统全国直选取代选举人团。1969年众议院通过相关修宪方案，但它未完成参议院和州批准程序，并未成为宪法。
游戏出现选举人票胜利而普选票落败的分支后，再谈推动改革，是架空政治后续。不能把这个分支当作卡特1976年真实地输了普选票。

sources.title: 印第安纳大学图书馆：贝赫生平及选举人团改革史
国家档案馆：1976年选举结果

notes.title: 格雷格案：有程序限制的死刑合宪
contains: What are your feelings in the Gregg v. Georgia case, recently decided, that allows capital punishment in the U.S.?
Even if permitted, I would hope that our states would move to abolish the death penalty.
I'm opposed to the death penalty overall, but I could support it for a few particularly heinous crimes.
I'm neutral when it comes to the death penalty. This is an issue for the states to decide.
This is a positive step forward for our criminal justice system. Certain crimes, like murder, demand such punishment if true justice is to prevail.
This is a good, liberal answer, but a bit outside the mainstream.
The party has a little more of a nuanced position on this issue.
body: 1976年格雷格诉佐治亚州案审查新的死刑制度，并认可该案所涉、对判刑裁量加以约束的程序。不能把“死刑不当然违宪”写成任何罪名、任意程序的处决都合法。
候选人可赞成、反对或限定死刑适用，译文保留立场差异；法院判决与人物道德赞许不是同一件事。

sources.title: 美国政府出版局：格雷格案428 U.S.153判词原件，第153—156页概要

notes.title: 效忠誓词：反对强制，不等于反对国旗
contains: To what extent will you attack the veto, by Dukakis, of a bill requiring teachers to lead their students in the Pledge of Allegiance?
Why Dukakis thought it would be a good idea to veto this bill is beyond me, but we won't let him forget it in this campaign. I will say the Pledge of Allegiance wherever I go on the trail.
Mr. Dukakis was simply following the law as handed down in West Virginia State Board of Education v. Barnette. I don't think this type of attack will resonate with voters.
body: 巴内特案1943年保护学生不被强迫敬旗和宣读誓词。杜卡基斯任州长时另向州最高法院咨询1977年法案，要求每位教师每天带领班级宣读。法院多数意见认为侵犯教师的第一修正案权利，明确把巴内特理由延伸到教师；不同意见对法案是否构成强制有不同解释。
所以这不是宣布国旗违法，也不是禁止自愿宣读。原作的攻击选项把法律争论用作爱国形象争论，译文保留政治立场，但不把候选人攻击认证为法院结论。

sources.title: 马萨诸塞州最高法院1977年咨询意见：372 Mass.874原文转载
美国联邦法院：第一修正案与不敬旗的自由

notes.title: 更加仁厚温和与读我的唇：真实口号及反常选项
contains: Are you willing to rule out any further increases to the federal income tax, if elected President?
My opponent will raise taxes, and so will I. He won't tell you. I just did.
I will move the nation forward to a new era, with continued employment growth and concern for the well-being of our citizens -- a kinder, gentler era.
As President, I will do anything I can to cut income taxes further.
I hope that this isn't necessary, but it would be irresponsible to rule anything out at the present time.
body: 布什在1988年8月18日接受提名演说中希望国家更加仁厚温和，并许诺不加新税；“读我的唇”是强调自己绝不加税的说法。
游戏另给出“对手会加税，我也会”的反常选项，不能因为与著名承诺相反就擅自改成不加税。保留自承加税、进一步减税和不排除加税三种不同立场；未来票数与税收分支是模拟，不是演说逐字史料。

sources.title: 布什1988年接受共和党总统提名演说全文

notes.title: 病人嘲讽：里根的话不是医学诊断
contains: Ronald Reagan referred to Michael Dukakis as an “invalid” during a recent speech. Do you care to make any comment on that?
Mr. Reagan's words are his own. I admire the President, but I would never go so far as to throw names at our opponent.
Reagan himself admitted he was only trying to tell a joke, which came off poorly. I think we should move on to other issues.
There's not much you can add to the Beltway flap du jour.
body: 1988年8月3日记者问杜卡基斯是否应公开医疗记录，并提到精神科诊治传闻，里根用invalid作嘲讽性回答。这里译为病人，不是无效的人；也不能据总统这句话确认候选人有精神疾病。
实际场合是国防授权法否决后的记者问答，原问题概括成演说，正文保留原作叙述。游戏可以选择与这番话切割；顾问所说华盛顿今日风波，Beltway指首都政界，不是高速公路交通事故。

sources.title: 里根1988年8月3日记者问答原文

notes.title: 中导条约：消除一类导弹，不是全面核裁军
contains: What is your opinion on the recent Intermediate-Range Nuclear Forces Treaty?
This is a huge leap forward between the United States and Soviet Union, and I hope to oversee additional arms control measures during my time as President.
This is a huge leap forward between the United States and Soviet Union.
body: 里根与戈尔巴乔夫于1987年12月8日签署《中程核力量条约》。里根在签署讲话中说明将销毁有关陆基中程导弹，强调现场检查及“信任，但要核查”。1988年6月1日在莫斯科交换批准书后生效。
这里的支持选项赞许美苏削减军备的进展；并不意味着所有核武器已经销毁，也不意味着游戏里支持的其他武器项目因此自动取消。

sources.title: 里根图书馆：1987年12月8日中导条约签署讲话
里根图书馆：1988年6月10日致参议院生效说明

notes.title: 诺列加与七届政府：竞选辩护的出处
contains: Do you have anything to say about your relationship with Manuel Noriega of Panama?
Seven Administrations have dealt with Manuel Noriega, dating back to the 1950s. As soon as his drug ties became known, it was the Reagan Administration that moved to indict him.
This is the kind of specious attack that doesn't merit serious discussion in a national campaign. I trust that voters will be smart enough to focus on the real issues.
I regret not taking active steps, as CIA Director, to limit our dealings with Manuel Noriega in the 1970s.
This is an embarrassing issue, but your best course is to minimize it and hope that it doesn't come up too much during the campaign.
body: 1988年9月25日首场总统辩论中，杜卡基斯批评美国与诺列加的关系，布什则说七届政府都与他打过交道，并以里根—布什政府提出起诉作为辩护。剧本选项沿用了这套论辩。
辩论记录能证明布什这样说过，不能据此证明美国此前毫不知情，或确认原作所写每个年代细节。认错、否认有何可说和以多届政府为自己辩护，是不同的政治选择；中文保留这些区别。

sources.title: 米勒中心：1988年9月25日总统辩论原文

notes.title: 课堂祈祷：学校主持与个人宗教活动的区别
contains: Do you believe that voluntary prayer should be allowed in the nation's classrooms?
I support the right for local schools to decide whether to include a daily, voluntary prayer.
This is settled law. It is not appropriate to have public schools lead students in prayer, even if it is voluntary.
body: 1962年恩格尔诉维塔莱案针对公立学校主持的祈祷。法院多数意见认为，即使不限定教派、允许学生退出，也不能消除政府介入宗教的问题。
因此，选项之间的争论在于地方学校是否组织日常祈祷，不能把反对学校带领祈祷译成禁止个人信教。旁注讲的是当时的判例语境；正文仍保留支持地方决定和反对校方主持两种立场。

sources.title: 美国联邦法院：恩格尔诉维塔莱案事实与判决摘要

notes.title: 三国自由贸易区：1988年仍是政策设想
contains: Would you support a free trade zone, encompassing Mexico, the U.S., and Canada?
Do you believe that free trade measures destroy more American jobs than they create?
This would be a positive step forward for all three countries, including the United States.
I'm predisposed to support this measure, but of course it depends on the specific negotiations that would play out.
I would oppose this measure without strong protections for the rights of American workers and employers.
I'm opposed to the expansion of foreign trade at the present time, when we are already dealing with a large trade deficit.
I believe that free trade creates jobs. If I didn't believe that, I wouldn't support it.
Probably the effect is about equal, but it does allow American workers to focus on what they do best, which makes us more prosperous.
Free trade agreements definitely cost more American jobs than they create, further polarizing our society.
Many in the party are surprised by your protectionist tone.
body: 本题问的是是否支持涵盖墨西哥、美国和加拿大的自由贸易区。不能在1988年的问题里把它直接写成已经生效的《北美自由贸易协定》。
白宫1993年9月的背景简报明确列出协定的生效日为1994年1月1日。剧本中对就业、产业转移和劳动保障的判断是竞选政策及顾问评价，不能用后来的实际经济结果改写选项立场。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：1993年9月14日北美自由贸易协定白宫简报

notes.title: 禁毒主管：沙皇比喻及机构时点
contains: We need to strengthen the power of the Drug Czar, and implement tough measures on repeat offenders. We also need programs to assist low-income families so that the children of today don't turn to crime in the future.
body: Drug Czar用“沙皇”比喻集中协调禁毒政策的负责人，并非君主头衔；正文译为国家禁毒主管。
里根于1988年11月18日签署《反毒品滥用法》，在大选之后。里根基金会的当日日记页面概述该法建立了内阁级禁毒主管职位。剧本把加强主管权力放在竞选选项里，仍按原作保留；不要由此误以为后来设立的职位在竞选时已经按相同制度运作。

sources.title: 美国总统项目：1988年11月18日法案签署讲话
里根基金会：1988年11月18日日记及事件摘要

notes.title: 含着银脚出生：富家子与失言的双关
contains: I will take the attack to George Bush, who has all of the weaknesses of Ronald Reagan, with none of the strengths. He was born with a silver foot in his mouth.
body: 英语“含着银勺出生”指家境优裕；“把脚塞进嘴里”形容说错话、失言。把银勺换成银脚，同时讥讽布什的出身和讲话表现。正文保留奇怪的银脚形象，借旁注解释笑点。
安·理查兹在1988年民主党全国代表大会的演说中使用了这句话；2007年国会纪念她的记录也明确重述此事。游戏让杜卡基斯选用这句攻击话，不意味着这句话最初由他提出。

sources.title: 美国国会记录：纪念安·理查兹，2007年

notes.title: 希腊移民之子：原作一处人物经历错误
contains: Let's focus on my record as a Greek immigrant who has risen to the highest positions in American life, along with my competence and liberal values.
To what extent will you campaign focus on your background as the child of Greek immigrants, and your rise through American society?
body: 东北大学保存的杜卡基斯总统竞选档案说明，他于1933年11月3日出生在马萨诸塞州布鲁克莱恩，父母为希腊移民。本人不是出生在希腊后移居美国的移民。
原作一处选项却称本人为希腊移民。英文和正文沿用原作说法，以此旁注指出错误；其他正确写为移民之子的段落也保持其原有意义。不能从错误选项推断他不具备总统参选资格。

notes.title: 星球大战：战略防御倡议的绰号
contains: Do you support the Strategic Defense Initiative, a.k.a. “Star Wars”, designed to produce missile-defense weapons?
body: 战略防御倡议试图研究拦截战略弹道导弹的防御技术。“星球大战”是该计划的流行绰号，不能理解成电影项目或当时已经部署成功的太空武器系统。
里根在1983年3月23日讲话中提出长期研发方向，也承认技术艰巨、可能需要数十年，并要求继续维持核威慑。题目中的支持或反对仍是1988年的政策选择，不把未来技术成败写进候选人的回答。

notes.title: 佛州537票：计票与诉讼不是同一道程序
contains:
George W. Bush attempts to chart a new direction for the U.S., while Al Gore tries to win election as the sitting Vice President. Ralph Nader is a leftist third-party candidate. The economy has been booming, until quite recently, but President Clinton has been through an embarrassing scandal.

Candidates will debate what to do with a $200 billion budget surplus, among other things. In the real world, Florida was decided by 537 votes after 36 days and a Supreme Court decision.
How the fuck did Florida tie are you fucking kidding me

“Too close to call!”

The state of Florida has a margin of victory under half a percent, and with the election hinging on its result, the recounts in the state are going to decide it. Every court option and legal procedure will be investigated by you and your opponent, so be ready for the long haul. Let’s hope this delay in fundamental democracy doesn't result in the unpreparedness of any critical governmental agencies. That would be truly terrible!
body: 众议院书记员公布的2000年选举统计中，佛州共和党总统选举人得票2912790，民主党2912253，相差537票。这个数字来自认证计票结果，不是最高法院亲自数出的票数。
布什诉戈尔判词回顾了不足半个百分点触发机器重计，随后申请手工重计、认证和诉讼的过程。游戏将这些程序压缩为结局；不要把小差距直接等同于平票，或把司法裁判译成选举人团投票。

sources.title: 众议院书记员：2000年选举统计佛州表
