notes.title: 纳德的5%目标与公共资助
contains:
As expected, you have lost the 2000 election.

The legacy of this campaign depends on a couple of factors. First of all, did you receive 5% of the popular vote? If so, congratulations! You will enable the Green Party to run a vigorous campaign in 2004 and present a true choice to the American people. Also, the Democrats were a little peeved that you "stole" votes from them in this election. Hopefully that doesn't lead to a backlash.

Wow! No candidate received 270 electoral votes, but the House will elect George W. Bush as President.

Did you receive 5% of the popular vote? If so, congratulations! You will enable the Green Party to run a vigorous campaign in 2004 and present a true choice to the American people. Also, the Democrats were a little peeved that you "stole" votes from them in this election. Hopefully that doesn't lead to a backlash, especially since they will lose the vote in the House.

”As expected, you've lost the 2000 election.”

Congratulations! You received 5% of the popular vote! You will enable the Green Party to run a vigorous campaign in 2004 and present a true choice to the American people. You’ve run a great campaign these last few months, and you should have no problem getting renominated in 4 years.

But for now, sit back and relax, you’ve earned it. Who knows? Maybe next election you’ll even win a state or two.

”Congratulations! You’ve won D.C.!”

What a campaign! You’ve managed to surpass expectations and net yourself some electoral votes! You should have no trouble gaining federal matching funds next election, and you can take solace in the fact that the people of D.C. chose the only capable man this election.

Democrats are sure to be miffed, especially so if they lost, but you couldn’t care less at this moment. Good luck in 2004!

”Holy Cow! You won a state!”

Everyone thought it impossible, but you’ve pulled it off! You’re the first third-party candidate in over 30 years to win a state, and both you and your supporters are ecstatic. Federal matching funds in 2004 are all but guaranteed, and you’ve established the green party as a force to be reckoned with.

Let’s hope you’re more than just a flash in the pan and can run a similar campaign in 2004. The Green party may even find itself in the White House someday - and it’s all thanks to you.

”As expected, you've lost the 2000 election.”

This was hardly a surprise, considering the stranglehold that the two-party system holds on American politics. To make matters worse, you didn’t even get 5% of the popular vote, so the Green Party will have to do without federal matching funds.

Still, you’ve run a decent campaign, and your campaign has tried the best it could. You have a chance to cross that 5% threshold in the next election at least, considering you’ve been a perennial candidate for 8 years now. Good luck in 2004!
Interesting campaign strategy. But you will lose a good number of votes in states like Florida and Ohio, and every little bit helps if you want to hit 5% nationally.
This is one of the big decisions of your campaign -- can you run up your vote total in large, liberal states to hit the 5% threshold nationally? Time will tell.
body: 联邦选举委员会2000年年报区分初选配套资助和大选公共资助：小党依据上次总统选举的全国普选票比例取得部分大选资助；新党候选人达到5%可取得选后部分资助。
所以5%目标有制度背景，但赢下哥伦比亚特区或一个州，不会自动保证全国比例达标。原作把多种公共资助概称matching funds，正文保留联邦配套资助说法；需用这条说明区分初选配套款与大选拨款。候选人还须满足其他资格条件。

sources.title: 联邦选举委员会：2000年年报第16—17页，PDF第20—21页

notes.title: 纳德喊否决：架空喜剧与真实程序
contains:
”The Senate will now vote on H.R. 5411, the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2001.”

Those were the words of the clerk in the US Senate. They went through each Senator by state, asking for a voice vote from each of them. After all, was said and done, the tally was 81-19 in favour of the motion. the clerk said 'The motion passes. The bill will now be presented to the president for signing.' He stood up and turned around, only to see president Ralph Nader standing 2 inches behind him, which causes the Clerk to stumble back. 'Oh, h-hello there President Nader. I was just going to pres-' He gets interrupted by the loudest yell he had ever heard, when president Nader bellowed at him:

VETOED!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

president Nader then had his 74th veto overridden that congress just 5 minutes later.
body: 这一结局是纳德当总统的架空喜剧。总统不是靠在参议院书记员身后大喊一声，就完成法定否决；宪法规定将法案连同反对理由退回原提出的院，推翻否决须两院各有三分之二赞成。
真实的2001财年国防授权立法是2000年10月30日的公法106-398，由H.R.4205承载并引入H.R.5408内容。原作的H.R.5411、81比19、74次否决与五分钟都保留，不拿真实编号替换或改变触发条件。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：宪法第一条第七款
GovInfo：公法106-398正式文本开篇

notes.title: 戈尔发明互联网：缩略转述形成的政治梗
contains: Is it true that you claimed to have invented the internet?
Maybe I didn't personally sit down and invent the internet. But I was crucial in fighting for the funding that allowed our universities to build this system.

This is misrepresentation of what I said. I never claimed to invent the internet, I was merely pointing out that government research which I supported as a Senator was a crucial piece of the equation.
This is a petty, personal attack, designed to distract from the real issues facing our country.
body: CNN在2003年节目逐字稿中重放了1999年采访片段：戈尔谈的是在国会任职时主动推动互联网的创建。节目随后明确谈到，简化转述把这变成了“我创造了互联网”。不是声称亲自写出全部技术。
互联网协会由早期建设者撰写的历史也记述了研究报告对戈尔及高速网络政策的影响。游戏中的问题采用广为流传的攻击说法，回答则可解释政府研究与经费支持；中文保留这一区别，不把传闻写成技术史结论。

sources.title: CNN：2003年1月19日节目重放原采访片段
互联网协会：互联网简史，政府政策与研究网络

notes.title: 克里与京都：决议不等于条约批准票
contains: The Kyoto Protocol would commit the United States (along with many other countries) to reduce greenhouse gas emissions. Would you support this plan as President?
I would not. The Protocol exempts 80% of the world, including major population centers such as China and India, from compliance, and would cause serious harm to the US economy.
It seems very unlikely that the Senate will ever come up with the votes to ratify this agreement. I don't know how my support or opposition would change that equation.
We have worked for years with many other countries to negotiate this agreement. I support the environment and believe the Protocol should be ratified.
It does not look good for Al Gore, noted environmentalist, to come out against the Kyoto Protocol.
This is a good hedge. Even John Kerry voted against the Protocol.
body: 1997年7月25日，参议院以95票赞成通过伯德—黑格尔决议，克里投赞成票。决议反对不同时要求发展中国家承担指定减排承诺、或严重损害美国经济的协定。这不是对后来《京都议定书》的批准表决。
议定书第三条将量化目标放在附件一国家，另有其他合作义务。原作把克里的投票概括为反对议定书、把差别义务概括为80%免于履约；正文保留竞选语境，旁注指出制度区别，不把这些概括认证为完整法条。

sources.title: 参议院：1997年第205号唱名表决及克里票向
美国国会：第105届参议院第98号决议原文
联合国气候框架公约：京都议定书原文第三条

notes.title: 米洛舍维奇下台与移交法庭的时间
contains: This certainly helped unseat Slobodan Milosevic, but as President I will make sure that America treads carefully before intervening in foreign nations' affairs.
I support our actions in this theatre. For minimal cost we were able to stop a potential genocide and put a dictator to justice.
body: 前南刑庭的案件历史记载，1999年发出逮捕令，2000年9月选举及10月群众抗议使米洛舍维奇下台；实际移交海牙是在2001年6月。
因此，2000年竞选中说已经让独裁者接受司法制裁，超前概括了后来的过程。原作这句话与对轰炸效果的赞许仍保留；不能把起诉、下台、逮捕、移交和定罪当成同一个事件。

sources.title: 联合国前南刑庭：逮捕与移交历史

notes.title: 科尔号袭击：当时疑问与后来的调查
contains: What are your thoughts on the USS Cole bombing, which has killed 17 American sailors. How should we prevent such incidents of terrorism in the future?

I support a strong, overwhelming response against whoever perpetrated this attack. Any government that harbors such terrorists should be overthrown, even if it requires the commitment of American troops.

We need to do two things -- first of all we need better procedures to ensure that our forces in dangerous regions do better at protecting themselves. Secondly, we will investigate who is responsible for this attack, be it Al-Qaeda or some other group, and attack them accordingly.

This attack was a tragedy, but it underscores the need to the United States to have a more limited foreign policy. The Cold War is over, and it doesn't make sense to deploy troops in so many parts of the world.
body: 2000年10月12日，科尔号驱逐舰在也门亚丁港补给燃料时遭载有炸药的小艇袭击，17名美国水兵遇难。FBI后来确认基地组织策划并实施袭击。
题目及回答处于竞选当时，可以要求先调查责任人。不能把后来调查的结论强行写进每个选项，抹去克制、调查后打击和推翻庇护政府三种政策立场的差别。

sources.title: FBI：科尔号袭击案件历史

notes.title: 埃利安：监护与移民争议
contains: Do you believe that Elian Gonzalez should have been returned to Cuba?
Returning Elian to Cuba was unconscionable. I did not support this decision by the Clinton Administration.
We should be talking less about Elian, and more about my plans to expand upon the great prosperity of this nation.
The law is the law. Elian belongs in Cuba with his father. These questions are never easy, but the Clinton Administration and Janet Reno did what they had to do.
The Elian issue is simple -- a small, politically active minority in Florida wants him to remain. There is also the issue of supporting or opposing Bill Clinton to consider.
body: 埃利安·冈萨雷斯案涉及古巴男孩在美国亲属与古巴父亲之间的监护、移民和庇护申请争议。克林顿图书馆档案说明，联邦人员于2000年4月22日接走男孩，同年6月28日他与父亲返回古巴。
正文的支持或反对遣返，是候选人的政治选择；不把两党立场简单归成赞成或反对某种族，也不把政府说明当成所有争论已经消失。

sources.title: 克林顿总统图书馆：埃利安案档案导读

notes.title: ANWR：北极保护区的名称
contains: Do you support proposals to expand oil drilling in Alaska, and specifically in the Alaska National Wildlife Refuge?
I oppose these plans. The ANWR is an environmental treasure of the United States, and the oil gained from any exploitation will be relatively limited.
body: ANWR指位于阿拉斯加的北极国家野生动物保护区。鱼类与野生动物管理局说明，其前身建立于1960年，1980年扩大并改称现名。
题干原作写成Alaska National Wildlife Refuge，正文保留阿拉斯加措辞；含ANWR的回答使用规范译名。地名不改原始资源与州数据，钻探支持和反对仍按原作立场表达。

sources.title: 美国鱼类与野生动物管理局：北极保护区历史

notes.title: 战略石油储备：2000年交换放油
contains: What do you think of Bill Clinton's recent action to tap the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to reduce the costs of home heating, particularly in the northeast?

This is clear political gamesmanship which I cannot support in good conscience. The Reserve should be used in cases of national emergency only. Furthermore, why did Clinton announce this decision so close to the election?
I understand the impulse to help America's families, but the Reserve should be used in cases of national emergency only. This action is unwise.
Oil prices have spiked to nearly $40 a barrel. We need to help hard-working Americans in states like New Hampshire by making temporary allowances from our reserve.
A lot of oil companies and national security hawks are upset with this move, and not too thrilled that you have embraced it.
Those few who pay close attention admire your integrity and avoidance of regional favoritism on this issue. Except for those who live in New England of course.
If you want to win New Hampshire, supporting this move can't hurt.
body: 克林顿在2000年9月23日讲话中宣布，前一日指示能源部长在30天内交换3000万桶战略储备原油，理由是取暖油库存不足、原油昂贵，尤其影响东海岸与新英格兰。
交换安排不是永远免费赠送库存。游戏对是否只应在紧急情况下动用储备、以及临近选举的动机有不同判断，中文保留这些争议，不把所有批评者统称不关心冬季取暖。

sources.title: 美国国家档案馆：克林顿2000年9月23日讲话

notes.title: 弹劾不等于免职
contains: Despite your best efforts, Al Gore will succeed Clinton in the presidency. Many Republicans are disappointed with your loss, seeing the Monica Lewinsky scandal, among others a real opening for them to return to the White House. The closeness of the election will likely inspire Gore to be a bit more moderate and bipartisan in his decision-making. With the close Senate, it will certainly be needed.

Despite your best efforts, Al Gore will succeed Clinton in the presidency. Many Republicans are disappointed with your loss, seeing the Monica Lewinsky scandal, among others a real opening for them to return to the White House. Gore flipping the House and Senate will give him some breathing room, but with the slim margins, he will have his work cut out for him.

Despite your best efforts, Al Gore will succeed Clinton in the presidency. Many Republicans are disappointed with your loss, seeing the Monica Lewinsky scandal, among others a real opening for them to return to the White House. Many are shocked at the margin you lost by, seeing the Lewinsky scandal as giving a lot of socially conservative states the impetus to vote for you. Many it really IS just the economy that matters.
Bill Clinton was an embarrassment to the United States, and his impeachment was well-deserved. I believe that he should have been removed from office.
I don't think we need to belabor the point. I pledge to the American people that I will restore honor and dignity to the White House when I am President.
I am my own man. I respect Bill Clinton in many ways, but his personal conduct was lacking in this case.
This is a non-issue. Bill Clinton is one the best Presidents of the last fifty years, and we should be focusing on his policies and successes, not his personal affairs.
body: 众议院在1998年12月19日弹劾克林顿，参议院于1999年2月12日审判后作无罪裁决，他并未因此被免职。弹劾是提出正式指控，免职还涉及审判定罪，不能互译。
候选人可以主张他本应被免职，也可以赞许其政策、批评其私生活；这些立场原样保留，不把“应该”改成已经发生的事实。

sources.title: 美国众议院历史办公室：弹劾名单与克林顿审判结果

notes.title: 纳德突击队：消费者权益研究者
contains:
”Good lord! You’ve won the 2000 election!”

Everyone thought it impossible, that at best you would get 5%, but you’ve proved everybody wrong! This is the biggest political upset in American history, beating out Truman over 50 years ago. An impromptu party has been arranged at the Green Party headquarters in DC, your answering machine is clogged with congratulatory calls from your supporters, and every news station in the country has been clamouring to get to you for an interview

What you've achieved tonight is a stellar victory that will be studied for the rest of American history. From Nader’s Raiders to the White House in 30 years, let’s hope your surprise victory has also netted the Green Party some senate seats, or you’ll have to compromise big in the coming years, considering your stiff opposition from both parties. This definitely wasn’t supposed to happen - Good luck!
body: 纳德在自己的回顾文章中记述，第一批年轻研究者于1969年调查并推动改革联邦贸易委员会，后续团队调查公司与政府机构。这就是Nader’s Raiders称号的背景。
正文译为纳德突击队，指政策调查与消费者权益行动者，不是军队、橄榄球队或游戏中的袭击部队。“三十年走到白宫”则是本局架空胜选结局，不是纳德现实中曾当选总统。

sources.title: 纳德本人：2021年回顾早期Nader’s Raiders

notes.title: 丹福思的四届：补缺与完整任期
contains: John Danforth served four terms as Senator from Missouri. He has broad experience in government, and as a moderate Republican would reinforce Bush's claim to be a uniter. Danforth also has close relationships with conservative stalwarts such as Kit Bond, Clarence Thomas, and John Ashcroft, and would not arouse undue suspicion from the conservative wing of the party. Winning Missouri back would be a key piece of any Republican victory in 2000.
body: 参议院手册记载，丹福思于1976年12月27日就任，任至1995年1月2日；脚注说明，他先当选1977年1月3日开始的任期，随后获州长任命补完此前任期的最后几天。
因此，原作的四届可以将极短的补缺任期与三个完整六年任期分别计数。正文保留四届，不应据此推断他任职24年或四次当选；也不能确定作者是否有意采用这种计数。

sources.title: GovInfo：第110届参议院手册，密苏里州历任参议员表及脚注（PDF第26页）

notes.title: 亚利桑那移民法：保留一条不等于全法获认可
contains: A recent Supreme Court decision affirmed an Arizona law allowing officers to check suspected illegal immigrants for proof of immigration status. Do you think this law is a good idea?
This is an unconscionable violation of civil rights and will certainly lead to racial profiling.
The proper authority for enforcement rests with the federal government. This law goes further than federal laws and even if constitutional, should be repealed.
I don't want to comment on an issue that is best left to the voters of Arizona.
The federal government has forced Arizona's hand by being too lax on enforcement for far too long.
body: 2012年6月25日的判决认定，SB1070的第3、5(C)、6条被联邦法排除；对执法过程中核查移民身份的第2(B)条，则认为在州法院解释及实际实施之前，不宜先行禁止。
这不是确认所有实施方式都合宪。判词仍保留对拖延释放、种族及其他宪法问题提出挑战的可能。游戏题干作了简化，选项中反对种族筛查、强调联邦权限或支持严格执法的立场仍各自保留。

sources.title: 康奈尔转载：亚利桑那诉美国案多数判词，2012年6月25日

notes.title: 联合公民案：独立支出与直接捐款
contains: Would you support a Constitutional Amendment to overturn some provisions of the Citizens United ruling, affecting campaign finance by PAC's?
Absolutely not. The right to disseminate one's political viewpoints freely is central to American democracy.

Perhaps not a Constitutional Amendment. These should be reserved for the most serious of issues. I think we can investigate maybe other ways to prevent money from having an undue influence in politics.

I would be happy to disavow the use of Super PAC advertising if my opponent would as well. Unfortunately the other side will do anything to win this election, regardless of how it aligns with the will of the public.
This is one of the worst decisions in the history of the court. If they can't see that campaign finance regulation is entirely constitutional, then we do need to have an Amendment in place.
Expect your hopes of getting reelected to be buried under about $50 million of shady, PAC television commercials.
Expect your hopes of getting elected to be buried under about $50 million of shady, PAC television commercials.
body: 联邦选举委员会2010年说明，判决撤销了禁止公司及工会以自身资金支付独立支出和竞选传播的限制，但广告的付款声明、披露要求，以及公司和工会直接向候选人捐款的禁令仍然存在。
因此，不能把它概括成所有竞选资金均无限制。独立广告、候选人筹款和不同类型政治行动委员会须分别理解；题目关于修宪或自愿放弃广告的选择，仍按原作政治立场呈现。

sources.title: 联邦选举委员会：2010年联合公民案实施声明

notes.title: 奥巴马医改：保费、自付额与强制投保
contains: The Affordable Care Act (i.e. 'Obamacare') will cap annual premiums, require minimum coverage levels, and outlaw discrimination against people with pre-existing conditions. What do you think?

Barack Obama's signature achievement from his first term was a landmark health care reform act. The law will establish insurance exchanges which must meet minimum coverage standards, and also cannot deny people based on pre-existing conditions. To help support these policies, every American will be mandated to purchase health insurance.

Believes that government regulations have put an unaffordable burden on doctors and insurance companies. Supports drastic cuts to Medicare and Medicaid. May support an end to the FDA and other regulatory agencies to restore competitiveness to the American health care system.
Supports a greater role for the free market in the halth care sector. Opposed to Obamacare. Probably would not support an end to the FDA or other, more radical measures.
Probably opposed to Obamacare. Would probably support malpractice reform and other incremental measures to cut overall health care costs, without challenging the larger regulatory system.

Supports some effort to collectively insure the poor and the chronically ill. May disagree with certain aspects of Obamacare or may not support a mandate, but agrees that the current system needs more intervention.
Supports Obamacare more or less as is. Rejects calls for a public option but supports an insurance mandate and also strongly supports the existing Medicare system.

Supports Obamacare but also would support a public insurance agency to ensure minimum coverage standards are met at an affordable cost. Believes that malpractice suits are conducive to good care by providing oversight of the medical system.
Admires the attempt of Obamacare to reform the system, but sees the change as too incremental. Favors a socialized medical system on the model of most European countries.
My plan was a good plan for Massachusetts. Obamacare is bad because it forces an individual mandate on the American public.
It's probably time to admit that there isn't much of a difference between our plans. I was simply forced to pander to extreme elements of the Republican Party during our primary election process.

I've changed my position on health care over the years after much reflection. We should focus on doing anything we can to overturn Obamacare, rather than dwelling on what I used to think years in the past.
body: 2010年公法111-148区分保费与费用分担，规定年度费用分担上限，并禁止既往病史排除；个人投保义务也有豁免，条款分阶段生效。原作“每个美国人”和“年度保费上限”的概括不等于完整法律条文。
保费是持有保险的缴费，自付上限是接受保障范围内服务时分担费用的上限，并不包括保费。正文保留原词，不把两者悄悄互换，也不把支持公共医保选项译成全面废除私人保险。此说明不套用2026年的金额到2012年。

sources.title: GovInfo：平价医疗法案原始公法，第1201、1302及1501节
HealthCare.gov：自付上限术语定义，仅用于区别概念

notes.title: 2033年预测：储备耗尽不是开始支付
contains: Talking about a bankrupt Social Security program is a right wing scare tactic. We could afford to increase benefits if we really wanted to.

You know, the projected shortfall that people talk of, we're not even talking about the Trust Fund making a net payout until 2033. Maybe there are some tweaks we can make to the program, but it is fundamentally sound.
With minor changes like an increase to the retirement age and means testing after a certain benefit level, we can ensure the solvency of this program long into the future.

The Social Security program has unfunded liabilities of over $100 trillion. It's time for us to admit that the Social Security program is bankrupt before it drags the rest of the federal government down with it.
This is a corrupt, ludicrous practice which Congress uses to hide the true size of our budget and Social Security deficits.

I think anyone who has managed money can tell you there is a place for U.S. Treasuries in any professional portfolio. Allowing the Social Security fund to invest in other securities opens a huge number of potential problems and conflicts of interest.
body: 社会保障署2012年公告预测，合并信托基金资产将在2033年耗尽，并明确记载：不含利息的收入在2010年已低于支出；2011年计入利息后的总收入仍高于支出。
所以原作把2033年说成开始净支出的日期，混淆了年度收支与储备耗尽。即使储备耗尽，当时预测持续收入仍可支付约75%的预定待遇，不等于一分钱也不发。原作数字及支持、改革、反对各选项保留；100万亿美元断言的估值口径尚未独立确认。

sources.title: 社会保障署：2012年4月23日信托基金年度公告

notes.title: 速度与激情：放枪追踪的执法丑闻
contains: What is your opinion on the 'gunwalking' tactics that led to the 'Fast and Furious' scandal?
It makes sense to track gun sales over a period of time, to get a better picture of who is buying them, and to try and arrest more important cartel leaders.
This is a specialized occupational question that can best be answered by the ATF and the Department of Justice.
Perhaps in limited cases. I am skeptical of these programs because they place too much faith in Mexican authorities to pursue cases once they cross the border.

The tactic of 'gunwalking' led directly to the death of a Border Patrol agent. If we see people breaking the law, it makes no sense not to punish them. I would support the removal of Eric Holder as Attorney General.
body: 司法部监察长2012年报告说明，ATF为追查贩枪网络高层，推迟逮捕代购者和扣押枪支；这些枪后来出现在墨西哥及美国犯罪现场，其中包括边境执法人员布赖恩·特里遇害案的相关现场。
gunwalking不是持枪散步，是放任可疑枪支转手的追踪手法；这里的Fast and Furious是执法行动名称。相关枪支在现场被发现，不自动证明某一支就是发射致命子弹的枪。正文“直接导致死亡”仍作为原作政治指控，不能扩大成已核定弹道结论。

sources.title: 司法部监察长：2012年4月至9月半年度报告，行动调查摘要

notes.title: 信仰演说的年份
contains: The Mormon Church has been the guiding force of my life. It's only natural for me to discuss this influence in my campaign speeches.

On occasion it makes sense to bring this up. Over the years I have helped out many in need through the Mormon Church, both with my time and through charity. We should make sure the American people know this about me.

I already made one speech that was entirely devoted to this issue back in 2008. Bringing it up more often runs the risk of distracting the American people from the most important issues of this campaign.
To what extent will you speak about your religious faith (Mormonism) on the campaign trail?
body: 罗姆尼竞选团队保存的新闻稿记载，他在乔治·布什总统图书馆发表“美国的信仰”演说的日期是2007年12月6日，谈的是宗教自由。
原作回答写2008年，正文保留这一年份，不改英文或游戏条件。2008是竞选周期，不能因此把2007年已经发表的演说挪到次年。也不把候选人的摩门教信仰当作不忠于美国的证据。

sources.title: 美国总统研究项目：罗姆尼竞选团队2007年12月6日新闻稿

notes.title: 近百年最高失业率：竞选攻击与数据
contains: I will hammer on the theme that Obama has completely failed the United States as President. He has presided over the largest deficit increases and highest unemployment rate in almost a hundred years.

The United States enters 2012 with a struggling economy. After a severe recession from 2007-2009, unemployment remains over 8%, and many voters are frustrated with the slow pace of job creation. At the same time, the annual deficit has exploded since Obama took office, with some advocating for immediate cuts in government spending.
body: 劳工统计局年度表列出：1982年失业率9.7%，2010年9.6%，2012年8.1%。单就这些年度数据，便不能把奥巴马任内失业率称为近百年来最高。
正文保留原作候选人的攻击台词，不把它当成译者确认的经济史结论。年度平均、单月峰值与就业人数不是同一指标；也不因旁注修改支持率或选项效果。

sources.title: 劳工统计局：历年就业与失业年度表

notes.title: 沃伦与消费者金融保护局
contains: Elizabeth Warren is currently fighting the good fight in the Massachusetts Senate race. Would you be open to offering her a position in your Administration if she falls short there?

She was supposed to be the head of the Consumer Financial Protection Board, remember? Republican obstructionism prevented that. I'm confident that she will do well against Scott Brown in the Massachusetts Senate race.
Let's hope it doesn't come to that. She is a brilliant, talented woman and no matter what happens, there will always be a place for her in government.

Some her views I think have become, you know, a little extreme perhaps. Ms. Warren has good intentions but I'm not sure that I would go so far as to offer her another position in an Obama Administration.
body: 2011年9月6日，理查德·科德雷在参议院作证时以消费者金融保护局局长提名人身份发言，并感谢伊丽莎白·沃伦将这个机构从构想变为现实。
原作Consumer Financial Protection Board的机构名称不准，规范名称为Bureau，中文使用消费者金融保护局。“原本该由她任职”是一种政治评价，不意味着沃伦已经正式获提名、随后遭到否决；不能把筹建工作与正式局长任命混为一谈。

sources.title: 消费者金融保护局：科德雷2011年9月6日提名听证证词

notes.title: 联邦雇员并非一律没有集体谈判权
contains: That's an issue for the states to decide. You know, the federal government does not support collective bargaining for its employees, so it's not appropriate for me to comment on a state matter.

Collective bargaining in the public sector is one of the primary contributors to our exploding state deficits, which must eventually be subsidized by the federal government. I agree that the practice should end.
body: 美国法典第5编第7102条列明，符合该章规定的联邦雇员可以通过其选出的代表就雇用条件进行集体谈判；此条源自1978年立法。
具体适用人员、可谈事项与限制另有规定，不能把联邦制度概括成完全没有集体谈判。游戏的候选人回答保留原作说法；谈判权不等于不受限制的罢工权，也不等于所有工资项目都可自由谈判。

sources.title: 康奈尔转载：美国法典第5编第7102条及1978年来源注

notes.title: 一万美元打赌：不要与赛马混为一事
contains: Recent reports have highlighted the large amount of money that you and your wife spend on racing horses. Have you ever bet more than $10,000 on a horse race?
Sometimes if you feel strongly about something, you have to back that up with a little cash. $10,000 is nothing for someone who's as wealthy as I am.
Absolutely not. I wouldn't think of making a bet this large.
body: 2011年12月10日共和党初选辩论中，罗姆尼就佩里对其医保立场的说法提出一万美元赌约；保存的逐字稿可见双方争论及赌约。
这为大额打赌的竞选话题提供真实背景，但不是他在赛马上实际下过一万美元赌注的证据。题目混合了马匹开支与赌注，正文保留；不替候选人补写未经证实的赌博经历。

sources.title: 美国总统研究项目：2011年12月10日得梅因共和党辩论逐字稿

notes.title: 佩尔助学金：受助者、年份与分母
contains: The most recent data (for 2010) on Pell Grants indicate that 60% of all college students receive one. In that same year, the program cost $36 billion. What changes, if any, would you recommend to this program?
Pell Grants and government aid serve to inflate the cost of college by a commensurate amount. This program does not benefit students in any way and serves as a boondoggle for administrators.
These programs should only aid the truly needy. It seems like the criteria is a little loose to me.
Students are the future of this country and they need all the help they can get to make it through college, especially considering how much tuition has been increased over the past few years.
In Europe, secondary education is publicly funded. I'm just pointing that out...
body: 国会预算办公室2013年报告说明，佩尔助学金帮助低收入学生接受中学后的教育，包括大学、社区学院与职业培训；2011至2012学年约940万人获336亿美元。
这不能直接认证题目关于2010年所有大学生60%及360亿美元的组合数字：学年、财政年度及统计分母不同。正文原数值保留，60%的具体依据尚待核。回答中的secondary education按原文译为中等教育，不擅自改成大学；这句话与助学金针对中学后教育的实际范围须区分。

sources.title: 国会预算办公室：2013年佩尔助学金增长与政策选项报告

notes.title: 加兰：提名并不等于就任
contains: Do you believe that the Senate should confirm Merrick Garland, an Obama appointee, to the Supreme Court?
You can't confirm him. We've got to let the people decide this November.
This is congressional obstructionism at its worst. We've seen any number of judges be appointed in the final year of a term. We can't have what we're seeing right now.
body: 奥巴马在2016年3月16日宣布提名梅里克·加兰接替斯卡利亚。白宫保存的当天讲话明确使用提名人的身份；总统提名与参议院确认，是不同的程序。
三月版中的争论应按当时提名仍待处理的视角理解。正文不倒灌后来的人事变化，也不把候选人关于确认或阻挠的政治立场改写成加兰已经成为最高法院大法官。

sources.title: 奥巴马白宫档案：2016年3月16日提名讲话

notes.title: 同性婚姻判决：许可与跨州承认
contains: Do you support the Supreme Court ruling in 2015 which struck down any prohibition on gay marriage?
I can't support it. You know, once upon a time we actually had a legislature in this country which debated the laws and made these kinds of decisions.
I fully support gay marriage, but I'd like to see every state make this decision for itself.
This decision was a milestone for equality in our country. I will appoint judges who feel the same way about it.
body: 2015年6月26日奥伯格费尔诉霍奇斯案判决要求各州准许同性伴侣结婚，并承认在其他州依法缔结的同性婚姻，依据是第十四修正案的正当程序与平等保护。
判决不是要求所有宗教团体举行婚礼，也不是取消一切婚姻规则。游戏保留支持、反对及诉诸州权的不同政治立场；旁注解释实际判决范围，不改变选项效果。

sources.title: 康奈尔转载：奥伯格费尔案判词与判决摘要

notes.title: 伊朗解冻资产不是美国赠款
contains: Do you support the recent nuclear deal between the United States and Iran?
This is a signature accomplishment of the Obama Administration, and I support it whole-heartedly.
I support this deal, but I will work very hard as President to see that it is aggressively enforced.
This deal is a completely asinine joke. We still owe Iran $150 billion if we change our mind. We just give them the money.
body: 美国财政部2015年证词估计，伊朗央行全球外汇资产总额为1000亿至1250亿美元，解除制裁后可用流动资产为略多于500亿美元，其余许多资产无法迅速变现。
解冻该国原有资产，不等于美国财政向它赠送同等金额。正文保留原作1500亿美元及候选人的攻击、辩护说法；上述不同口径不能混成一笔已经核定的美国援助。

sources.title: 美国财政部：亚当·舒宾2015年参议院书面证词

notes.title: bully pulpit：总统的公共发声平台
contains:
Congratulations! You have won the 2016 election.

In spite of a hard-fought challenge from Hillary Clinton, you have shocked the world with your election victory.

On the political front, you have the bully pulpit in your favor, but both parties in Congress are likely to oppose your next moves, albeit for different reasons. Can you build a working coalition?
body: 国家公园管理局的西奥多·罗斯福历史教材，说明他把总统职位视为可以向公众倡议政策的强大发声平台。这里的bully不是在说欺凌，pulpit也不要求理解为真的教堂讲坛。
结局中的意思是总统拥有影响公众议程的优势。拥有这种优势，不等于国会必然赞同或总统能单方面通过法案。

sources.title: 国家公园管理局：罗斯福总统任期与公共发声平台历史教材

notes.title: 三月版的起诉情节是架空分支
contains: The FBI has recommended the indictment of several of your aides, based on classified intelligence which they obtained from secure facilities and emailed to you. Do you have any comment?
The FBI has recommended the indictment of several of Hillary Clinton's aides, based on classified intelligence which they obtained from secure facilities and emailed to her. Do you have any comment?
We've all seen Hillary Clinton lie about this scandal from the first day until now, and she's still lying about it. It's unbelievable what she thinks she can get away with.
I've gotta tell you, I'm pretty surprised. It would be a shame if we decided this election based on politically motivated prosecutions, rather than the issues.
After months of denials from liberal pundits, the Clinton email scandal does seem like it will have significant consequences on this election.
This seems remarkably hands-off for what appears to be a major scandal in the Clinton camp.
body: 本剧本按2016年3月视角设想调查可能走向起诉，不能把游戏中的这一事件当成实际发生的法律结论。
现实中，司法部长洛雷塔·林奇于2016年7月6日表示，接受调查人员与检察官一致建议，结束调查，并不对该调查范围内任何人提起刑事指控。这份后来公告只用于区分历史与架空情节，不写进三月正文，也不改游戏条件。

sources.title: 美国司法部：林奇2016年7月6日关于邮件调查的声明

notes.title: 大学方案：原作350的单位疑点
contains: I have a plan to spend $350 over the next 10 years to help those who need it the most, to attend college.
body: 《时代》2015年8月10日报道，克林顿拟提出的大学负担能力方案，竞选团队估计十年成本约3500亿美元。
原作只写350而没有十亿这一数量单位；正文保留，不擅自改数字。报道不是已通过的拨款法，官方完整方案本次未成功取得。

sources.title: 时代：2015年8月10日大学方案报道，非官方方案原文

notes.title: 奥兰多枪击：受害者与枪手分开计数
contains: There was a mass shooting at a gay nightclub in Orlando overnight, perpetrated by a Muslim, resulting in 50 people killed. What is your reaction?

Around the world we have Islamic terror striking at innocent lives, while the Democrats do nothing. If this attack on the LGBT community, this vicious attack, isn't enough to make them wake up, then what is?
Appreciate the congrats for being right on radical Islamic terrorism, I don't want congrats, I want toughness & vigilance. We must be smart!

First of all, our hearts and prayers really go out to everyone affected by this shooting, and particularly the victims. But it would be a real tragedy if we used this incident as an excuse to restrict our constitutional rights.
What happened in Orlando last right was a terrible tragedy, and our thoughts and prayers go out to everyone affected.
Thoughts and prayers are not enough. Every American should be outraged that the assault rifles used in these attacks are freely available and affordable.
My heart goes out the victims of this shooting. I will be going to Orlando in the next couple of days to pay my respects to the victims.

We don't know yet the exact motives behind this attack, but I condemn religious terrorism in the strongest terms if that is the motive. And my heart especially goes out to the Hispanic and LGBT communities that were affected by this terrible act of violence.
Trump's response to this shooting has been widely criticized by political commentators.
It's not yet clear whether this attack was actually terrorism. Both you and Trump are coming under some criticism for jumping to that conclusion.
body: 联邦调查局记录，2016年6月12日奥兰多Pulse夜总会袭击造成49名受害者死亡；警察随后击毙枪手。原作的50人与49名遇害者并不是同一种计数口径。
正文保留50，不改原始数字。调查后认定为恐怖袭击，不表示事件初期每种动机猜测都已获确认；各个回答对拥枪权、宗教与LGBT群体的立场差别均保留。

sources.title: 联邦调查局：Pulse夜总会枪击案历史记录

notes.title: 尼斯袭击：当时消息与事后统计
contains: There has been a violent terrorist attack in Nice today, resulting in the deaths of almost 100 people. How will you address this?
Another horrific attack, this time in Nice, France. Many dead and injured. When will we learn? It is only getting worse.

As President, in spite of what people in the liberal media say, I will work very closely with our foreign allies on issues of importance. Together we can unite against and defeat radical Islamic terror.
My heart goes out to the fantastic and resilient people of France, it's one of the most beautiful countries, as they deal with unspeakable tragedy.
My heart goes out to the victims of this terrible attack. I will give a speech in a few days about the importance of tolerance and diversity in our society.
My heart goes out to those affected by this terrible attack. My thoughts and prayers are with the great nation of France, and I will travel to France to pay my respects to the victims.
My heart goes out to the victims of this terrible attack. I will give a speech in a few days about the importance of defeating ISIS and religious extremism in all of its forms.
body: 法国国家警察的纪念资料记载，2016年7月14日尼斯恐怖袭击造成86人死亡，400余人受伤。
游戏写近100人，是原作概括，不是此处重新核定的确切死亡人数。正文保留；将事后确认统计与事发当天不断变化的消息区分，也不擅自推定每段候选人台词都是真实逐字引文。

sources.title: 法国国家警察：尼斯袭击十周年纪念，2026年7月17日

notes.title: 泄密归因：竞选话术与正式指控
contains: If it's really true that Russia collaborated to release this information about Hillary Clinton's private speeches to Goldman Sachs, then I totally disavow and denounce these illegal leaks.
They keep saying "Russia Russia Russia". I've heard other people say this was an inside job from a DNC whistleblower. You know, the guy that assassinated or something like that. Strange!

I am preparing a severe criticism of Russia as we speak, a very very strong criticism I think you'll agree. For seeking to divide us as a nation by releasing this information about Hillary Clinton and her political tricks.
Your complaint about Russia Russia seems a little unprompted based on what has happened thus far. Is there something else?

This is nothing compared to the lies and equivocation of Donald Trump. And furthermore, it's appalling that Republicans are so willing to throw aside all ideals and cooperate with the Russians, the moment it's convenient for them.

Where is the investigation into the Russian leaks? Where is the investigation into Trump's blatantly illegal business practices over many years? This is an unprecededented and outrageous act of political interference by the FBI.
body: 联邦调查局公开资料记载，2018年7月13日大陪审团起诉12名俄罗斯军事情报人员，涉及2016年非法进入相关电脑系统、盗取材料并安排公开等指控。起诉是正式法律指控，不等同于已经定罪。

notes.title: “阻止偷窃”与角色互换的架空结局
contains: You've done it. The terror that has been the Trump administration comes to a close with your win tonight. They say third times the charm, and you certainly proved it tonight. But my, my, by a single vote in the electoral college you did. This is one of the closest elections in US history, and you can be sure that Republicans everywhere, Trumpians or not, will be fuming at this result, and calling foul play. Be prepared for 2000 all over again.

"Stop the Steal!"

Former Vice President Joe Biden was on MSNBC, discussing his recent claims of massive election fraud, "Trump stole this election! I think that's fairly clear."

"There is significant evidence that I won in all of these states that Donald Trump supposedly 'won'. I think we really need to look at these fraudulent 'in-person' votes because if you only count the legal votes, I win easily."

Biden was going across the media, trying to popularise his claims of electoral fraud before the Congressional certification occurred. In addition, he was preparing a major rally near the Capitol, where he could show those crooked Republicans a piece of his mind. January 6th was going to be a date to live in infamy. Joe was gonna fight like hell.

We all know who REALLY won the election, though, don't we? You no doubt will be on Biden's case from now until the end of his term, plotting your epic comeback. Your base is still ravenous as ever, and you might need to throw them a bone, as, after all, you've said about mail-ins and whatnot, they are angered at your loss. You're about to give a speech in Washington DC, near the capitol buildings. Let them know what you think about this election, then they can 'peacefully and patriotically' give that traitor Mike Pence a lesson.
body: 国家档案馆记录，真实2020年选举人票为拜登306票、特朗普232票，538票中的获胜多数为270票。国会计票因国会大厦内外的暴力骚乱而延迟，到2021年1月7日凌晨3时44分才完成确认。
游戏中让败选拜登指责现场投票、筹备一月六日集会的段落，是把现实政治话术换给另一角色的架空讽刺，不是拜登真实行动的历史记录。特朗普结局中的引号也带讽刺意味，不能按字面当成旁注赞同。原作“一票之差”保留；获胜所需多数与两名候选人之间的票差是两个概念。

因此，原作“2019年的弹劾审判”压缩了弹劾和审判两个阶段。正文保留年份，旁注说明区别。无罪判决不等于从未遭众议院弹劾，候选人有关拜登家族或调查动机的指控也不自动成为已证实事实。

notes.title: 扩充最高法院与法官任命
contains: Do you support the plans of some in your party to expand the size of the Supreme Court, in order to counteract the Republicans' actions in regard to Merrick Garland and Amy Coney Barret?

I'm warning Mitch McConnell right now. Either he can back off and wait until this election is over with to nominate a justice, or I will do everything in my power to expand the size of the Court as President.

This is a naked power grab by the Republicans, Trump, and Mitch McConnell that puts the integrity of the Court in serious jeopardy. It was just four years ago that McConnell took the exact opposite position on this same issue.

We can sit around all day worrying about tactics, but the fact of the matter is, we need to win elections. If Democrats did a better job of appealing to all Americans, we wouldn't be in this predicament right now.
Absolutely. We can't sit here and play by the niceties of a bygone era while Republicans steamroll us. I'm prepared to appoint four new justices to the Supreme Court.
Fair is fair, right? The Republicans have stolen two seats on the Court with McConnell's chicanery. I think we should create two new justices and appoint them in return.

This is a very serious issue and the integrity of the Court is at risk. We're going to create a commission when I'm elected to recommend ways in which we can reform the federal court system and restore the faith of the American people.
The Court has had nine justices since 1869, and any attempt to change that is sure to destroy the Court's legitimacy even further. We must look at other kinds of reform.
What controversy? Three seats opened up, and I filled those seats. Now Democrats want to destroy the very foundation of judicial independence that our entire democracy rests upon.
Who cares what I think about this issue? Go ask Joe Biden about it -- he's the one who will have no qualms about signing off on this insane plan if he's elected President.

What do you want me to say? That I'd be happy if Sleepy Joe nominated four leftist judges to the Supreme Court in some hare-brained court-packing scheme? I'm sure if he does that, we'll be more than happy to retaliate when the voters put us back in charge.

I hate how politicized the Democrats have made the Court, but there are better ways of dealing with it than court-packing. Maybe we can all sit together and come up with some term limits, as long as it's fair for everyone.
The fact of the matter is, there is no way that Republicans will not fill these seats on the Court, and you're simply stating the obvious.
Who knows if anything will come of your openness to negotiate on this issue. In the short term, perhaps not really.
body: 最高法院的官方说明指出，国会通过法律确定大法官人数；1869年法律确定为九人。总统提名填补空缺的人选，参议院表决确认。
Court-packing在这里是通过增设席位改变法院政治构成的争论，不是重新任命所有现有法官。正文中的扩充计划或拒绝回答立场各自保留；总统不能仅凭个人宣告就增加四个法定席位。

contains:
Donaldddddddd!!!!!

Donald demanded to know their names and purposes. They introduced themselves as Alf Landon, Herbert Hoover, and George McGovern, and explained they were the ghosts of elections past. What, did you expect them to be ghosts of the past, present, and future? That's not how elections work. contains: Donald Trump is attacking you almost daily on your 2002 vote in favor of the Iraq War. How do you plan to respond?
body: 参议院记录显示，2002年10月11日以77票对23票通过H.J.Res.114，授权对伊拉克使用武力；希拉里·克林顿投赞成票。
因此，2002年支持的是授权决议，不能把实际2003年入侵的时间挪到2002年。原作围绕战争判断的辩护和批评保留，投票本身不能独立证明所有角色对战争原因的说法。

sources.title: 美国参议院：2002年10月11日第237次唱名表决
